items.title: CMS AuthenticatedData exposes attacker-inserted authAttrs when digestAlgorithm is absent
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the streaming CMS AuthenticatedData parser accepted a message whose digestAlgorithm and authAttrs fields disagreed about whether authenticated attributes were present. RFC 5652 sec. 9.1 pairs the two, requiring that authAttrs be present whenever digestAlgorithm is, and sec. 9.2 makes the MAC cover the DER encoding of authAttrs when they are present and the eContent OCTET STRING directly when they are not. CMSAuthenticatedDataParser has to choose between those two in its constructor, before it can reach authAttrs, which comes later in the SEQUENCE, so it chose on digestAlgorithm alone: for a message with digestAlgorithm absent but authAttrs present it verified the content MAC and then returned the attributes through getAuthAttrs() as though they had been authenticated, when the MAC had never covered them. An attacker able to modify a message in transit could insert an authenticated attribute, such as an RFC 2634 ESSSecurityLabel, into an otherwise valid message while holding neither the key-encryption key nor the content-MAC key, and an application taking an authorization, routing or labelling decision from those attributes would act on attacker-chosen values. The content itself remained MAC-bound. asn1.cms.AuthenticatedData now rejects the mismatched pairing when parsing and CMSAuthenticatedDataParser cross-checks the two fields once authAttrs is read. This is a variant of CVE-2026-59642, which bound the content to the MAC for messages that legitimately carry authAttrs, and which does not address this case. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpkix-fips 1.0.13 (1.0.X series), 2.0.13 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.13 (2.1.X series), and bcutil-fips 2.0.8 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.8 (2.1.X series).

items.title: PKIXCertPathReviewer does not apply X.509 name constraints to the target certificate
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, neither copy of PKIXCertPathReviewer - org.bouncycastle.pkix.jcajce.PKIXCertPathReviewer nor the legacy org.bouncycastle.x509.PKIXCertPathReviewer - applied X.509 name constraints to the end-entity certificate. checkNameConstraints walked the path with a loop bound of index greater than zero, which is the bound the CA-only steps require, but index zero is the target certificate under the standard CertPath ordering, so the permitted and excluded subtree checks of RFC 5280 sec. 6.1.3 (b) and (c) never ran against the leaf's subject DN or its subjectAltName. items.title: CMS key-transport recipient key-size validation never runs for RFC 9709 HKDF-derived keys
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the opt-in key-size validation on CMS key-transport recipients, org.bouncycastle.cms.jcajce.JceKeyTransRecipient.setKeySizeValidation(true), never ran for a message using RFC 9709 content-encryption key derivation (id-alg-cek-hkdf-sha256). The branch that should have selected the actual content-encryption algorithm carried in the key derivation AlgorithmIdentifier's parameters compared the encrypted-key byte array against the id-alg-cek-hkdf-sha256 object identifier, a comparison between a byte array and an ASN1ObjectIdentifier that is false for every possible input, so the check fell through to a key-size lookup on the outer wrapper OID. That OID identifies a key-derivation construction rather than a cipher and has no registered key size, so the size comparison was skipped entirely. A key-transport EnvelopedData or AuthEnvelopedData whose transported, HKDF-derived content-encryption key did not match the key size of the advertised content-encryption algorithm was therefore accepted even with validation explicitly enabled, silently defeating the only mechanism the API offers for enforcing recovered key size. The recipient now dispatches on the content-encryption AlgorithmIdentifier's algorithm OID, so validation checks the recovered key against the inner content-encryption algorithm. Messages with a matching key size, non-HKDF messages, and recipients that do not enable validation are unaffected. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpkix-fips 2.0.13 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.13 (2.1.X series).

items.title: OpenPGP message truncation not reported, bypassing the SEIPDv1 integrity check
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, a truncated OpenPGP encrypted message was accepted with no error reported, and on the SEIPD version 1 path with no integrity check performed at all. RFC 9580 sec. 13.7 permits an implementation to release the cleartext of the fully authenticated chunks when streaming but requires it to indicate a clear error as soon as the truncation is detected, and to report suspect integrity when it discovers malleable ciphertext. The truncation was detected and then discarded: when a message is truncated but the length field of the enclosing packet is left unchanged, BCPGInputStream.PartialInputStream raises an EOFException for the missing ciphertext, and BCPGInputStream.nextPacketTag() reports an EOFException as a clean end of message, so the packet stream above it stopped as though no packets remained. On the AEAD path (SEIPD version 2 and the version 5 AEAD packet), when the literal data packet ended on an AEAD chunk boundary and the consumer read in increments smaller than one chunk, the look-ahead for the packet after the literal triggered the truncated chunk read, so BcAEADUtil and JceAEADUtil never reached the trailing message tag of sec. 5.13.2 that authenticates the total plaintext length; the caller received the plaintext of the fully authenticated chunks, every packet following the literal was silently dropped, and no exception was raised, so a signed and encrypted message read back as a well-formed unsigned one. Every byte released on that path remained individually authenticated, making this a missing truncation error rather than a forgery, and it is a residual of CVE-2026-12817, which closed the same outcome for an attacker who corrects the outer packet length. On the SEIPD version 1 path the consequence was more serious: IntegrityProtectedInputStream verifies the modification detection code from close(), and reached close() only by closing itself when a read of it returned -1, which a truncated message never produces, so PGPEncryptedData.verify() never ran and the recipient was handed CFB-decrypted plaintext on which no integrity check of any kind had been performed. Measured on a message truncated into that shape, 136 distinct single-byte modifications of the ciphertext produced accepted, altered plaintext with no exception raised. Reachability is a property of the message rather than of attacker-supplied input: the AEAD shape held for 3 of 131 consecutive payload lengths measured, and the SEIPD version 1 shape for one payload length in sixteen, at a truncation offset that did not move with the payload length. The low-level API is unaffected, a caller that invokes PGPEncryptedData.verify() directly getting the check regardless, as are consumers reading in increments of a whole AEAD chunk or more. The AEAD decryption streams now re-throw such an EOFException as a plain IOException, which nextPacketTag() does not launder; OpenPGPMessageInputStream.close() now closes its layer's integrity-protected stream itself rather than relying on that stream having seen the end of its data; and IntegrityProtectedInputStream.close() was made idempotent, as java.io.Closeable requires, which that depends on, since the stream is genuinely closed twice on the ordinary path and PGPEncryptedData.verify() consumes the digest state behind it and cannot be run a second time. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, on the AEAD route only, as that edition does not ship the high-level OpenPGP API the SEIPDv1 route runs through. It also affects Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpg-fips 1.0.14 (1.0.X series), 2.0.14.1 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.14 (2.1.X series), on the AEAD route only, as those editions do not ship the high-level OpenPGP API.

items.title: Latest Compatibility Definition Document (CDD)

items.title: PocsuitePocsuite 是由知道创宇安全研究团队打造的一款开源的远程漏洞测试框架。它是知道创宇安全研究团队发展的基石，是团队发展至今一直维护的一个项目，保障了我们的 Web安全研究能力的领先。

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本条信息来自知道创宇 / Seebug，内容为其开源项目 Pocsuite 的介绍页，而非一份描述具体漏洞的安全公告。Pocsuite 被定位为一款由知道创宇安全研究团队打造并长期维护的开源远程漏洞测试框架，用于在取得授权的前提下对目标系统进行漏洞验证（PoC / Exp 验证）、批量资产排查与安全研究支撑。该框架通常支持用户自定义或用社区共享的验证脚本，对单个目标或批量目标发起远程检测，并把结果结构化输出，便于安全团队在漏洞披露后快速确认资产是否受影响、评估风险面并支撑后续的修复优先级排序。需要特别说明的是：本次输入未提供任何具体的漏洞编号（CVE）、受影响组件与版本、漏洞成因、攻击触发条件以及实际危害描述，也未包含任何厂商修复方案、补丁或缓解措施；给出的严重性为空（unknown），参考链接也仅有项目主页。因此本条内容更适合被理解为“安全工具/项目背景信息”，用于理解防守方在漏洞管理流程中可能遇到或使用的验证工具类型，而不能据此判断某个产品或系统当前存在可利用漏洞。由于该框架本身具备远程漏洞验证能力，属于典型的双用途安全工具：在授权测试、红队评估、应急响应验证和资产自查场景中能提升效率，但若被未授权使用，则可能被用于对第三方资产进行探测与验证，防守方在资产暴露面治理和日志监测中应对此类工具特征保持关注。整体而言，本条信息不构成可直接处置的漏洞情报。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本条并非漏洞公告，而是开源远程漏洞测试框架 Pocsuite 的项目介绍，不含 CVE、受影响版本或利用细节。其价值在于帮助防守方了解该类 PoC 验证工具的能力边界与双用途属性，用于授权自查与资产排查，不能据此判定任何系统当前存在漏洞。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 1) 将该条目视为工具背景信息，不要据此生成漏洞工单或提升修复优先级；2) 如需使用 Pocsuite 类框架，仅在获得明确书面授权的资产范围内执行验证，避免触碰第三方系统；3) 对内部资产开展自查时，可借助此类框架核验已披露 CVE 的修复效果，并记录验证过程以备审计；4) 关注知道创宇 / Seebug 官方渠道，若后续发布正式漏洞公告（含 CVE、受影响版本与修复版本）再行评估与升级；5) 在边界与主机侧对异常的批量漏洞探测行为保持监控与告警，识别未授权扫描迹象。

items.title: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in the ait.core.server telemetry and command broker (ait-server) in NASA-AMMOS AIT-Core through 3.1.1 allows an unauthentic...
items.summary: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in the ait.core.server telemetry and command broker (ait-server) in NASA-AMMOS AIT-Core through 3.1.1 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to the ZeroMQ message bus to inject spacecraft command data, exfiltrate command and telemetry traffic, inject forged telemetry, or disrupt the command and telemetry bus. The ait-server ZeroMQ broker binds its XSUB and XPUB sockets to all network interfaces by default without authentication or transport security. An attacker able to reach TCP port 5559 can publish messages onto internal topics, including the __commands__ command topic. With the shipped default configuration, command messages are forwarded through command_stream and emitted on the command-uplink UDP path. An attacker able to reach TCP port 5560 can subscribe to command and telemetry traffic on the ground bus. AIT-Core 3.1.2 changes the default ZeroMQ bind addresses to loopback.

items.summary: The The Beaver Builder Page Builder – Drag and Drop Website Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary shortcode execution in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.0.5. This is due to the software allowing users to execute an action that does not properly validate a value before running do_shortcode. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shortcodes. Exploitation requires the target site to have a Beaver Builder page containing the Sidebar module populated with a widget that displays attacker-controllable text, such as the core Recent Comments widget, with comment moderation disabled or the attacker's comment approved.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the opt-in key-size validation on CMS key-transport...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the opt-in key-size validation on CMS key-transport recipients, org.bouncycastle.cms.jcajce.JceKeyTransRecipient.setKeySizeValidation(true), never ran for a message using RFC 9709 content-encryption key derivation (id-alg-cek-hkdf-sha256). That OID identifies a key-derivation construction rather than a cipher and has no registered key size, so the size comparison was skipped entirely. Messages with a matching key size, non-HKDF messages, and recipients that do not enable validation are unaffected. items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, validation of an MLS (RFC 9420) external commit's proposal...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, validation of an MLS (RFC 9420) external commit's proposal list, org.bouncycastle.mls.protocol.Group.validateExternalCachedProposals, counted the proposals by type and bounded the removed leaf index but never established that the removed leaf had anything to do with the joiner. RFC 9420 sec. 12.2 permits at most one Remove proposal in an external commit, with which the joiner removes an old version of themselves, and requires that where one is present the LeafNode in the commit's path field meet the criteria it would have to meet in an Update for the removed leaf, in particular that its credential present identifiers acceptable for the removed participant. The ordinary proposal-list validator's self-remove rule is deliberately not applied on this path, because a resync commit legitimately removes a leaf the joiner owns, but nothing was put in its place. Any party holding the group's public GroupInfo, which is precisely what an external joiner is meant to be given, could therefore commit a Remove naming any member's LeafIndex and have every member apply it, evicting that member and taking over their slot in the ratchet tree. The credential check that should have prevented this existed only in the gRPC interop harness and so protected no other caller of the public Group.externalJoin and Group.handle API. An external commit carrying a Remove is now accepted only when the removed leaf's credential is identical to the one in the joiner's own new leaf, on both the sending and the receiving side.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the streaming CMS AuthenticatedData parser accepted a...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the streaming CMS AuthenticatedData parser accepted a message whose digestAlgorithm and authAttrs fields disagreed about whether authenticated attributes were present. RFC 5652 sec. 9.1 pairs the two, requiring that authAttrs be present whenever digestAlgorithm is, and sec. 9.2 makes the MAC cover the DER encoding of authAttrs when they are present and the eContent OCTET STRING directly when they are not. CMSAuthenticatedDataParser has to choose between those two in its constructor, before it can reach authAttrs, which comes later in the SEQUENCE, so it chose on digestAlgorithm alone: for a message with digestAlgorithm absent but authAttrs present it verified the content MAC and then returned the attributes through getAuthAttrs() as though they had been authenticated, when the MAC had never covered them. An attacker able to modify a message in transit could insert an authenticated attribute, such as an RFC 2634 ESSSecurityLabel, into an otherwise valid message while holding neither the key-encryption key nor the content-MAC key, and an application taking an authorization, routing or labelling decision from those attributes would act on attacker-chosen values. The content itself remained MAC-bound. asn1.cms.AuthenticatedData now rejects the mismatched pairing when parsing and CMSAuthenticatedDataParser cross-checks the two fields once authAttrs is read. This is a variant of CVE-2026-59642, which bound the content to the MAC for messages that legitimately carry authAttrs, and which does not address this case. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpkix-fips 1.0.13 (1.0.X series), 2.0.13 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.13 (2.1.X series), and bcutil-fips 2.0.8 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.8 (2.1.X series).

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, the one-shot native packet ciphers for AES-CBC, CCM...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, the one-shot native packet ciphers for AES-CBC, CCM, CFB, CTR, GCM and GCM-SIV released the caller's key, IV and additional authenticated data arrays with JNI's ReleaseByteArrayElements in mode 0, which commits the native copy back into the Java array. Those arrays are read-only to the native code, and on a JVM that returns a copy rather than a pin the copy still holds the input bytes as they were read. The output buffer is taken through a separate critical region and committed first, so where an application passed the same Java array as both an input and the destination - encrypting in place over KeyParameter.getKey(), for example - the later mode-0 release of the key wrote the unchanged key bytes over the ciphertext that had just been produced. The call still returned the correct output length, so an application encrypting in place over its own key array was handed the raw AES key where it expected ciphertext, with nothing in the API to indicate it, and would transmit or store the key in place of the message. The read-only input arrays are now released with JNI_ABORT, freeing the native copy without copying it back, and mode 0 is reserved for arrays the native code wrote. The pure-Java packet ciphers and the streaming native modes are not affected. Bouncy Castle for Java (bcprov) is not affected, as it ships no native implementations.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, a truncated OpenPGP encrypted message was accepted with no...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, a truncated OpenPGP encrypted message was accepted with no error reported, and on the SEIPD version 1 path with no integrity check performed at all. RFC 9580 sec. 13.7 permits an implementation to release the cleartext of the fully authenticated chunks when streaming but requires it to indicate a clear error as soon as the truncation is detected, and to report suspect integrity when it discovers malleable ciphertext. The truncation was detected and then discarded: when a message is truncated but the length field of the enclosing packet is left unchanged, BCPGInputStream.PartialInputStream raises an EOFException for the missing ciphertext, and BCPGInputStream.nextPacketTag() reports an EOFException as a clean end of message, so the packet stream above it stopped as though no packets remained. On the AEAD path (SEIPD version 2 and the version 5 AEAD packet), when the literal data packet ended on an AEAD chunk boundary and the consumer read in increments smaller than one chunk, the look-ahead for the packet after the literal triggered the truncated chunk read, so BcAEADUtil and JceAEADUtil never reached the trailing message tag of sec. 5.13.2 that authenticates the total plaintext length; the caller received the plaintext of the fully authenticated chunks, every packet following the literal was silently dropped, and no exception was raised, so a signed and encrypted message read back as a well-formed unsigned one. Every byte released on that path remained individually authenticated, making this a missing truncation error rather than a forgery, and it is a residual of CVE-2026-12817, which closed the same outcome for an attacker who corrects the outer packet length. On the SEIPD version 1 path the consequence was more serious: IntegrityProtectedInputStream verifies the modification detection code from close(), and reached close() only by closing itself when a read of it returned -1, which a truncated message never produces, so PGPEncryptedData.verify() never ran and the recipient was handed CFB-decrypted plaintext on which no integrity check of any kind had been performed. Measured on a message truncated into that shape, 136 distinct single-byte modifications of the ciphertext produced accepted, altered plaintext with no exception raised. Reachability is a property of the message rather than of attacker-supplied input: the AEAD shape held for 3 of 131 consecutive payload lengths measured, and the SEIPD version 1 shape for one payload length in sixteen, at a truncation offset that did not move with the payload length. The low-level API is unaffected, a caller that invokes PGPEncryptedData.verify() directly getting the check regardless, as are consumers reading in increments of a whole AEAD chunk or more. The AEAD decryption streams now re-throw such an EOFException as a plain IOException, which nextPacketTag() does not launder; OpenPGPMessageInputStream.close() now closes its layer's integrity-protected stream itself rather than relying on that stream having seen the end of its data; and IntegrityProtectedInputStream.close() was made idempotent, as java.io.Closeable requires, which that depends on, since the stream is genuinely closed twice on the ordinary path and PGPEncryptedData.verify() consumes the digest state behind it and cannot be run a second time. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, on the AEAD route only, as that edition does not ship the high-level OpenPGP API the SEIPDv1 route runs through. items.title: probe-image-size: Quadratic-time Denial of Service in the SVG Parser
items.summary:
## Overview

`probe-image-size` scans the SVG header with a searching regular expression, `/<[-_.:a-zA-Z0-9][^>]*>/`. On input that contains many `<` characters but no `>`, the engine restarts the `[^>]*` scan at every `<` position and runs to end of input each time, giving quadratic time complexity.

Both the synchronous and the streaming parser are affected.

## Impact

Every entry point that reaches the SVG parser is affected: `probe.sync()`, `probe(stream)` and `probe(url)`. The URL form is the most exposed one — the input is fetched from a remote host, so an attacker only needs to supply a link.

Processing a crafted buffer blocks the Node.js event loop at 100% CPU for the whole duration. In production environments such as upload validators, image proxies or link unfurl services, a small number of concurrent requests is enough to deny service.

## Root Cause Analysis

Two independent problems.

1. **Absence of input size cap in the sync path.** `lib/parse_sync/svg.js` copied the entire buffer into a string and matched against it. There was no size limit at all, so cost scaled with the size of the attacker-supplied buffer.

2. **Repeated rescanning in the stream path.** `lib/parse_stream/svg.js` did cap accumulated data at 64 KB, but called `parseSvg(str)` on the whole accumulated string on *every* chunk, giving `O(chunks × N²)`. The cap does not help here: the more chunks the input is split into, the more times the quadratic scan is repeated.

   Chunk size is influenced by the sender. `highWaterMark` (16 KB) is a buffering threshold, not a lower bound — a socket read returns whatever has arrived. A server that writes one byte at a time produces one-byte chunks; this was confirmed against the real `needle` pipeline with default options.

The original report identified (1) only, and stated that the 64 KB cap mitigates the streaming path. It does not.

## Proof of Concept (PoC)

Synchronous:

```js
const probe = require('probe-image-size')

// ~200 KB of '<a' — contains '<' but never '>'
probe.sync(Buffer.from('<a'.repeat(100000), 'latin1'))
```

Streaming — the same payload split into chunks, slower per byte than the synchronous form:

```js
const { Readable } = require('stream')
const probe = require('probe-image-size')

const payload = Buffer.from('<a'.repeat(32768), 'latin1')
const chunks = []
for (let i = 0; i < payload.length; i += 4096) chunks.push(payload.subarray(i, i + 4096))

await probe(Readable.from(chunks))
```

Measurements on the maintainer's machine:

| path | input | time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `probe.sync()` | 25 KB | 0.9 s |
| `probe.sync()` | 50 KB | 5.5 s |
| `probe.sync()` | 100 KB | 18 s |
| `probe.sync()` | 200 KB | 54 s |
| `probe(stream)` | 64 KB, 1 chunk | 1.6 s |
| `probe(stream)` | 64 KB, 4 chunks | 2.9 s |
| `probe(stream)` | 64 KB, 16 chunks | 9.6 s |

items.title: @fastify/busboy vulnerable to Denial of Service via prototype-named multipart part header
items.summary:
### Impact

Versions of `@fastify/busboy` from 1.0.0 and prior to 3.2.1 are vulnerable to a Denial of Service. The multipart header parser stores part-header names on a plain JavaScript object, so a part header named `__proto__` or `constructor` resolves to an inherited value that is not an array, and the parser throws `TypeError: this.header[h].push is not a function`. Through the documented `req.pipe(busboy)` integration this surfaces as an `error` event, while direct `write()`/`end()` usage throws synchronously and can terminate the Node.js process if uncaught. The parser runs before application middleware, so any unauthenticated client that can submit multipart/form-data is affected.

### Patches

Fixed in version 3.2.1.

### Workarounds

Attach an `error` listener to the Busboy stream so the parser failure is handled rather than crashing the process, and wrap direct `write()`/`end()` calls in a try/catch. Upgrading to 3.2.1 removes the failure entirely.

items.title: @fastify/busboy vulnerable to Denial of Service via oversized multipart boundary
items.summary:
### Impact

Versions of `@fastify/busboy` from 3.1.0 and prior to 3.2.1 are vulnerable to a Denial of Service. The vendored streaming multipart search stores its default skip distance in a `Uint8Array(256)`. A multipart boundary of exactly 252 bytes makes the search needle 256 bytes, and the table entry wraps to zero, so a crafted request keeps the search in a CPU-bound loop and stalls the Node.js event loop. An unauthenticated client can trigger this with a single small request. Applications that use `@fastify/busboy` to parse multipart/form-data, directly or through `@fastify/multipart`, are affected.

### Patches

Fixed in version 3.2.1.

### Workarounds

Validate the multipart boundary before parsing and reject any boundary longer than the RFC 2046 limit of 70 characters (for example at a reverse proxy or in an onRequest hook). Upgrading to 3.2.1 removes the issue.

items.title: Wasmtime: Preemption and traps during bulk operations enable breaking internal VM state
items.summary:
### Impact

Wasmtime's implementation of bulk-data-transfer WebAssembly instructions, such as `memory.copy`, contains a vulnerability when a preemption via epochs or fuel is combined with altering the store's state or cancelling a computation. To prevent these operations from taking too long Wasmtime injects fuel/epoch checks during these operations, but this enables embedders, and possible WebAssembly, to witness intermediate state in the middle of the operation. Examples of this include:

* When a non-nullable WebAssembly table is grown the new elements initially start as null and are filled in as part of a loop with preemption checks. If this computation is then cancelled this left the table in a grown-but-uninitialized state where subsequent usage via WebAssembly could possibly segfault. Loads from this table are assumed to not be null due to its type, but the runtime implementation was exposed through this cancellation at a preemption point.
* Embedders could mutate the store during an epoch callback, such as growing a WebAssembly linear memory. During a bulk `memory.copy` operation, however, the pointers being copied to/from weren't recomputed between preemption points. This meant that if the linear memory moved its base address it could be possible to have a preemption, the embedder manually grows memory, and then on resumption the copy operation uses invalid pointers.
* Embedders could execute a GC during epoch callbacks. GC operations such as `array.copy`, like `memory.copy` above, maintained raw pointers internally in the operation which were not updated after the preemption point. This could lead to corruption of the GC heap.

All of these situations are examples of embedder-driven mutations of the `Store` or embedder-induced resumption of a `Store` after a computation was cancelled. These operations expose the internal state of these WebAssembly operations which is semantically incorrect and additionally can cause segfaults for example. Exposing these bugs, however, requires explicit patterns to be present in the embedding itself such as using `Store::epoch_deadline_callback` and mutating wasm options. Another example is to cancel one invocation (possibly in a `table.grow`) and then execute more wasm afterwards within the same store. Embeddings not using `Store::epoch_deadline_callback` or executing code after timeouts/fuel are not affected by this issue.

### Patches

This issue is fixed in Wasmtime 46.0.2 and 47.0.3. In these versions Wasmtime reverts back to Wasmtime 45-and-earlier behavior for these operations to check fuel once before the operation and then not during the operation. This means that a very large `memory.copy` does not have preemption points in the middle of the operation any more, for example.

### Workarounds

Embedders using `Store::epoch_deadline_callback` are safe if they only access the `T` in `Store<T>`. Embedders that do not continue using a store after a timeout or epoch deadline are also unaffected. Embedders which explicitly mutate the store in an epoch callback, or resume wasm after trapping have no workaround however. The embedding needs to be updated to account for this issue.

items.title: aws-smithy-json: Uncontrolled recursion in the aws-smithy-json unknown-key skip path allows unauthenticated remote denial of service in smithy-rs generated servers
items.summary:
### Summary
Smithy-RS is a Rust code generation and runtime framework that generates HTTP clients and servers from Smithy interface definitions, powering the AWS SDK for Rust and custom service implementations. An issue exists which allows uncontrolled recursion in the unknown-key skip path of the Amazon aws-smithy-json runtime crate in versions 0.62.6 and earlier.

### Impact
Uncontrolled recursion in the unknown-key skip path of the aws-smithy-json runtime crate before 0.62.7, which the smithy-rs code generator invokes from every generated struct deserializer, might allow remote unauthenticated users to cause a denial of service (process abort via stack exhaustion) via a single small HTTP request containing deeply nested JSON to a smithy-rs generated server.

Impacted versions: aws-smithy-json <= 0.62.6

### Patches
This issue has been addressed in aws-smithy-json version 0.62.7. We recommend upgrading to the latest version and ensuring any forked or derivative code is patched to incorporate the new fixes.

### Workarounds
There are no workarounds besides updating to the patched version.

### References

items.title: figlet is vulnerable to denial of service via unbounded loop when whitespaceBreak is used with a small width
items.summary:
### Impact
A denial-of-service (infinite loop) can occur in `text()` / `textSync()` when
**both**:
- `whitespaceBreak: true` is set, **and**
- `width` is set smaller than the rendered width of a single FIGlet character.
Under these conditions `breakWord()` could never find a valid break point, so the
word-wrapping loop in `generateFigTextLines()` never terminated. This pins a CPU
core and grows memory without bound, blocking the Node.js event loop.

### Severity
Low or Medium. Triggering requires a non-default configuration (`whitespaceBreak: true`) and
an attacker-controlled `width` value reaching `text()`/`textSync()`. This library is typically
used with fixed options, where this is not
reachable. Applications that pass an untrusted `width` together with
`whitespaceBreak` on a request path are affected.

### Patches
Fixed in **figlet 1.11.3**. `breakWord()` now always makes forward progress
(emitting an over-wide character on its own line), and FIGlet header parsing now
rejects invalid values (e.g. zero/negative height).

### Workarounds
Do not expose `width` to untrusted input, or leave `whitespaceBreak` disabled
(the default), or upgrade to 1.11.3.

items.title: geopy: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in geopy.Point
items.summary:
### Impact

`geopy.Point` and `Point.from_string()` may take excessive CPU time when parsing long, malformed coordinate strings due to inefficient regular-expression behavior. The numeric Point constructor is not affected.

Geocoders' `reverse` methods called with string inputs exercise the vulnerable path.

Applications are affected when they pass attacker-controlled strings to these APIs without an appropriate length limit. Repeated requests may cause denial of service.

### Patches

Fixed in geopy **2.5.0** by rejecting overly long (over 256 characters) coordinate strings before parsing.

### Workarounds

Limit coordinate strings to a reasonable maximum length, such as 256 characters, before passing them to geopy.

items.title: Aletheia: Permission-Minimality Testing for Coding-Agent Rules
items.summary: Repository instruction files guide coding agents, but also expose them to prompt injection. Malicious rules can request credential access or data transfer while the agent produces a correct patch. We present Aletheia, a framework for permission-minimality testing. Aletheia translates requested authority into a typed language and synthesizes executable sandbox configurations. It runs the unchanged rule and task under full permissions and independent restrictions that remove one permission at a time. Passing independent functional tests under strictly reduced authority provides a dispensability witness, which Aletheia interprets against task context to diagnose suspicious requests. We formalize synthesis and the conditions connecting witnesses to enforced restrictions. On a shared refactoring task, Aletheia executes and detects all 314 AIShellJack attack inputs, with no alarms on five benign templates. Among 80 manually verified benign GHAgentFiles rules, it raises three false positives (3.75%).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注编码智能体（coding agent）所依赖的「仓库指令文件」（如 AGENTS.md、copilot-instructions 一类指导性规则）带来的安全风险：这些文件本意是引导智能体正确完成开发任务，但也构成一条 prompt injection 通道。攻击者可以在规则中植入恶意条目，要求智能体访问凭据、外传数据或扩权，而智能体仍然能产出一个表面上「正确」的补丁，使传统以功能正确性为判据的测试完全无法察觉异常。作者提出 Aletheia 框架，用于对编码智能体规则做「权限最小性测试」（permission-minimality testing）。核心思路是：把规则所请求的权限翻译成一种带类型的中间语言，据此自动合成可执行的沙箱配置；随后在两种条件下运行同一条未经修改的规则与任务——一次在完整权限下，一次在一组互相独立、每次只削减单一权限的约束下——如果削减权限后规则仍能通过独立的功能测试，就得到该权限「可被弃用」的见证（dispensability witness）。Aletheia 将该见证与任务上下文结合解读，从而判定某个权限请求是否可疑（即属于过度索取）。论文形式化了沙箱配置合成过程，以及见证与实际生效限制之间的关联条件，使诊断结论具备可验证的语义基础。实验方面：在一个共享的重构任务上，Aletheia 执行并检测出 AIShellJack 全部 314 条攻击输入，同时对 5 个良性模板零告警；在 80 条经人工核验为良性的 GHAgentFiles 规则上仅产生 3 个误报（3.75%）。这表明权限最小性可以作为一条独立于语义分析、以「实际行为」为准绳的检测维度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 编码智能体正在获得 shell、文件与网络权限，仓库内的指令文件因此成为新的注入面。该工作给出可执行的权限最小性验证思路，能在补丁功能正常的前提下暴露过度授权，适合纳入 Agent 安全评估与 CI 流程。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接迁移到使用 AGENTS.md / 仓库级指令的编码助手平台、CI 流水线中的 GHAgentFiles 类规则审核，以及任何需要判定工具调用权限是否最小化的 LLM Agent 沙箱；也可作为「同一任务、多档权限」差分测试的通用范式。
detection_signals_zh: 仓库指令文件中出现访问凭据、环境变量、SSH/AWS 密钥或外部上传地址的描述
智能体在完成功能任务之外发起额外网络请求或文件读取
在削减某一权限后，同一规则与任务仍能通过全部功能测试（该权限可弃用的证据）
同一规则在全权限与最小权限下的行为差异，或规则中显式声明通配权限、非必要写权限
defense_advice_zh: 对编码智能体的仓库指令文件建立评审与版本管理，将其视同可执行配置而非文档
为常见开发任务维护独立的功能测试集，用于在受约束权限下验证规则是否仍可完成工作
默认以最小权限沙箱运行智能体，按需逐项放权，并对每次放权记录理由
对智能体的进程执行、文件与网络出站行为做日志留存与告警，重点关注与任务无关的访问
在合并指令文件变更前引入自动化权限最小性检查，降低误报带来的评审噪音（该工作误报率约 3.75%）

items.title: The Achilles' Heel of Partial Reconfiguration: Optical Side-Channel Leakage on the 7-Series ICAP
items.summary: Major FPGA manufacturers have incorporated bitstream encryption to protect sensitive configuration data. However, for the most widely used FPGA families, multiple attacks against unpatchable protection schemes hard-wired into the devices can bypass or fully break them, making patchable schemes desirable. In this work, we present a proof-of-concept implementation of an AMD-proposed asymmetric key encryption scheme for bitstream protection for 7-Series FPGAs, using partial reconfiguration from the Programmable Logic. We analyze the security implications and hardware overhead of this implementation. We then propose and demonstrate an optical side-channel attack that is able to recover plain-text configuration data during the dynamic reconfiguration process. This attack leverages Photon Emission Microscopy and Electro-Optical Probing to first locate and then contactlessly extract the plain-text data from the ICAP interface, which internally connects the Programmable Logic with the configuration logic. We located the ICAP buses in an AMD XC7A200T device and show that the data on it can be extracted with Electro-Optical Probing. We claim that even advanced encryption schemes utilizing Partial Reconfiguration and custom cryptographic engines are vulnerable to optical attacks, as reconfiguration is only possible via hard-wired, vulnerable configuration interfaces.

llm_summary.summary_zh: FPGA 厂商普遍在比特流中引入加密以保护敏感的配置数据,但主流器件中一些保护方案是硬连线、不可修补的,已被多项研究绕过或完全攻破,因此业界转向可升级、可修补的加密方案。本文针对 7 系列 FPGA,首先实现了 AMD 提出的一种用于比特流保护的非对称密钥加密方案的概念验证:该方案从可编程逻辑(PL)侧发起部分重配置来解密与加载配置数据。作者随后从两个角度对该实现进行评估,一是其安全含义,二是所需的硬件开销。在此基础上,论文提出并实验演示了一种光学侧信道攻击,可在器件动态重配置的过程中恢复明文配置数据。攻击流程利用光子发射显微镜(PEM)与电光探测(EO Probing),先在芯片上定位 ICAP 接口,再以非接触方式从该接口提取明文数据。ICAP 是芯片内部连接可编程逻辑与配置逻辑的关键通路,作者在 AMD XC7A200T 器件上成功定位了其总线,并证明能够通过电光探测读取其上的数据。论文的核心论点是:只要重配置必须经过硬连线且本身存在弱点的配置接口,那么即便采用部分重配置与自定义密码引擎的高级加密方案,也依然会暴露在光学侧信道之下,单纯的加密并不能覆盖这一物理层面的攻击面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 使用 7 系列等 FPGA 的产品设计方需要认识到:比特流加密并不等于安全,ICAP 等内部配置接口是可被光学探测的物理侧信道,存在物理接触能力的攻击者仍可提取明文配置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 FPGA 知识产权保护、密钥与比特流保密设计,涉及国防、航天、工业控制、通信设备中依赖部分重配置与自定义密码引擎的场景;该方法论可迁移到其他具有内部配置/数据总线的 SoC 与可重配置器件。
detection_signals_zh: 机箱开启、去封装(decap)或芯片表面处理的物理篡改痕迹
实验室级光学探测设备引入的环境与电磁扰动
异常或非预期的部分重配置请求、ICAP 访问时序异常
调试/配置端口(如 JTAG)在非维护窗口被访问
设备加电后密钥或配置数据完整性校验失败
defense_advice_zh: 对需要长期密钥保护的器件优先采用不可逆或带主动清零机制的密钥存储(如电池供电的易失密钥 RAM)
在威胁模型中显式纳入具备物理访问与光学探测能力的对手,而非仅考虑远程攻击
部署物理防拆与入侵检测,限制非授权环境下的部分重配置操作
对 ICAP/JTAG 等配置接口访问进行监控与审计,并在设计阶段评估总线混淆、抗侧信道布局等措施
对采用的加密与重配置方案做独立安全评估,跟踪厂商的补丁与器件迁移建议
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: A weakness has been identified in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /user/ticket of the component Ticket ...
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /user/ticket of the component Ticket Attachment Upload. This manipulation causes cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞披露自 NVD,影响 Omega Solution 出品的 CoinEx Crypto 2025 产品。问题位于 /user/ticket 路径所对应的工单(Ticket)功能中的“工单附件上传”(Ticket Attachment Upload)组件,受影响的具体函数或代码逻辑尚未公开,属于 CWE-79 类型的跨站脚本(XSS)缺陷:应用对用户可控输入(推测为附件文件名、描述或相关元数据)未做充分的输出编码或过滤,导致攻击者可注入并让脚本在受害者浏览器上下文中执行。根据 CVSS 3.1 向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N,该漏洞可远程利用,攻击者无需高权限(需已具备低权限账户),但必须诱使受害者进行交互(如点击特制链接或上传页面),作用范围局限于原组件,机密性与可用性均无影响,仅完整性受到轻微影响,因此官方评分为 3.5,属低危级别。NVD 描述指出相关利用方式已向公众公开,理论上可被用于攻击。值得注意的是,该产品的官方网站已不存在,可能已停止维护或被新产品替代;披露方在公开前曾提前联系厂商,但厂商未作任何回应,说明短期内不会有官方修复版本。结合低评分、需用户交互、需低权限前置条件以及产品疑似退役等因素,该漏洞的实际风险有限,但对于仍在生产环境中运行该系统的组织而言,由于缺乏厂商支持,修复只能依靠自行处置或下线替换。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 厂商网站已失效、披露后厂商零回应,意味着不会有官方补丁;任何仍在运行的实例将长期处于“无支持、不可修补”状态,只能靠下线、网络隔离或自建 WAF/输入过滤缓解。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可在受害者浏览器中执行脚本,可能导致会话凭证窃取、页面篡改或钓鱼跳转,完整性受轻微影响;机密性与可用性不受影响,且需低权限账户并诱使受害者交互,整体危害有限。

items.title: A security flaw has been discovered in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. Affected is an unknown function of the file /ticket/customer of the component Support Ticket API. The m...
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. Affected is an unknown function of the file /ticket/customer of the component Support Ticket API. The manipulation of the argument status/page/count results in information disclosure. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响 Omega Solution 公司的 CoinEx Crypto 2025 产品。问题出在“支持工单 API”（Support Ticket API）组件中 /ticket/customer 这一接口的未知功能函数上：当攻击者对 status、page、count 等请求参数进行操纵（例如篡改分页大小或状态过滤条件）时，服务端未能正确实施授权与查询范围限制，导致越权信息泄露。攻击者可远程发起请求，无需受害者交互（UI:N），但需要具备一定的低权限身份（PR:L）、且攻击复杂度低（AC:L），CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 4.3，属于中等偏低危；向量显示仅影响机密性（C:L），对完整性和可用性无影响（I:N/A:N），作用域不变（S:U）。NVD 描述明确指出该利用方式已被公开发布，理论上可被用于攻击，但本次输入未将该 CVE 列入 CISA KEV，也没有“已在野利用”的标记，因此不应推断其已被实际利用。另一个关键背景是：该产品的官方网站已不存在，厂商很可能已经停产或被替代产品取代；披露方在早期已联系厂商，但厂商完全未作任何回应，意味着短期内不会有官方补丁或安全公告。对于仍在使用该系统的组织，这属于典型的“厂商停止维护 + 公开利用代码”组合风险，需要自行通过隔离、访问控制与接口加固来降低暴露面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个厂商已停止维护、官网下架且不回应的产品漏洞，官方补丁基本无望，而利用细节已公开，任何仍暴露该工单接口的实例都可能被低权限用户越权读取客户工单数据，只能靠自身加固来兜底。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 低权限远程攻击者可通过操纵 status/page/count 参数越权访问支持工单接口，读取本不应可见的客户工单及关联信息，造成客户资料与业务数据泄露；机密性受损程度有限，但不影响系统完整性与可用性。由于厂商不提供修复，风险长期存在。

items.title: A vulnerability was identified in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. This impacts an unknown function of the file /customer-currency/ of the component Customer Information API. ...
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. This impacts an unknown function of the file /customer-currency/ of the component Customer Information API. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to authorization bypass. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
CVE-2026-105097 是一枚被分配在 Omega Solution 旗下产品 CoinEx Crypto 2025 中的授权绕过（Authorization Bypass）漏洞。根据 NVD 描述，问题位于组件 Customer Information API 的 /customer-currency/ 接口所对应的未知功能函数中。攻击者通过操纵请求参数 ID 的取值，即可绕过系统原有的权限校验逻辑，访问本不属于其权限范围的客户币种/客户信息数据。由于该接口可通过网络远程触达，且攻击者只需具备低权限账户（CVSS 3.1 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N），因此利用门槛较低，无需用户交互即可完成。

该漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 4.3，属于中危等级，其影响主要集中在机密性（C:L），对完整性与可用性无直接影响，实质上是典型的对象级授权缺失（IDOR 类）问题，攻击者通常通过枚举或替换 ID 参数来横向读取其他客户的敏感数据。NVD 描述明确指出，该漏洞的利用代码（exploit）已公开可得，存在被滥用的可能；但需强调，当前元数据中未将其列入 CISA KEV，也未标记为已在野利用，因此不应推断该漏洞已被实际攻击者大规模使用。

值得注意的是，该产品的官方网站已不再可访问，推测产品可能已停止维护或被替换；厂商在披露前被提前联系，但未作任何回应。这意味着官方修复补丁大概率不会发布，受影响方无法依赖厂商渠道获得修复，只能通过架构层面的隔离、下线或自行加固来降低风险。由于输入中未提供具体的受影响版本区间与部署形态，资产排查存在一定难度。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞属对象级授权缺失，低权限远程攻击者可通过操纵 ID 参数越权读取客户信息，且利用代码已公开。产品官网已下线、厂商未回应，官方补丁基本无望，只能靠隔离与下线止损，属于需要自主处置的遗留资产风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致未授权访问他人客户币种/客户信息数据，造成机密性泄露；因不涉及写入与拒绝服务，完整性与可用性不受影响。若该 API 承载交易所类客户账户数据，泄露内容可能被用于后续社工与账户接管，形成链条风险。

items.title: A vulnerability was determined in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. This affects an unknown function of the file /customer/ of the component Customer Profile API. Executing a m...
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in Omega Solution CoinEx Crypto 2025. This affects an unknown function of the file /customer/ of the component Customer Profile API. Executing a manipulation of the argument ID can lead to authorization bypass. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The product web site does not exist anymore. Maybe the product got retired and/or replaced. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-105096 是 NVD 收录的一则授权绕过漏洞，影响 Omega Solution 开发的 CoinEx Crypto 2025 产品。漏洞位于该产品 Customer Profile API（客户资料接口）的 /customer/ 路径下，涉及一个未被披露具体名称的处理函数。攻击者通过操纵请求中的 ID 参数（即篡改资源标识符），即可绕过对象级授权检查，访问或操作原本不属于自己的客户资料数据，属于典型的 IDOR/BOLA（对象级授权失效）类缺陷。由于该接口以 HTTP 服务形式对外提供，攻击者可远程发起利用，无需本地接触目标系统；利用者只需持有一个低权限账户（CVSS 向量中 PR:L 表明需要基本认证），且不需要任何用户交互配合。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 6.3（中危），向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L，即机密性、完整性与可用性影响均评估为“低”，但攻击复杂度低、可远程触发，实际危害程度取决于被越权访问的客户数据敏感度与业务关键性。描述明确指出该漏洞的利用细节已对外公开披露，可能被他人直接借用；但 NVD 未将其列入 KEV 目录，也没有任何字段标注已在野利用或已武器化。另需注意，厂商 Omega Solution 在该披露被提前联系后未作任何回应，且该产品官网已不复存在，产品可能已停售或被替换，因此官方补丁的获取前景不明，现有使用方需自行评估是否继续运行。当前元数据未给出具体受影响版本范围。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 授权绕过可导致越权读取或篡改客户资料，直接冲击隐私与数据完整性；利用细节已公开、可远程触发且无需用户交互，叠加厂商失联、官网下线，短期内基本不会有官方补丁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用低权限账户构造请求，通过篡改 ID 参数越权访问或修改他人客户资料，造成客户隐私泄露与业务数据被篡改；单次利用的机密性、完整性与可用性影响均为低，但可批量枚举，影响面可能随客户数据规模放大。

items.title: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users by supplying an unvalidated redirect_url parameter to EmailTemp...
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users by supplying an unvalidated redirect_url parameter to EmailTemplateController builder and builderEdit. Attackers can send crafted builder links to logged-in users with email template permissions so saving a template navigates them to attacker-controlled phishing sites.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-105128 是 LaraDashboard 1.4.8 之前版本中存在的一个开放重定向（Open Redirect）漏洞。该项目的邮件模板管理功能由 EmailTemplateController 实现，其中 builder 与 builderEdit 两个动作会接收一个用于跳转的 redirect_url 参数，但代码未对该参数做白名单、域名归属或格式校验，直接将其用作模板保存后的跳转目标。攻击者可据此构造特制的 builder 链接，诱导已登录且具备邮件模板管理权限的用户点击；当用户在界面上执行保存模板操作时，浏览器会被重定向到攻击者控制的站点。由于跳转由目标系统自身域名发起，用户与浏览器往往不会产生怀疑，攻击者可借此实施钓鱼、凭据窃取或恶意软件投递。利用该漏洞需满足两个前提：受害者已登录后台并拥有邮件模板相关权限，且需主动点击并完成一次保存操作，因此属于需要用户交互的场景。按 CVSS 3.1 评估为 5.4（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N），整体定级为中危。NVD 元数据未标注该漏洞已列入 KEV 或存在在野利用，修复版本为 1.4.8，升级后即可消除该问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 管理后台的开放重定向可被用于发起高可信度钓鱼，目标通常是已登录且持有模板权限的用户，凭据一旦泄露可能引发二次入侵。利用门槛较低但需用户交互，当前元数据未显示在野利用，应以尽快升级与参数校验为主。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 具备邮件模板权限的已登录用户可能被从可信域名重定向至攻击者控制的站点，导致钓鱼、凭据或会话信息泄露。系统本身数据未被直接篡改，业务影响以信任滥用和用户侧安全风险为主。

items.title: LaraDashboard 1.4.2 before 1.4.8 applies advanced email validation to unauthenticated forgot-password and reset-password requests, triggering DNS lookups and paid AbstractAPI ve...
items.summary: LaraDashboard 1.4.2 before 1.4.8 applies advanced email validation to unauthenticated forgot-password and reset-password requests, triggering DNS lookups and paid AbstractAPI verification calls. Unauthenticated attackers can submit arbitrary addresses to exhaust the verification quota, making validation fail open for all public forms, and probe domain resolution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-105127 涉及 LaraDashboard 在 1.4.2 至 1.4.8 之前的版本中存在的资源耗尽与安全校验失效问题。该产品在面向未认证用户的「忘记密码」和「重置密码」流程中，默认启用了较为严格的高级邮箱地址验证逻辑：为了判断提交的邮箱是否真实可用，系统会对用户提交的域名执行 DNS 解析查询，并调用第三方付费服务 AbstractAPI 进行邮箱有效性校验。由于这两个入口本身无需登录即可访问，攻击者可以批量提交任意构造的邮箱地址（尤其是解析失败或明显无效的域名），从而持续消耗 DNS 查询与 AbstractAPI 的调用配额。当配额被耗尽或第三方校验接口因限流/欠费而不可用时，验证逻辑会「失败开放」（fail open），也就是校验失败后不再阻断请求，而是直接放行。这一行为会产生两个后果：第一，所有公开展示、依赖同一验证组件的表单都将失去邮箱真实性校验能力，可能导致垃圾注册、伪造邮箱地址、密码重置流程被滥用等问题；第二，攻击者可以通过观察提交不同域名时系统响应时间或行为的差异，对目标环境的域名解析能力和内部网络可达性进行探测，形成侧信道信息泄露。该漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 5.3（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L），即远程、无需认证、无需用户交互即可触发，但综合影响仅体现为可用性方面的低度损失，完整性与机密性未被评为受影响。需要注意的是，本次输入数据未标记该漏洞已被列入 KEV 或存在在野利用，因此不应假设其已武器化。修复版本为 1.4.8，建议受影响用户尽快升级，并对相关公开端点施加限流与验证码等防护。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未认证的公开端点会因任意邮箱提交而消耗付费验证配额与 DNS 查询，配额耗尽后校验逻辑失败开放，导致所有公开表单的邮箱真实性校验整体失效，并可被用于域名解析探测。攻击门槛低、可自动化，但当前仅评估为可用性低影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能导致第三方验证服务配额被恶意耗尽、产生额外费用，并使邮件地址校验在所有公开表单上失效（fail open），进而被滥用为垃圾注册或密码重置滥用入口；同时可用于探测目标环境的域名解析情况。机密性与完整性未被评为受影响，暂未见在野利用证据。

items.title: W (vincent-peugnet/wcms) through 3.18.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via the login user field and...
items.summary: W (vincent-peugnet/wcms) through 3.18.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts via the login user field and visitor comment website field. Attackers can submit failed logins rendered unescaped in the adminlog.php log viewer, or comment URLs echoed into href attributes in editrightbar.php, executing script with administrator or editor privileges.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响 vincent-peugnet/wcms 项目（通常简称为 W）3.18.0 及之前的所有版本，属于存储型跨站脚本（Stored XSS）类型。漏洞的根本成因是应用在多个位置将用户可控输入写入页面时未进行充分的输出编码/转义处理。具体有两条注入路径：其一，未认证攻击者可以在登录表单的“用户名”字段中提交带有恶意脚本的内容，该字段被原样写入日志，随后在管理员查看后台日志页面 adminlog.php 时被当作 HTML 渲染，从而在管理员的浏览器上下文中执行脚本；其二，游客在评论功能中填写的“网站 URL”字段会被直接回显到 editrightbar.php 生成页面的 href 属性中，攻击者可以通过构造带有可执行脚本的伪协议链接（例如 javascript: 之类的形式）或闭合属性再注入事件处理器的方式，使管理员或编辑人员点击/浏览该页面时触发脚本执行。由于该漏洞的利用不需要任何账号权限（PR:N），但需要受害者主动访问被投毒的后台页面或与受污染链接交互（UI:R），因此 CVSS 3.1 评分为 6.1（中危），向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N，其中作用域变更（S:C）体现了脚本从低权限输入面扩散到高权限管理会话的横向影响。成功利用后可窃取管理员或编辑的会话 Cookie、伪造管理操作、篡改站点内容或进行钓鱼跳转，属于典型的权限提升型前端攻击。当前 NVD 元数据未标记该 CVE 已列入 KEV，也未标记存在公开的在野利用信息，因此不应推断已被实际攻击利用。建议受影响部署尽快跟踪上游修复版本，升级到 3.18.0 之后的修复发行版；在补丁到位前，应对日志查看页与后台编辑栏页面实施输出编码、对用户名字段与评论 URL 做白名单校验、部署 CSP 与 HttpOnly/SameSite Cookie 策略，并将后台管理界面限制在内网或受控 IP 范围以缩小攻击面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 攻击者无需认证即可向日志与评论字段植入脚本，并在管理员/编辑浏览后台时于其会话中执行，可能导致会话劫持与后台接管。虽然当前未见在野利用记录，但暴露在公网的 wcms 后台是现实攻击面，需优先修复或限制访问。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可窃取管理员/编辑会话凭据、以高权限身份执行后台操作、篡改内容或植入钓鱼页面；因作用域变更为 S:C，影响不仅限于原始注入页面，而会波及整个管理会话。

items.title: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in Ultimate Member Ultimate Member ultimate-member allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Ultimate Member:...
items.summary: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in Ultimate Member Ultimate Member ultimate-member allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Ultimate Member: from n/a through 2.13.1.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
CVE-2026-96451 是 WordPress 生态中广泛使用的会员/用户资料插件 Ultimate Member (ultimate-member) 的一个授权绕过漏洞，缺陷类型为 CWE-639「通过用户可控键实现授权绕过 (Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key)」。根据 NVD 元数据，受影响版本为 2.13.1 及之前的所有版本 (from n/a through 2.13.1)，厂商给出的官方描述仅有一句结论性说明：该问题允许攻击者实现权限提升 (Privilege Escalation)。

从漏洞类别可以推断其技术机理：应用在处理某个请求时，把由用户端提交、可被篡改的键值 (例如对象标识、角色或会员等级标识、表单字段、请求参数等) 直接用作服务端授权判定的依据，而没有在服务端重新校验「当前登录用户是否有权对该键所指向的资源或角色执行该操作」。因此，一个仅具备低权限账户 (例如普通注册会员) 的攻击者，可以在构造请求时把该键替换为更高权限目标所对应的值，使服务端误认为操作合法，从而完成越权操作。结合 CVSS 3.1 向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H 可知：攻击可经网络远程发起、利用复杂度低、需要低权限前提、无需用户交互，成功利用后对机密性、完整性、可用性均有高影响。该评分 8.8 属于「高危」区间，但由于攻击者仍需先拥有一个低权限账户，因此并非全然的未认证远程利用。

目前 NVD 元数据中未提供 EPSS 分值，未列入 CISA KEV，且来源字段明确标注未发现在野利用 (exploit_in_the_wild=false / known_exploited=false)，故本文不对在野利用或武器化状态做任何推测。由于 Ultimate Member 常用于构建会员制站点、社区、论坛与内容付费平台，且角色权限往往与内容访问、付费等级直接绑定，一旦被利用可能造成会员等级被非法提升、受限内容被批量读取或站点接管风险。修复方向为升级到 2.13.1 之后的已修复版本，并配合服务器端授权校验加固与日志审计。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Ultimate Member 装机量大，会员角色常与付费等级、内容访问权限直接绑定。该漏洞只需一个低权限账户即可越权提升权限，利用门槛低、无需交互，CVSS 8.8 属高危。当前未见在野利用证据，但应尽快升级至 2.13.1 以上版本以防被批量利用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 低权限已认证用户可能通过篡改请求中用户可控的键值绕过授权检查，实现权限提升，导致高价值账户被冒用、受保护内容与敏感数据被读取或篡改，并可能进一步扩大为站点管理权限失守。元数据显示未发现在野利用。

items.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Unlimited Elements Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, ...
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Unlimited Elements Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates) unlimited-elements-for-elementor allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates): from n/a through 2.0.20.

llm_summary.summary_zh: WordPress 插件 Unlimited Elements For Elementor（Free Widgets, Addons, Templates）存在反射型跨站脚本（Reflected XSS）漏洞，编号 CVE-2026-103342。该问题归类为 CWE-79，即在网页生成过程中对用户输入未做充分的中和与转义处理：插件在处理带有用户可控参数的请求时，可能将未经过滤或编码的输入直接回显到 HTML 响应中，使攻击者构造的特制链接在受害者点击后，恶意脚本得以在受影响站点的域上下文中于其浏览器内执行。受影响范围为该插件 2.0.20 及之前的所有版本（from n/a through 2.0.20），受影响的具体产品与厂商字段元数据未提供，供应商也未见明确标注的修复版本。NVD 给出 CVSS 3.1 基础评分 7.1（高危），向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:L，表明攻击可经网络远程发起、无需认证与任何特权，但依赖诱导用户交互（点击恶意链接），且作用域发生改变（S:C），对机密性、完整性和可用性各造成低度影响。当前该 CVE 未被列入 CISA KEV，且元数据中“已在野利用”标志为 False，因此没有任何证据表明其已被在野利用或已武器化，应将其视为潜在风险而非已确认的活跃威胁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 反射型 XSS 可在受害者浏览器内以站点身份执行脚本，虽需用户点击诱导，但利用门槛低、无需认证，且评分 7.1 属高危，对运行该 Elementor 扩展的 WordPress 站点构成现实风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可通过构造恶意链接，在受害者访问后于受影响站点域内执行脚本，可能窃取会话凭据、篡改页面内容或诱导进一步操作。CVSS 3.1 评分 7.1（高危），机密性、完整性、可用性影响均为低。元数据未显示在野利用。

items.title: OpenAM before 16.1.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers able to register or modify OAuth 2.0 clients to make OpenAM fetch internal resour...
items.summary: OpenAM before 16.1.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers able to register or modify OAuth 2.0 clients to make OpenAM fetch internal resources via an unvalidated jwks_uri. Attackers can trigger unauthenticated fetches through client-authentication and ID-token validation to probe internal hosts, metadata endpoints or local files, or exhaust request threads for denial of service.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-105122 是 OpenAM（ForgeRock 系身份与访问管理平台）16.1.3 之前版本中存在的一个服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞。其根因在于 OpenAM 在处理 OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect 客户端注册与配置时，未对客户端元数据中的 jwks_uri 字段做充分校验（缺少内网地址、回环地址、元数据端点及本地文件协议等目标的限制与白名单），导致服务端会以自身身份向攻击者指定的任意地址发起出站 HTTP 请求。攻击者只要具备注册新 OAuth 2.0 客户端或修改既有客户端配置的权限（对应 CVSS 向量中的 PR:L，即需要低权限账户），即可植入恶意的 jwks_uri。此后，OpenAM 在两类无需额外交互的流程中会自动拉取该 URI：一是客户端认证（client-authentication，例如 private_key_jwt 场景下读取 JWKS 公钥）；二是 ID Token 校验（ID-token validation，读取签名密钥）。由于这些拉取由服务端主动发起且无需受害者点击或登录，攻击者可反复触发，形成稳定的探测原语。利用该原语可实现：对内网主机与端口做存活与拓扑探测、访问云环境元数据端点（如 169.254.169.254 一类实例元数据服务）以窃取临时凭据、通过 file:// 等协议尝试读取本地文件，或构造大量指向不可达/超时地址的请求以长期占用请求线程池，造成拒绝服务。CVSS 3.1 评分为 5.4（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:L），属中危，主要影响机密性与可用性的低程度损失，完整性不受影响。NVD 元数据未标注该漏洞已被列入 KEV 或存在在野利用，因此不应推断已被武器化。修复方式是升级到 OpenAM 16.1.3 或更高版本；若无法立即升级，应对 jwks_uri 实施出站目的地白名单、阻断对内网与元数据地址的解析，并限制可注册/修改 OAuth 客户端的账户范围。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SSRF 常被用作进入内网与云元数据服务的跳板，可导致凭据泄露与横向移动；且触发路径（客户端认证、ID Token 校验）无需受害者交互，具备低权限账户的攻击者即可稳定复现。虽然当前 CVSS 仅 5.4 且未见在野利用证据，但身份平台通常位于信任边界内部，暴露面价值高，应优先排查与修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 具备注册或修改 OAuth 2.0 客户端权限的攻击者可让 OpenAM 服务端向其指定地址发起请求，用于探测内网主机与端口、访问云元数据端点或尝试读取本地文件，并可通过制造大量超时请求耗尽请求线程，造成服务不可用。机密性与可用性受低程度影响。

items.title: OpenAM before 16.1.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the sessions REST endpoint query operation that allows realm administrators to list sessions of every real...
items.summary: OpenAM before 16.1.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the sessions REST endpoint query operation that allows realm administrators to list sessions of every realm. Attackers holding delegated RealmAdmin privileges can supply a _queryFilter naming another realm to disclose usernames, universal IDs, and session handles across tenant boundaries.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-105120 是 OpenAM（原 ForgeRock、现 Open Identity Platform 的访问管理组件）16.1.3 之前版本中的一处授权绕过漏洞，位于 sessions REST 端点的 query 查询操作。该接口的设计意图是按调用者所属的 realm（租户域）做数据隔离，即只应返回当前 realm 内的会话信息。但由于服务端在处理请求时未对查询参数 _queryFilter 做充分的 realm 归属校验，持有被委派的 RealmAdmin（领域管理员）权限的攻击者可以在查询条件中指定另一个 realm 的名称，从而越过租户边界，枚举并读取其他 realm 的用户名、通用标识符（Universal ID）以及会话句柄（session handle）。CVSS 3.1 评分为 4.9，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N：攻击者可经网络远程发起、攻击复杂度低、无需用户交互，但需要已经拥有较高权限的 RealmAdmin 账户（PR:H）；漏洞仅影响机密性（C:H），不直接影响完整性与可用性，作用域保持不变。成功利用后造成的是跨租户会话与身份数据泄露，可被用于后续的会话劫持、横向移动或大规模账户枚举，因此对多租户 / 多 realm 部署的 IAM 环境风险尤为突出。官方修复版本为 OpenAM 16.1.3。该 CVE 未被列入 CISA KEV，输入数据亦未标注存在公开的在野利用或武器化情况。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多租户 IAM 的隔离边界被打破：具备 RealmAdmin 权限者可跨 realm 读取用户名、Universal ID 与会话句柄，可能引发会话劫持与横向渗透。虽需高权限前提，但利用门槛低、无需交互，属应尽快修复的隔离缺陷。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 跨租户机密性泄露：其他 realm 的用户名、Universal ID 与会话句柄被未授权读取，完整性、可用性不受影响；后续可被用于会话劫持、账户枚举与横向移动。

items.title: Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents
items.summary: Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost. These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究多轮（multi-turn）交互场景下 LLM 智能体（agentic system）的安全风险。作者指出的核心问题是：现有防御往往孤立地评估单次动作或单个状态，而攻击者可以将多个单独看都合规的操作逐步组合，最终产生有害结果，这类"组合式"攻击因此容易绕过逐动作检查。论文的关键发现是：这种有害行为会在智能体的内部表示中留下可检测的痕迹——有害倾向表现为随上下文更新而累积的表示位移（representation transition），并且触发它的上下文可以从同一信号中被定位与归因。作者进一步发现，直接对表示位移做朴素聚合会被良性表示漂移（benign representation drift）干扰：一个对比式的安全方向并不必然对良性位移给出零值，因此需要先做去噪处理，将良性流量锚定到零并移除其主要变化方向，且这一校准不带来运行时开销。基于上述发现，作者提出 DART——一个运行时框架，用于检测和归因表示漂移，并通过有针对性的提醒（targeted reminders）进行干预。实验在六个模型与两个多轮基准上展开：在 MT-AgentRisk 上把攻击成功率从 84% 降至 25%，并能捕获全部攻击，平均误报率 12%；在 ASEval 上从 97% 降至 52%，良性拒答代价分别为 8% 与 0%。在 MT-AgentRisk 上，DART 在全部六个模型上均优于当前最先进的多轮防御 ToolShield（相同协议下 ToolShield 仅能达到把成功率降到 55% 的水平）。消融显示去噪步骤至关重要：在 ASEval 上，未去噪的监控器只能捕获 7%-40% 的攻击，而去噪后可达 60%-85%。同一监控器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入（indirect injection）场景，每个被监控步骤仅增加 0.14-0.56 秒开销，且不需要辅助模型，因此可作为计算量大的推测式防御的轻量补充。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多轮组合式攻击是当前智能体防御的薄弱环节，逐动作检查天然失效。该工作证明内部表示位移可作为检测与归因信号，且给出无需辅助模型、每步仅增加亚秒级开销的运行时方案，对构建生产级 agent 防护有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于带工具调用/多轮会话的 LLM 智能体平台（如企业助手、自动化工作流代理）的运行时防护层；可迁移到单轮提示注入检测、越权操作链识别、以及作为高成本防御（如推测式解码类安全推理）的轻量前置过滤。
detection_signals_zh: 上下文更新过程中累积的内部表示位移超过基线阈值
去噪后安全方向投影出现异常偏移（良性漂移已被零锚定与主变差方向去除后仍显著）
多轮会话中出现虽各自合规但组合后指向有害目标的动作序列
单轮间接注入同样会触发同一监控器的表示异常信号
defense_advice_zh: 在多轮 agent 运行时引入表示层监控，而非仅检查单步动作或最终状态
部署监控前必须做良性流量校准：将良性位移锚定到零并剔除其主变化方向，否则检出率会从 60%-85% 跌至 7%-40%
检测到异常时采用有针对性的提醒式干预，避免直接硬阻断带来的良性拒答率上升
将该轻量监控与计算密集的防御方案串联，作为前置过滤以降低整体成本
关注良性非拒答代价（MT-AgentRisk 约 8%、ASEval 约 0%），并按业务容忍度调优阈值
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：复现其去噪校准与监控流程，评估在自有 agent 业务上的误报/检出权衡

items.title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching
items.summary: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties. In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. While inputs that instruct the LLM to send data directly via generated code are easy to detect and network libraries are typically restricted, LLMLeak relies only on the LLM's tool to fetch websites for further information. A malicious software component on the client side embeds a secret into a URL. It presents the referenced website as providing information required for a benign task, such as migrating a software library. When the LLM accesses the URL, the attacker receives the encoded secret through an attacker-controlled DNS or web server. We perform an extensive evaluation on eleven open-parameter models, observe an attack success rate of 79.7%, and also conduct a case study on real-world chatbots, demonstrating the relevance of LLMLeak.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是大语言模型（LLM）及其智能体（agent）在带来便利的同时所引入的一类新型数据外泄风险。作者指出，已有研究大量关注提示注入（prompt injection）以及敏感数据被泄露给聊天机器人服务商等问题，业界也提出了相应缓解手段，例如对输入进行结构化处理以阻止提示注入，或部署本地 LLM 以避免把机密数据交给第三方运营方。然而，论文认为仍存在一个被忽视的威胁面：LLM 反过来可能成为把机密数据泄露给外部第三方的通道。为此，作者提出并演示了一个名为 LLMLeak 的新型攻击向量。其核心场景是：本地运行的恶意软件本身被沙箱或网络策略限制，无法直接访问互联网，但它可以借助同一主机上的 LLM 来建立隐蔽信道。与那些直接在提示中要求模型用生成的代码把数据发出去的做法不同（这类请求容易被检测，且网络请求库通常受限制），LLMLeak 只依赖 LLM 自带的“抓取网页以获取更多信息”工具。具体而言，客户端上的恶意组件把要外泄的秘密编码进一个 URL，并把这个 URL 包装成某个良性任务（例如迁移某个软件库）所必需的信息来源，诱导 LLM 主动去访问该链接。一旦 LLM 发起抓取请求，攻击者即可通过其控制的 DNS 服务器或 Web 服务器接收到被编码的秘密，从而完成数据外泄。为验证可行性，作者在 11 个开放参数（open-parameter）模型上进行了较为广泛的评测，观察到 79.7% 的攻击成功率，并针对真实世界的聊天机器人开展了案例研究，说明该威胁在现实部署中具有相关性。该工作属于攻击面分析与安全评估类研究，揭示了“合法工具被滥用为外泄通道”这一范式，适合从事 LLM/智能体安全、终端防护与数据防泄漏的读者阅读，也为后续检测与缓解研究提供了基线。需要注意的是，本文摘要未标注该攻击已被在野利用或武器化。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了 LLM 网页抓取工具可被本地受限恶意软件滥用为隐蔽外泄信道，且不依赖易被检测的代码生成或网络库调用；79.7% 的高成功率意味着现有仅做提示注入防护与本地化部署的缓解措施并不足以阻断此类数据外泄，防御方需重新审视 LLM 工具调用的出站流量与主机侧行为关联。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有在终端或内网部署 LLM 助手/智能体并启用联网抓取工具的场景，包括企业办公助手、IDE 编程助手、浏览器智能体、邮件自动处理代理等。可迁移到数据防泄漏（DLP）、终端检测与响应（EDR）、LLM 网关与出站流量管控等产品与流程中，用于设计新的检测规则与策略。
detection_signals_zh: LLM 工具调用触发的出站 DNS/HTTP 请求中出现此前未出现过的域名或新注册域名
URL 路径、查询参数或子域名中包含高熵、Base64/十六进制样式或长度异常的编码片段
本地进程活动与 LLM 发起网页抓取之间存在时间与因果关联（如某进程写入临时文件后立刻触发抓取）
LLM 抓取目标被描述为与当前良性任务相关的“参考资料”，但域名与任务主题明显不匹配或非官方来源
同一主机在短时间内发生多次对同一陌生域名的抓取，呈规律性或分片式请求模式
DNS 查询目标解析指向非主流解析服务或归属可疑自治域
defense_advice_zh: 对 LLM/智能体的网页抓取工具实施域名允许列表（allowlist）与出站代理审计，默认拒绝未知域名
在出口层部署 DNS/HTTP 监控，对高熵 URL 与陌生域名进行告警与阻断
将本地 LLM 工具调用日志与端点进程行为日志关联分析，建立抓取触发源的可追溯性
对不受信任的本地软件实施最小权限与网络隔离，同时限制其对 LLM 接口/工具调用的可达性
在 URL 构造与拼接环节引入 DLP 检查，检测疑似编码秘密的 URL 结构
在智能体提示与工作流中加入对“来源不明外部链接”的确认机制，减少模型自主抓取的触发面
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并将 LLM 抓取工具的出口管控与 URL 高熵检测纳入内部评估与检测规则试点

items.title: ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills
items.summary: LLM-based agents extend their capabilities through third-party skills that provide task-specific instructions, scripts, and tool-use procedures. However, malicious instructions inserted into an otherwise benign skill can cause a benign user request to trigger dangerous Tool Calls, including data exfiltration, file deletion, or unauthorized code execution. This paper presents ActionGuard, which inspects skill-influenced Tool Calls immediately before execution. ActionGuard separates the target agent's action-generation context from the safeguard's authorization context. The target agent may use the original skill for planning, but the Reviewer does not receive the potentially poisoned raw skill text. Instead, it determines whether each action is justified by the trusted user request using a balanced skill profile, current and recent Tool Calls, and local script contents. ActionGuard intercepts each Tool Call at OpenClaw's before-tool-call stage and enforces the Reviewer's ALLOW or DENY decision under a fail-closed policy. We evaluate ActionGuard on 139 contextual and 180 obvious injections in a SKILL-INJECT-based setting against Dynamic Guardian and SkillGuard, using three open-source and two commercial Reviewer models. Each condition is repeated three times and evaluated using Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Task Success Rate (TSR). Overall, ActionGuard reduced ASR by 35.54 to 46.11 percent relative to existing safeguards and by 70.44 percent relative to No Safeguard, while maintaining high benign-task completion. These results show that execution-boundary authorization grounded in trusted user intent and runtime evidence can restrict unauthorized Tool Calls induced by skill injection.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文关注 LLM 智能体在引入第三方 skill 后的安全风险。当前智能体普遍通过第三方 skill 扩展能力,这些 skill 会提供任务指令、脚本和工具使用流程。问题在于:即使 skill 本身看起来无害,只要其中被插入了恶意指令,一个完全良性的用户请求也可能被诱导触发危险的 Tool Call,例如数据外泄、删除文件或未授权代码执行。现有防护方案(如 Dynamic Guardian、SkillGuard)在这一场景下防护不足,因为它们需要接触或依赖可能已被污染的 skill 文本,攻击者可以把恶意指令藏在对防护器可见的上下文中。

论文提出 ActionGuard,一种在 Tool Call 真正执行之前进行拦截与授权的机制。其核心设计是把目标智能体的动作生成上下文与防护器的授权上下文相互解耦:目标智能体仍然可以使用原始 skill 进行规划,但负责裁决的 Reviewer 不会收到可能被污染的原始 skill 文本。Reviewer 改为依据三类受信证据做判断——平衡化的 skill profile(balanced skill profile)、当前与最近的 Tool Call 记录、以及本地脚本内容,从而判定每一个动作是否能被可信的用户请求所正当化。ActionGuard 在 OpenClaw 的 before-tool-call 阶段拦截每一次 Tool Call,并在 fail-closed(默认拒绝)策略下强制执行 Reviewer 的 ALLOW 或 DENY 裁决。

评估方面,作者在 SKILL-INJECT 设定下构建了 139 个上下文型注入样本和 180 个显式注入样本,与 Dynamic Guardian、SkillGuard 进行对比,使用三个开源模型和两个商用模型作为 Reviewer,每个实验条件重复三次,采用攻击成功率(ASR)和任务成功率(TSR)作为指标。结果表明:ActionGuard 相对现有防护方案将 ASR 降低 35.54% 至 46.11%,相对无防护基线降低 70.44%,同时保持了较高的良性任务完成率。

论文的主要贡献在于:提出并验证了"执行边界授权"(execution-boundary authorization)这一思路,即把授权判断建立在可信用户意图与运行时证据之上,而非建立在可能被污染的 skill 文本之上;并给出了在真实 agent 运行时(OpenClaw)中可落地的拦截点与失败关闭策略。该工作适合智能体框架开发者、LLM 应用安全研究者以及负责 AI 工具链安全的防御团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 第三方 skill 已成智能体供应链的主要信任入口,而 skill 文本本身又是攻击面。ActionGuard 的关键思路是让授权决策绕开被污染的 skill 文本、只依赖可信用户意图与运行时证据,并默认拒绝,这对设计 agent 工具调用网关和运行时策略引擎具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到各类具备工具调用能力的智能体平台与运行时:IDE/终端智能体、CI/CD 自动化 agent、浏览器自动化、企业内 RPA 与内部 copilot。适用场景包括工具调用前置授权网关、skill 市场准入审查、以及多 agent 架构中独立 Reviewer 角色的划分。对已部署 OpenClaw 类运行时的团队,该拦截点可直接纳入现有 hook 机制。
detection_signals_zh: Tool Call 的目标资源、参数或数据流向与用户原始请求不存在可解释的对应关系
短时间内出现读取敏感路径/凭据文件后紧接对外网络请求的连续工具调用序列
单个 skill 触发的工具调用链明显超出其声明功能范围(如文档处理 skill 调用 shell 或删除操作)
同一用户请求下,动作生成上下文与授权审查上下文出现语义不一致
高风险工具(删除、执行、外发)在无对应显式用户指令时被触发,或触发频率异常升高
Reviewer 返回 DENY 但底层执行层仍尝试执行的日志不一致现象
defense_advice_zh: 在工具调用执行边界部署强制审查层,并对高风险工具采用 fail-closed 默认拒绝策略
确保授权审查组件不直接接触未经净化的原始 skill 文本,改用结构化/平衡化后的 skill profile 作为输入
将当前与历史 Tool Call 序列、用户原始请求、本地脚本内容作为审查证据一并输入,做意图一致性比对
对 skill 建立准入与持续审查机制:来源校验、权限声明、最小权限授予以及变更后的重新评估
将 Reviewer 与动作生成智能体的上下文隔离,避免被注入内容同时影响生成与裁决两侧
对高风险工具(文件删除、代码执行、网络外发)设置额外的人工确认或二次审批通道
持续以 ASR 与 TSR 双指标做回归测试,避免为降低攻击成功率而过度牺牲正常任务完成率
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进,并评估将执行边界授权与 fail-closed 审查模式纳入内部智能体工具调用网关设计

items.title: Chaining Skills to Hijack LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents use skills to improve performance on specialized tasks. To complete a user request, an agent may invoke several skills in sequence, allowing information produced under one skill to guide the next. Because skills may come from open-source repositories, this handoff can also carry attacker-controlled claims into later decisions. In this paper, we introduce APEX, which constructs and refines adversarial skill chains tailored to a user task and an attacker-selected action. The key insight is that an agent-written record of genuine task progress can carry a false claim of user approval across skills: an upstream skill induces the agent to create the record, and a downstream skill uses it to direct the attacker-selected action. Across four targeted-action families and six models on SkillsBench, the chains induce the selected action in 512 of 690 attempts (74.2%). On GPT-5.4, the full chain succeeds in 84.3% of attempts, compared with 17.4% when the workflow is merged into one skill. We further evaluate a prompting defense that asks the agent to check skill-produced files against the original request. On GPT-5.4, it lowers targeted-action success from 84.3% to 59.1%, while the verifier test-pass rate across 72 benign native-skill tasks falls from 86.7% to 56.3%. These results highlight the need for defenses that prevent attacker-directed actions while preserving legitimate task performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究 LLM 智能体（agent）的「技能链」被滥用的风险。LLM 智能体通常借助技能（skill）完成专门任务，为响应用户请求，智能体会按顺序调用多个技能，前一个技能产生的信息会作为后一个技能的输入或决策依据。由于技能常来自开源仓库，这种技能间的信息交接也可能把攻击者控制的声明（claim）带入后续决策，形成一种跨技能的攻击面。作者提出 APEX 框架，针对特定用户任务和攻击者选定的目标动作，自动构建并迭代优化对抗性技能链。其核心洞察是：智能体自己写下的、看似真实的「任务进度记录」可以成为一个载体——上游技能诱导智能体生成该记录，其中夹带一条「用户已批准」的虚假声明；下游技能再读取这条记录，从而把智能体导向攻击者选定的动作。这种设计利用了智能体对自身产物的信任，而非直接注入外部恶意文本，因此更难被单点检测发现。实验在 SkillsBench 上覆盖四个目标动作族和六个模型，共 690 次尝试中 512 次成功诱发选定动作，成功率为 74.2%。在 GPT-5.4 上完整技能链成功率达 84.3%，而将整个工作流合并为单个技能时成功率仅 17.4%，说明跨技能交接是攻击成立的关键。作者还评估了一种提示层防御：要求智能体将技能产出的文件与原始用户请求进行核对。该防御在 GPT-5.4 上把目标动作成功率从 84.3% 降至 59.1%，但同时使 72 个良性原生技能任务的验证器通过率从 86.7% 降至 56.3%。结论是：现有防御在安全性与正常任务性能之间存在明显权衡，亟需既能阻止攻击者导向动作、又能保持合法任务完成能力的新机制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体已能自主串联第三方技能并据此执行动作，而攻击者可借智能体自身生成的「进度记录」洗白虚假授权声明，绕过对单技能的检查。这是供应链与提示注入交叉的新型风险，直接影响企业部署的自动化流程。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何采用多技能/多工具编排的 LLM 智能体平台，如自动化办公助手、代码代理、运维自动化流水线、电商与客服智能体。攻击者可通过投毒开源技能仓库，诱导智能体执行转账、数据外发、配置修改等敏感动作。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体生成的文件或中间记录中出现未经用户实际确认的「已批准 / 已授权 / 用户同意」类声明
同一会话内跨技能传递的授权声明缺乏与原始用户请求的可追溯对应关系
下游技能执行的动作与用户原始请求的语义意图存在明显偏离
技能调用链长度异常增长，且上游技能产出被下游技能直接作为决策依据
来自外部/开源来源的技能写入或修改了被后续技能读取的文件
单技能内低风险行为在多技能串联后形成高影响动作（权限提升、数据外发、资金操作）
defense_advice_zh: 对技能产出物建立来源与可信度标记，区分「用户直接输入」「智能体自述」与「外部技能写入」，不允许智能体自述内容作为授权凭据
对敏感或不可逆动作强制引入人工确认或带外校验，不依赖智能体上下文中的授权声明
在技能链层面做策略校验：检查每步动作是否仍收敛于用户原始请求的意图范围，而不仅校验单个技能
对第三方技能仓库引入准入审查、版本锁定与签名校验，降低技能投毒与静默更新风险
采用最小权限运行技能，限制文件写入范围与可调用的下游工具集合
谨慎评估「让智能体自查技能产出」类提示防御，其安全收益伴随显著的任务性能下降，需测量误伤率后再上线

items.title: PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents turn generated text into real side effects, so poisoned tool metadata, retrieved pages, memory, and reusable skills can steer the next call. Vetting an artifact before admission does not settle this. A safe variant and a leaking variant can produce the same admission evidence, and a sound gate then cannot relax that site for either. We make that condition precise, which leaves the last boundary a deployment can still act on. We present Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement (PACE), which mediates every tool call immediately before it executes. Path confinement proposes an executable cut of represented influence paths, while capability and effect verification checks schema-defined effects against authority compiled from the authenticated request. We distinguish the certified execution contract from the evaluated configuration, which can restore an authorized call after a proposed block or apply a declared repair. Confinement requires the final action to preserve the certified cut. On eight executable agent-security benchmarks with three target-model families, the evaluated configuration gives strictly lowest attack success in 62 of 79 eligible attack columns and ties in 14; full-benchmark native utility loses at most three points relative to the undefended agent. A complete ablation over 1167 paired cases attributes most security gains to effect verification and refusal control to boundary adaptation. A reduced-scale adaptive search succeeds on 0/30 out-of-authority targets against the defense.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 工具调用型 LLM Agent 会把生成的文本转化为真实的副作用，因此被投毒的工具元数据、检索到的网页、长期记忆以及可复用的技能，都可能在后续调用中被用来左右下一次工具调用。论文指出，单纯在“准入前”审查工件并不能解决这一问题：一个安全变体与一个泄露变体可能产生完全相同的准入证据，此时任何可靠的准入闸门都无法只放行其中之一而拒绝另一个，于是准入层存在原理性的能力下限。作者将这一条件形式化，并把部署方仍然可以行动的最后边界定位为“调用即将执行之前”的即时中介，提出 Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement（PACE）。PACE 在每次工具调用执行前进行中介：路径围堵（path confinement）计算一条对所表征的影响路径的可执行切分，明确哪些影响路径允许被组合；能力与效果验证（capability and effect verification）则把 schema 定义的效果与由已认证请求编译出的授权进行比对，从而判断该调用是否越权。论文区分“已认证执行契约”与“被评估配置”：后者可在拟议阻断之后恢复一个本已授权的调用，或施加一种已声明的修复动作；围堵约束要求最终动作必须保持已认证的切分不被破坏。实验在 8 个可执行 Agent 安全基准、3 个目标模型族上进行：被评估配置在 79 个可攻击列中有 62 个取得严格最低的攻击成功率，14 个与基线持平；同时全基准原生效用手相对无防御 Agent 最多下降 3 个百分点。对 1167 对配对样本的完整消融显示，大部分安全收益来自效果验证，而拒绝行为的控制来自边界自适应。作者还做了缩小规模的自适应搜索，针对防御在越权目标上 0/30 成功。适合 Agent 平台安全架构师、LLM 应用红蓝队与 SOC 检测工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它解释了为什么“入口审查 / 内容过滤”不足以保护工具型 Agent，并把防线前移到调用执行瞬间，用授权对齐与路径围堵实现可执行的权限最小化，为 Agent 运行时防护提供了可落地的设计范式与量化基线。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 Agent 平台的运行时策略执行点（Policy Enforcement Point）：工具注册与元数据准入、检索/记忆写入后的使用、技能复用、MCP 类工具网关、以及需要区分“已认证契约”与“部署当前配置”的合规审计场景。
detection_signals_zh: 同一工具/技能存在准入证据相同但行为分化的变体（安全变体与泄露变体难以区分）
工具元数据、检索文档、记忆条目或可复用技能在调用前被修改且缺少溯源信息
工具调用参数与 schema 声明效果不一致，或效果超出已认证请求编译出的授权范围
拟议阻断后被“恢复”的授权调用、以及声明式修复动作的触发记录
越权目标的反复尝试与自适应探测，表现为授权边界上的高频失败与重试
defense_advice_zh: 把策略执行点放在工具调用执行前的最后一跳，而不是只做入口准入或离线审查
为影响路径建立可执行的切分与溯源（provenance），明确哪些来源可以组合进同一次调用
将 schema 定义的效果与从已认证用户请求编译出的授权做强制比对，越权即阻断
严格区分“已认证执行契约”与“当前部署配置”，恢复授权调用或自动修复必须留痕并可审计
在阻断策略之外引入边界自适应与拒绝控制，降低误拦导致的效用损失
以配对样本消融方式持续度量各防护组件（尤其效果验证）的真实贡献，避免过度依赖单一机制
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：在内部 Agent 工具网关中复现“调用前中介 + 效果/授权校验”思路，并评估原生效用手损失与绕过面。

items.title: Pretext: Defeating Malicious Skill Detection Frameworks for AI Agents
items.summary: Skills extend an agent's capabilities by injecting instructions and information into the context, and are widely used by agents such as OpenClaw and Claude Code. Prior work shows third-party marketplaces host malicious skills that give attackers direct influence over the victim's agent. The emerging defense scans skills before installation, pairing deterministic static checks with an LLM-based semantic judge, as in NVIDIA's SkillSpector. We show that such defenses fall to an attacker who knows the detector. Our white-box LLM attacker, Pretext, iteratively crafts skills that evade detection while still delivering the payload and performing the benign task: moving the payload from code into natural language leaves static analysis inert, while framing it as the skill's legitimate purpose and splitting instructions across files keeps the LLM stage below its blocking threshold. Across three open-source models, Pretext achieves up to 97\% and 77\% against a frozen detector and a co-adaptive one, respectively, revealing major gaps in current skill scanners.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究 AI Agent 技能（Skill）供应链的安全检测问题。技能通过把指令与信息注入到 Agent 上下文中来扩展其能力，已被 OpenClaw、Claude Code 等 Agent 广泛采用；此前研究已证实第三方技能市场存在恶意技能，攻击者可借此直接操控受害者 Agent。针对这一风险，业界出现了一类安装前扫描防御：将确定性静态检查与基于 LLM 的语义裁判相结合，NVIDIA 的 SkillSpector 即属此类。本文提出 Pretext——一个掌握检测器内部逻辑的白盒 LLM 攻击者，通过迭代方式构造技能，使其既能规避检测，又能同时投递恶意载荷并正常完成声明的良性任务。作者归纳出三条使现有防御失效的关键机制：其一，将载荷从可执行代码迁移到自然语言表述，使静态分析完全失效；其二，把恶意意图包装成该技能宣称的合法用途，使语义裁判难以判定为异常；其三，把指令拆分到多个文件，使 LLM 检测阶段看不到完整语义，从而落在拦截阈值之下。实验在三个开源模型上进行，Pretext 对冻结（固定不变）检测器的规避成功率最高达 97%，对协同自适应（随攻击同步演化）的检测器仍达 77%。结果说明当前技能扫描器存在显著结构性缺口，仅靠单次安装前扫描难以抵御了解检测逻辑的对手。该工作适合 Agent 平台安全团队、供应链安全与红队研究者阅读，并为技能审查机制的设计提供对抗性评估基线。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 技能市场是 Agent 供应链的关键入口，而业界正把“静态检查＋LLM 语义裁判”当作主要防线。该研究以白盒对抗方式证明这道防线可被系统性击穿，且自然语言化与跨文件拆分属于低成本、易复制的思路，提示防御方不能把安装前扫描当作唯一判据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用第三方技能/插件市场的 Agent 平台与终端 Agent 部署（如 OpenClaw、Claude Code 类生态），以及依赖 LLM 语义判定做内容安全审查的系统；同类分片与语义伪装思路也可迁移到提示注入检测、模型输出审核、恶意文档/脚本过滤等场景的对抗评估。
detection_signals_zh: 技能包内以自然语言指令替代可执行逻辑，且指令语义明显超出其声明的功能范围
单条技能指令被拆分到多个文件，需跨文件拼接后才呈现完整意图
技能描述、权限声明与其实际读取的上下文范围或工具调用不匹配
Agent 运行期出现与用户任务无关的凭据读取、外部网络外发或数据收集行为
技能更新后内容相对首次扫描版本发生语义漂移，或同一技能版本间行为不一致
安装前扫描通过但运行期工具调用序列与该技能宣称用途偏离
defense_advice_zh: 不要把安装前扫描当作唯一防线，叠加运行期上下文与工具调用的行为监控，并对技能实施最小权限与沙箱隔离
审查时将技能内多文件内容先做语义聚合再判定，避免因分片导致漏判
以白盒假设对自研或采购的技能扫描器开展持续红队对抗评估，跟踪规避率变化
对第三方技能强制来源验证、签名与版本锁定，高风险或高权限技能引入人工复核
建立技能行为基线，对安装后异常外联、凭据访问等事件接入 SOC 告警
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：将多文件语义聚合审查与运行期行为监控纳入内部 Agent 技能准入评估，并对现有扫描器做对抗性验证

items.title: Jev-IDS: System One Models for Network Intrusion Detection
items.summary: Machine-learning Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) depend on substantial labeled datasets and task-specific training, whereas Large Language Models (LLMs) detection can analyze flow records directly but incurs higher inference cost and latency, with less constrained outputs. This paper presents JEV-IDS, an open experimental general NIDS based on the Jev System One Model (SOM) to detect zero day intrusions Under label scarcity. JEV-IDS serializes one flow per request and asks JEV two questions: a binary attack probability and a finite-choice traffic category. Our results show that, at k=1, JEV was 4.8 times faster and 3.8 times cheaper than GPT-5.6 Luna, with 1.5 times higher novel-attack recall; it also produced 15 times fewer false alarms than a low-data Random Forest. Across 5,400 decisions on a 300-flow NSL-KDD pilot split, JEV achieved F1-Score 0.859, precision 0.941, recall 0.790, and novel-attack recall 0.838. Increasing k to 2 reduced its F1-Score to 0.839.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文提出 JEV-IDS，一个面向零日入侵检测的开放式通用网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）实验框架，其核心思路是绕开传统机器学习 NIDS 对大量标注数据和任务专用训练的依赖，同时规避大语言模型（LLM）在流量记录检测中推理成本高、延迟大、输出约束弱的问题。作者采用 Jev System One Model（SOM）作为推理基座，将 NIDS 任务重构为“单流序列化 + 双问答”的极简推理范式：每次请求只序列化一条网络流记录，随后向 JEV 模型提出两个受约束的问题——一是二分类的攻击概率判断，二是有限选项的流量类别归类。这种设计把开放式生成转变为有限空间内的判定任务，从而在标签稀缺条件下仍能保持输出的可比性和可控性。

实验方面，论文在 300 条流的 NSL-KDD 试点划分上进行了 5,400 次判定（对应 k=1 与 k=2 等设置）。结果显示，在 k=1 时，JEV 相比 GPT-5.6 Luna 推理速度提升 4.8 倍、成本降低 3.8 倍，且对新型（零日）攻击的召回率高出 1.5 倍；与低数据量训练的 Random Forest 相比，误报数量减少 15 倍。在 k=1 配置下，JEV 取得 F1-Score 0.859、精确率 0.941、召回率 0.790，新型攻击召回率 0.838。当把 k 提升到 2 时，F1-Score 下降至 0.839，说明额外采样或候选扩展并未带来收益，反而引入噪声或决策分歧。

论文的主要贡献可归纳为三点：其一，提出一种以 System One Model 为基础的通用 NIDS 架构，把流量检测任务转化为受约束的双问答题，降低对标注数据的依赖；其二，在标签稀缺与零日攻击场景下给出量化对比，证明小规模专用模型在成本、时延、误报率和新型攻击召回上相对通用大模型与传统轻量分类器具备综合优势；其三，指出 k 值增大反而降低性能，为后续在推理稳定性与成本之间做权衡提供了经验证据。该工作属于实验性试点研究，样本规模较小（300 条流），结论的泛化能力仍需在更大数据集与真实流量分布上验证。适合从事 NIDS、零日检测、LLM 安全应用与低成本推理部署的研究人员和蓝队工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 零日检测长期受困于标注稀缺与误报率高，该工作展示了用小型专用模型替代通用大模型做流级判定的可行性：成本与延迟显著下降、新型攻击召回提升，且误报少于低数据随机森林，对资源受限的 SOC 部署有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到标签稀缺环境下的流量异常检测、边缘/本地化 NIDS 推理、以及以 LLM 辅助告警降噪的场景；其“单流序列化 + 有限选择问答”的范式也可用于日志分类、告警归类等受约束判定任务。
detection_signals_zh: 流级判定分数分布异常（攻击概率阈值附近聚集）
模型对同一流的多次采样（k>1）输出不一致，可用于识别不确定样本
与低数据基线相比误报率骤降但漏报结构变化的监测
推理时延与单流请求量的异常波动（提示推理侧瓶颈）
defense_advice_zh: 在自有数据集上复现该双问答判定流程，重点核对精确率与新型攻击召回率
将模型输出与现有 IDS/规则告警做交叉验证，避免单一模型决策
对 k 值、阈值与流量类别枚举集合做敏感性测试，确定适合自身网络分布的配置
在小规模试点阶段保留人工复核通道，尤其是高不确定度样本
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进
