items.title: A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware
items.summary: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a ransom is typically demanded for its release. Current cybersecurity measures in place are being outpaced by the rapid growth of the IoT, which is accompanied by a subsequent growth in malware variants being created per day. Recognizing this pitfall, this research examines and proposes a novel approach to malware detection and classification to safeguard devices from further attacks and make IoT systems more robust and secure. The framework proposed utilizes a Structured State Space Sequence (S4) model, which discretizes sequences of malware samples in a sequence and captures long-range dependencies, essentially identifying the "cause" and "effect" hidden within malware execution flow. This study presents two novel contributions: the first empirical application of the S4 model for malware analysis, and a comprehensive comparison of its performance against other deep learning architectures, laying the stepping stone for future research in this new paradigm.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注物联网（IoT）设备规模快速膨胀带来的恶意软件威胁。作者指出，预计到 2030 年全球 IoT 设备将达到 400 亿台，工业、医疗、农业、汽车、楼宇与家庭自动化等领域的技术迭代极大扩展了攻击面；由于大多数设备缺乏内建安全能力，攻击者可通过漏洞植入恶意软件，控制系统或窃取敏感数据，并在得手后索要赎金。与此同时，现有安全防护手段的演进速度已跟不上 IoT 增长以及每日新增恶意软件变种的速度，因此需要更有效的检测与分类手段。为此，论文提出一种面向恶意软件检测与多分类的新框架：采用结构化状态空间序列（Structured State Space Sequence，S4）模型，把恶意软件样本表示为序列并做离散化处理，从而捕获长程依赖关系，本质上刻画恶意软件执行流中隐藏的“因”与“果”关系，用于提升对设备攻击的识别能力与 IoT 系统的整体健壮性。论文强调两项新颖贡献：一是首次将 S4 模型实际应用于恶意软件分析领域（据摘要表述为 the first empirical application），二是将其性能与其他深度学习架构进行较全面的对比，为这一新范式后续研究奠定基础。需要说明的是，摘要层面未披露具体数据集、特征工程细节、类别数量以及量化指标，也未提及任何在野利用或武器化信息，因此其结论的实证强度尚待正文核实。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: IoT 恶意软件变种增速远超传统特征与签名式检测能力，S4 状态空间序列模型在长序列建模上具备潜力，可能成为 EDR、沙箱与固件侧恶意软件多分类的新技术路线，值得安全团队跟踪评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 IoT 固件与设备遥测分析、沙箱行为序列分类、系统调用/API 调用序列的恶意软件家族多分类等场景；对边缘侧轻量化推理与长序列依赖建模有参考价值，但摘要未给出部署成本与延迟数据。

设备侧出现基于序列建模的推理流量或边缘推理组件部署行为
面向 IoT 沙箱遥测的异常长程时序依赖模式，可作为现有检测规则的补充信号

关注数据集代表性、类别不平衡与概念漂移问题，避免模型在新变种上快速退化
将该类模型定位为纵深防御中的补充层，与签名、规则、异常检测并行，不单独作为判定依据

items.title: Combining Homomorphic Encryption and Differential Privacy in Federated Learning for Model Inspection and Availability
items.summary: The increasing prevalence of decentralized data has led to a growing interest in federated learning, which enables collaborative model training without clients sharing their sensitive local data. However, FL alone does not sufficiently protect sensitive training data and is generally coupled with privacy-preserving techniques, such as differential privacy and homomorphic encryption. Although powerful, these techniques address separate concerns via different mechanisms, so relying on just one might prove insufficient or impractical for addressing challenges associated with federated learning. In this work, we propose a privacy-preserving federated learning framework that combines homomorphic encryption-based training with differential privacy-based model inspection and release. We adopt a Markov chain Monte Carlo-based Bayesian privacy estimation method to estimate the privacy of our proposed framework. Our results show that this method improves both model utility and estimated privacy over the baseline method that relies solely on differential privacy for training. In our experiments with the FEMNIST dataset, by the end of training, our method reaches a test loss of $1.09$, compared to $2.37$ for the differential privacy-only approach, while providing stronger estimated privacy protection, with the estimated posterior mean of the privacy parameter $ε$ of $4.32$, compared to $7.26$ for the differential privacy-only approach. We also show that intermittent model monitoring can preserve the encrypted training trajectory while, under our evaluated experimental setting, providing estimated privacy comparable to or stronger than the differential privacy-only approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注联邦学习（FL）场景下的隐私保护问题。FL 允许多方在不共享本地敏感数据的前提下协同训练模型，但作者指出 FL 本身并不足以保护训练数据，实践中通常需要与差分隐私（DP）、同态加密（HE）等隐私增强技术结合。问题在于：DP 与 HE 解决的是不同层面的隐私关切（前者作用于统计层面的输出/梯度噪声，后者作用于计算与传输过程的机密性），机制彼此独立，单一技术往往不够充分或在工程上不可行（例如纯 DP 训练会带来显著效用损失）。为此，作者提出一个组合式隐私保护联邦学习框架：训练阶段采用基于同态加密的训练流程，使服务器在密文域完成聚合/计算；模型的检查（inspection）与发布（release）阶段则引入差分隐私机制，控制模型外泄时携带的隐私信息。为了量化整体隐私水平，作者采用基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）的贝叶斯隐私估计方法，对框架的隐私参数进行后验推断，而不是仅依赖理论上的 DP 上界。实验在 FEMNIST 数据集上进行：训练结束时，所提方法的测试损失为 1.09，而仅依赖差分隐私的基线方法为 2.37，说明模型效用明显更优；同时隐私参数 ε 的后验均值为 4.32，优于（数值更低即更强隐私）纯 DP 基线的 7.26，即在效用与隐私两个维度同时取得改进。论文还进一步表明，间歇式的模型监控可以在保持加密训练轨迹完整性的同时，在其实验设定下提供与纯 DP 基线相当甚至更强的估计隐私。整体贡献可归纳为：提出 HE 训练 + DP 检查/发布的组合架构，给出基于 MCMC 贝叶斯隐私估计的评估路径，并通过实验证明该组合在效用与隐私度量上优于纯 DP 方案。适合隐私保护机器学习、联邦学习系统、HE/DP 工程实现以及隐私度量方向的研究与工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: FL 部署中单靠差分隐私常导致效用大幅下降，而单靠同态加密又难以约束模型发布后的信息泄露。本文给出的 HE 训练 + DP 检查/发布组合架构及 MCMC 贝叶斯隐私估计方法，为隐私增强训练系统的隐私-效用权衡提供了可参考的量化评估思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到多方/跨机构联合建模平台（医疗、金融等敏感数据场景）：训练侧用密文计算降低服务器可见明文风险，发布侧用 DP 控制模型抽取风险；MCMC 后验隐私估计可作为一种替代或补充 DP 上界的合规性度量手段，用于内部模型发布前的隐私评估流程。
defense_advice_zh: 在设计联邦学习平台时，明确区分“训练过程机密性”与“模型发布后信息泄露”两类风险，分别用 HE 与 DP 手段覆盖，避免单一技术兜底。
对模型发布流程引入发布前隐私评估环节，除理论 DP 上界外，可考虑引入基于采样的后验隐私估计作为补充校验。
评估加密训练带来的计算与通信开销，确认在业务时延预算内可接受后再纳入生产架构。
使用公开数据集复现该框架的隐私-效用曲线，再决定是否迁移到自有数据分布上。
关注同态加密密钥管理、密文计算权限与模型检查接口的访问控制，这些是组合方案中最易被忽视的落地风险点。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：阅读全文确认其威胁模型、HE 方案选型与开销数据，评估是否可在内部联邦/多方训练平台上做小规模复现验证。

items.title: Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?
items.summary: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究生物特征模板保护方法 PolyProtect 在应用于人脸嵌入时，能否在“系统级密钥”场景下仍然生成不可逆的受保护模板。PolyProtect 通过参数 C 和 E 对生物特征向量进行变换，传统做法是为每个受试者分配专属的 C/E（受试者级密钥），从而保证不可链接性——同一身份使用不同参数生成的多个受保护模板彼此无法关联。但这一性质也导致在受保护域内无法进行身份去重，因为系统无法判断两个模板是否属于同一人。本文提出的核心问题是：如果对所有受试者统一使用同一组系统级 C/E 参数，是否仍能维持不可逆性？作者给出了可复现的开源实验，证明至少存在三种系统性选取系统级密钥的方法可以生成不可逆的 PolyProtected 模板：(i) 从预先选定的受试者级密钥中挑选参数；(ii) 对随机向量应用先前提出的密钥选择算法；(iii) 近似拟合出一个“优质”的 C/E 参数分布，再据此构造系统级密钥。实验结论表明，在系统级密钥场景下运行 PolyProtect 不会削弱其模板保护潜力，不可逆性仍然成立。该结果意味着可以在 PolyProtected 域内实现身份去重，为生物特征识别系统提供更实用的部署路径。论文属于 cs.CV 方向，适合生物特征隐私保护、模板保护方案设计与身份管理系统的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 生物特征模板保护需要在不可逆性与业务可用性之间权衡。该工作证明系统级密钥下 PolyProtect 仍保持不可逆性，使受保护域内的身份去重成为可能，对隐私合规与实际去重部署有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响人脸识别与生物特征身份管理系统的模板保护方案选型，涉及跨系统不可链接性与域内去重的设计权衡；其评估思路可迁移到其他基于密钥变换的模板保护方法。
defense_advice_zh: 在采用系统级密钥的模板保护方案前，要求供应商提供不可逆性与可链接性的独立评估报告
对生物特征模板库执行去重时，确保密钥严格隔离在系统边界内，避免跨系统关联
关注其开源实现的可复现性，自行验证论文中的不可逆性声明

items.title: GNSS Spoofing in Mobile Devices: A Survey on Impact and Countermeasures
items.summary: Smartphones rely on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-based positioning for many of the functions they execute everyday. The GNSS receivers embedded in smartphones are susceptible to anthropogenic radio frequency interference attacks in the forms of jamming and spoofing due to the low-power and open-architecture signals they receive from the satellite constellations. While jamming is a practice that denies a GNSS receiver the ability to form a position, velocity, and time (PVT) solution, spoofing represents a more insidious threat by using forged satellite signals that aim at causing the victim receiver to compute a false PVT solution. The ubiquity of smartphones and the sensitive geolocation data they hold make them a primary target for malicious spoofing. However, their hardware constraints and the lack of deep visibility into the GNSS receiver processing chain create significant hurdles for effective countermeasures. Existing surveys comprehensively explore general spoofing countermeasures but fail to address these mobile-specific limitations. This article fills that gap with a novel survey focused on techniques viable within the unique constraints of smartphone architectures. Specifically, we establish a taxonomy for defining GNSS spoofing attack effects and countermeasures, provide a historical review of smartphone vulnerability characterization, and provide an overview of techniques proposed to detect and counteract smartphone spoofing threats, offering a comparative framework to weigh their respective pros and cons on mobile platforms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇聚焦于移动设备（尤其是智能手机）GNSS 欺骗问题的综述性研究，作者来自 Robert Argo、Andrea Nardin、Alex Minetto、Pau Closas 等团队，属 eess.SP 与 eess.SY 方向。研究背景在于：智能手机的日常功能（导航、位置服务、时间同步、基于位置的应用授权等）高度依赖 GNSS 定位，而手机内置的 GNSS 接收机由于卫星信号功率极低且民用信号体制公开，天然暴露于人为射频干扰之下。论文明确区分了两类攻击：干扰（jamming）是压制式的，使接收机无法形成位置、速度与时间（PVT）解算；欺骗（spoofing）则更为隐蔽，通过伪造卫星信号诱导受害接收机计算出一个错误的 PVT 解，从而在用户无感知的情况下扭曲其真实位置或时间。由于智能手机数量庞大且承载大量敏感地理位置数据，它们成为恶意欺骗的首要目标。然而，手机平台存在显著的硬件约束（天线与射频前端受限、算力与功耗预算紧张、缺乏多天线/多频点观测能力），并且操作系统与应用层对 GNSS 接收机内部处理链缺乏深度可见性（芯片与固件通常闭源、原始观测数据难以获取），这使得许多在专业接收机上可行的抗欺骗手段难以直接迁移到手机端。论文指出，既有综述虽较全面地讨论了通用 GNSS 欺骗对抗技术，但普遍未针对上述移动端特有局限展开分析，因此本文填补这一空白。核心工作有三：一是建立一套分类体系（taxonomy），用于界定 GNSS 欺骗的攻击效果与对应的对抗措施类别；二是对智能手机脆弱性刻画的历史研究进行回顾与梳理；三是系统综述面向手机欺骗威胁的检测与反制技术，并给出比较框架，从移动平台的可行性、成本、开销与局限等角度权衡各方案的优劣。该文适合从事移动安全、定位安全、车联网与位置数据合规的攻防研究者与工程师阅读，可作为理解手机 GNSS 欺骗威胁建模与防御选型的入门与索引性材料。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 位置数据是移动端最敏感的一类资产，欺骗成功可静默篡改导航、时间基准与基于位置的风控判定。该综述提供面向手机受限环境的攻击效果分类与对抗技术比较框架，便于安全团队评估现有防护盲区与选型边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至移动终端反欺诈、基于位置的风控与授权、打车/外卖/共享出行合规、车机与车队定位、以及手机授时与金融交易时间戳等场景；也可用于评估 MDM/EMM 与 App 层位置校验策略的可靠性。
detection_signals_zh: 设备上报位置与基站/Wi-Fi/惯导等辅助定位源出现持续且系统性偏差
PVT 解算异常：定位跳变、速度与轨迹物理不可达、时间解与网络时间源不符
GNSS 观测质量指标异常（信噪比分布畸变、可见卫星数骤降、多径/一致性检验失败）
同一区域多台设备同时出现一致的错误定位，提示外部射频事件而非单机故障
defense_advice_zh: 对敏感业务实施多源定位交叉校验，不以 GNSS 单源作为唯一可信位置依据
在应用层引入位置合理性规则校验（轨迹连续性、速度上限、地理围栏一致性）
关注厂商 GNSS 芯片与固件层面的抗欺骗能力声明，将抗欺骗特性纳入终端采购与准入评估
在受控环境开展干扰/欺骗影响评估与红队测试，明确业务可接受的位置偏差阈值与降级策略
建立位置异常事件的日志留存与告警流程，便于事后取证与影响范围研判

items.title: Device-Independent Conference Keys from Parity-Extended Games
items.summary: Device-independent conference key agreement (DI-CKA) lets a group of parties establish a shared secret key from untrusted quantum devices, with security certified by non-locality. Existing DI-CKA protocols are each built around a single Bell inequality, typically a multiparty variant of the CHSH game. DI-QKD protocols, in contrast, have been built from a much richer landscape of non-local games, and it has remained unclear how to carry this landscape over to the conference setting. We introduce $\textit{Parity-$G$ games}$, which extend any two-player game $G$ to $N$ players, for every $N$, provided $G$ has an optimal strategy in which one player measures Pauli observables. The extension preserves the quantum and classical values of $G$, and the security of the resulting $N$-party protocol follows from an analysis of the two-player game alone. Our framework recovers the Parity-CHSH game of Ribeiro, Murta and Wehner (Phys. Rev. A, 2018) as a special case. Applied to the Mermin--Peres Magic Square Game, it yields a new $N$-player pseudo-telepathy game, the $\textit{Parity Magic Square Game}$, which ideal devices win in every round. We use it to construct the $\textit{first}$ DI-CKA protocol based on a pseudo-telepathy game. We prove the protocol secure against coherent attacks. It produces up to two key bits per round, and at low noise its key rate exceeds that of the DI-CKA protocol based on the Parity-CHSH game.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文研究的是设备无关会议密钥协商（Device-Independent Conference Key Agreement, DI-CKA）：一组（N 方）参与者在完全不信任其量子设备的前提下，仍需协商出一把共享密钥，其安全性由量子非局域性（non-locality）而非设备可信性来保证。这类协议的安全性分析与标准的 Bell 不等式违背直接挂钩，因此具有很高的理论价值，但也长期受制于可用的非局域博弈种类有限。作者指出，既有 DI-CKA 协议几乎都是围绕单一 Bell 不等式构造的，最典型的是多方 CHSH 博弈的变体；而在设备无关量子密钥分发（DI-QKD）领域，研究者早已使用了远为丰富的非局域博弈工具箱。长期以来不清楚的是：如何把 DI-QKD 中丰富的博弈构造方式迁移到多方会议场景，从而实现更高的密钥率或更广的协议族。

针对这一空白，作者提出了一类新的博弈构造，称为 Parity-G 博弈（Parity-G games）。其核心思想是：对任意一个两方博弈 G，只要 G 存在一种最优策略使得某一方测量 Pauli 可观测量，就可以把 G 扩展成任意 N 方的博弈。关键的技术性质有两个：一是该扩展同时保持原两方博弈 G 的量子值与经典值不变；二是扩展后 N 方协议的安全性可以仅通过分析原来的两方博弈来证明，这极大地简化了多方场景下的安全证明负担。作为一致性检验，该框架把 Ribeiro、Murta 与 Wehner（Phys. Rev. A, 2018）提出的 Parity-CHSH 博弈作为特例重新导出。

进一步，作者把该框架应用于 Mermin-Peres 魔方博弈（Magic Square Game），得到一个新的 N 方伪心灵感应（pseudo-telepathy）博弈，命名为 Parity Magic Square Game。其显著特点是理想的量子设备可以在每一轮都获胜，即经典设备无法做到而量子设备完美获胜。基于该博弈，作者构造了首个基于伪心灵感应博弈的 DI-CKA 协议，并证明该协议对相干攻击（coherent attacks）是安全的。性能方面，该协议每一轮最多可产生两个密钥比特，并且在低噪声条件下，其密钥率超过基于 Parity-CHSH 博弈的 DI-CKA 协议。

总体而言，这项工作把 DI-QKD 中成熟的非局域博弈设计方法系统性地推广到了多方会议密钥协商场景，提供了一个可复用的构造与安全归约框架，并给出了具体的新协议实例与密钥率优势。适合从事量子密码学、量子信息理论、设备无关安全协议设计的研究者阅读；对从事长期密码迁移规划、量子安全通信标准化评估的工程与安全团队也有间接参考价值。

defense_advice_zh: 将量子密钥协商与设备无关安全协议纳入长期密码敏捷性（crypto-agility）路线图的跟踪清单，关注其对现有多方密钥协商机制的潜在替代/补充作用。
关注后续工作是否从理论证明走向实验实现与协议参数落地，届时再评估对现有密钥管理体系的工程影响。
在量子安全通信标准化与内部评估中，记录此类多方 DI 协议的密钥率与噪声容忍度指标，作为未来选型参考。

items.title: Crossing the Cyber Divide: Sim-to-Sim and Sim-to-Real Transfer for RL Agents
items.summary: Cyber attack agents are typically trained and evaluated within a single simulator, making it unclear whether learned policies transfer beyond the environments in which they were developed. This limitation hinders both deployment and fair comparison, as cyber simulators differ substantially in their state representations, observation models, and action spaces. In this paper, we study policy transfer across cyber environments and argue that simulator-to-simulator and simulator-to-real transfer can be viewed as instances of the same underlying alignment problem. We propose a framework that separates state alignment from action translation, enabling a policy trained in one environment to operate in another without retraining. We evaluate transfer across four cyber platforms, CyberBattleSim, NetSecGame, CyberWheel, and NASim, including emulated deployments in NASim. Our experiments show that zero-shot transfer is feasible, fully preserving source-policy performance in closely aligned environments and achieving 45.2% win rates when transferring policies whose source performance is 60.5%. In emulated virtual machine environments, transferred policies exhibit a Jensen-Shannon divergence of 0.085 from native policies, indicating strong behavioral similarity. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RL-Transfer-between-env-4F47/.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究网络攻防强化学习智能体在不同仿真环境之间的策略迁移问题。现有网络攻击智能体通常只在单一模拟器中训练和评估，导致无法判断学到的策略能否迁移到其他环境，也妨碍部署与公平比较。作者指出，不同网络模拟器在状态表示、观测模型和动作空间方面差异显著，因此跨环境迁移本质上是一个对齐问题：仿真到仿真（sim-to-sim）与仿真到真实（sim-to-real）可以视为同一类底层挑战。为此，论文提出一个框架，将状态对齐与动作转换分离，使在一个环境中训练好的策略无需重新训练即可在另一个环境中运行。实验覆盖四个网络平台：CyberBattleSim、NetSecGame、CyberWheel 和 NASim，并包含 NASim 中的仿真虚拟机部署。结果表明，零样本迁移可行：在高度对齐的环境中，源策略性能可完全保持；当源策略胜率为 60.5% 时，迁移后仍能达到 45.2% 的胜率。在仿真虚拟机环境中，迁移策略与原生策略的 Jensen-Shannon 散度仅为 0.085，显示出较强的行为相似性。论文还提供了代码与基准，主要贡献在于提出跨环境策略迁移框架、构建多平台评估基准，并验证了零样本迁移和仿真到仿真/真实迁移的可行性。适合研究自主网络攻防智能体、强化学习环境标准化、策略泛化与安全仿真基准的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对蓝队而言，理解攻防RL策略跨环境迁移能力，有助于评估仿真训练成果能否外推到真实网络，避免高估或低估自主代理能力，并为红蓝对抗、自动化防御评估与跨平台基准建设提供参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响自主网络攻防智能体的训练、部署前评估与仿真平台可比性；可迁移到安全强化学习环境标准化、跨环境策略验证、红蓝对抗智能体泛化评估等场景。
detection_signals_zh: 迁移策略与原生策略的行为分布差异可通过 Jensen-Shannon 散度等指标监测
跨环境迁移后策略胜率变化可作为行为漂移的间接观测信号
多模拟器环境中动作空间与状态表示不一致可能导致异常或不稳定行为模式
defense_advice_zh: 在采用攻防RL智能体前，应进行跨环境或跨版本迁移验证，避免仅在单一模拟器上评估
将状态对齐与动作转换模块纳入策略部署审查，关注迁移后行为分布偏移
对仿真训练到真实环境的性能衰减建立基线，并结合行为相似性指标持续监测
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进；若团队使用网络攻防RL仿真，建议纳入内部评估，重点验证跨环境迁移风险与基准可比性

items.title: Need for Coherent Access in Constructing Quantum Cryptography
items.summary: We construct quantum oracles relative to which quantum-secure one-way functions (OWFs) exist but pseudorandom states (PRSs) with superlogarithmic output length do not. At first glance, this appears to contradict the known black-box constructions of PRS generators from quantum-secure OWFs. The distinction lies in the access model to the oracles; our oracle separation uses \emph{classical-accessible} random oracles that can be accessed only classically even by quantum algorithms. In fact, our impossibility of PRSs applies to \emph{any} classically accessible classical oracle in place of the random oracle, while keeping the other oracle component unchanged, showing the need for coherent access in constructing PRSs. We further show that logarithmic output length pseudorandom function-like states (PRFSs) exist relative to our oracles, giving an oracle separation between classically accessible logarithmic length PRFSs and superlogarithmic length PRSs. This shows that fully black-box PRS length extension from logarithmic to superlogarithmic output length must use coherent access to the underlying short PRS.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究量子密码学中伪随机态（PRS）构造的可实现性问题，属于量子计算复杂性理论中的黑盒分离（oracle separation）研究。已知结论表明，存在从量子安全单向函数（quantum-secure OWF）构造 PRS 生成器的黑盒构造方案，因此直觉上"存在量子安全 OWF"应当蕴含"存在 PRS"。本文作者 Minki Hhan、Changhun Oh、Vaughn Sohn 构造了一类量子 oracle，相对于该 oracle 同时满足两个条件：量子安全单向函数存在，但输出长度超过对数量级（superlogarithmic）的伪随机态（PRS）不存在。这表面上与已知的黑盒构造矛盾，作者指出关键在于对 oracle 的访问模型：他们的分离使用的是"经典可访问"（classical-accessible）的随机 oracle，即即便是量子算法也只能以经典方式查询该 oracle，无法进行量子叠加式（相干）查询。作者进一步证明，这一 PRS 的不可能性结论实际上适用于替换随机 oracle 的任意经典可访问经典 oracle，而保持 oracle 的另一组成部分不变，从而说明构造 PRS 必须依赖相干访问（coherent access）能力。此外，作者证明相对于同一组 oracle，对数量级输出长度的伪随机函数类态（PRFS）是存在的，由此给出"经典可访问的对数长度 PRFS"与"超对数长度 PRS"之间的 oracle 分离。综合这些结果，论文表明：任何完全黑盒的、把 PRS 输出长度从对数量级扩展到超对数长度的构造，都必须对底层的短 PRS 使用相干访问。该工作厘清了量子密码原语黑盒构造中访问模型（经典 vs 相干）这一此前被忽视的关键维度，对理解 PRS/PRFS 与 OWF 之间的相对关系、以及量子密码安全性归约的边界具有理论意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它指出黑盒归约中"经典访问 vs 相干访问"的差异会导致结论反转，提醒安全工程师：量子时代原语的安全性证明与构造假设不能想当然地沿用传统黑盒直觉，需重新审视依赖经典访问随机预言机的方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响量子密码理论层面对 PRS、PRFS、OWF 之间构造关系与安全性归约的理解；对基于随机预言机模型的协议设计与安全性论证的严谨性提出更高要求，短期内不直接影响现网部署系统的可利用性。
defense_advice_zh: 在评估后量子/量子密码方案的证明时，明确区分 oracle 是经典可访问还是允许相干访问，避免误用黑盒分离结论。
关注过度依赖随机预言机模型（ROM/QROM）且未讨论访问模型的密码构造，将其列入技术观察清单。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Quantum Secret Sharing and Error Correction vs No-Cloning
items.summary: Secret sharing is ubiquitous throughout cryptography. All possible access structures are classically feasible, and in the case of threshold access structures, the protocols are even very efficient. However, when moving to the quantum setting, the no-cloning theorem shows that many access structures are impossible. In fact, no-cloning exactly characterizes feasibility: for thresholds, quantum secret sharing is possible if and only if the threshold $t$ is strictly more than $n/2$. In this work, we propose a variant of quantum secret sharing (QSS) where two or more identical copies of the input state are provided, but the output is only required to recover one copy. This notion circumvents the simple one-copy no-cloning obstruction, though the natural $k$-copy generalization still gives much milder obstructions. For thresholds using $k$ copies, no-cloning implies that QSS is impossible whenever $t\leq n/(k+1)$. It is tempting to hypothesize that no-cloning continues to exactly characterize the many-copy case. However, we show that this is not the case. We give positive results showing that multiple copies allow for going slightly beyond the single-copy obstruction: for thresholds, we construct QSS whenever $t>(n-k+1)/2$. On the other hand, we give a novel obstruction we call the Clique Path obstruction, which applies to arbitrary access structures. For thresholds, it shows that QSS is impossible whenever $t\leq (n-1)/k$. Our upper and lower bounds exactly match for $k=2$. Both our results leverage connections to the $k$-colorability of certain graphs derived from the access structure. We leave closing the gap for $k\geq 3$ copies as a fascinating direction for future work. Secret sharing is closely related to error correction, which can also be considered in the many-copy setting. Our results imply similar obstructions for quantum error correction for erasure channels.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究量子秘密共享（QSS）在「多份输入副本」设定下的可行性与不可能性边界。经典秘密共享中，任意访问结构都可行，阈值结构更有高效协议；但进入量子设定后，不可克隆定理（no-cloning）使大量访问结构变得不可能，而且对阈值结构而言，不可克隆恰好刻画了可行性：当且仅当阈值 t > n/2 时 QSS 可行。作者提出一种 QSS 变体：允许提供两份或多份输入量子态的相同副本，但只要求输出恢复其中一份副本。这一松弛绕开了单副本下最直接的不可克隆障碍，不过 k 副本的自然推广仍带来较弱障碍——由不可克隆可推出当 t ≤ n/(k+1) 时 QSS 不可能。一个自然的猜想是：不可克隆仍精确刻画多副本情形，但作者证明该猜想不成立。正面结果：对阈值结构，当 t > (n-k+1)/2 时给出 QSS 构造，说明多副本能略微突破单副本障碍。负面结果：提出一种新的「团路径障碍」（Clique Path obstruction），适用于任意访问结构；对阈值结构，它证明当 t ≤ (n-1)/k 时 QSS 不可能。k=2 时上下界完全吻合。两项结果都利用了访问结构所导出图的 k-可着色性这一联系。k≥3 的间隙仍未闭合，作者将其列为未来方向。由于秘密共享与纠错码密切相关，上述结论也意味着擦除信道上量子纠错在同类多副本设定中存在类似障碍。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 不可克隆是量子密码学的根本约束。该工作精确划定量子秘密共享与擦除信道纠错在「多副本」松弛下的可行边界，并提出新的组合型下界（团路径障碍）。它对评估量子秘密共享/容错方案的设计极限与安全假设有理论指导意义，但不构成对现实系统的直接攻击面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响量子秘密共享与擦除信道量子纠错的理论可行性边界，尤其涉及阈值访问结构的参数选型与协议设计假设；对经典密码协议与当前生产系统无直接现实影响。
defense_advice_zh: 关注该理论边界对量子秘密共享/容错方案设计假设的长期影响，在选型评估中记录多副本与单副本模型的能力差异。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Robust and leakage-resilient device-independent oblivious transfer in MiniQCryp
items.summary: Assuming post-quantum one-way functions, we construct device-independent (DI) oblivious transfer (OT) and bit commitment: honest parties use only trusted classical computation to operate untrusted quantum devices, which may share arbitrary entanglement and behave non-IID. Security is simulation-based against quantum polynomial-time adversaries and composes sequentially with efficient simulators. One protocol skeleton serves both, in two regimes. With isolated laboratories and coordinate-local measurements in the honest receiver's device, it tolerates a constant rate of honest-device faults. With polylogarithmically many qubits of adaptive leakage between the laboratories and arbitrary joint measurements, it tolerates an inverse-polylogarithmic rate. Each elementary DI call uses a fresh, isolated batch of polylogarithmically many device coordinates, and total device use in the compiled OT protocol is polynomial. The commitment has efficient simulators against both parties and yields DI coin tossing with abort. Because OT is complete for secure computation, the construction yields a DI protocol, with abort, for every efficiently computable classical functionality on a fixed number of parties, secure against static corruption of any proper subset of them. The commitment's extractor changes a public parity relation through classical equivocation and leaves the device execution, hence its leakage, unchanged. A commit-and-prove functionality, disjoint audits, and an affine consistency check link the certified correlations to ideal OT. Sender security rests on a selector-aware parallel-repetition bound for the Magic Square game, which we derive from the two-round threshold theorem of Kundu and Tan.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文在 MiniQCryp 框架下构造了设备无关（DI）的不经意传输（OT）与比特承诺协议，其唯一计算假设是存在后量子单向函数。其核心安全模型是：诚实参与方只使用可信的经典计算来驱动不可信的量子设备，而这些设备之间可以预先共享任意纠缠，并且其行为可以是非独立同分布（non-IID）的，即不要求设备行为按轮次独立或同分布。安全性采用基于模拟（simulation-based）的定义，针对量子多项式时间敌手，并具备顺序可组合性且模拟器是高效的。论文的亮点在于用同一套协议骨架同时实现 OT 与比特承诺，并在两种不同资源假设下给出安全性：第一种情形是各实验室相互隔离、且诚实接收方设备只做坐标局域测量，此时协议可容忍诚实设备以恒定比例发生故障；第二种情形是实验室之间存在多对数数量级量子比特的自适应泄漏、并允许任意联合测量，此时可容忍多对数倒数比例的故障率。每次基本 DI 调用都使用一批全新的、相互隔离的多对数数量级设备坐标，编译后的 OT 协议对设备的总使用量仅为多项式级。比特承诺对双方都具备高效模拟器，并可由此导出带中止（abort）的 DI 抛硬币协议。由于 OT 对安全计算是完备的，该构造进一步给出了面向固定参与方数量、任意高效可计算经典功能的带中止 DI 协议，且可抵抗对任意真子集参与方的静态腐化。技术路线上，承诺的提取器通过经典“模糊化/等价化”（equivocation）手段改变一个公开的奇偶关系，同时保持设备执行过程不变，因而不会引入额外泄漏；作者还引入 commit-and-prove 功能、不相交审计（disjoint audits）以及仿射一致性检查，把被认证的关联与被理想化的 OT 绑定起来。发送方安全性依赖作者为 Magic Square 游戏推导出的“选择器感知”（selector-aware）并行重复界，该界从 Kundu 与 Tan 的两轮阈值定理导出。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 设备无关密码学是后量子时代抵御硬件后门与侧信道泄漏的重要理论防线。该工作首次把实验室间泄漏、非 IID 设备行为与通用安全计算（OT 完备性）统一到同一构造中，为“只用可信经典计算驱动不可信量子硬件”的信任模型提供了完整可行性证据。但属理论研究，短期内无直接部署价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响量子安全基础设施的信任假设设计、量子硬件供应链风险评估，以及长期保密性要求下的多方安全计算路线图；可迁移至需要容忍设备被俘获或存在跨机房泄漏的密码协议评估场景。
defense_advice_zh: 在量子硬件采购与集成评估中，将“设备不可信/可被植入纠缠”纳入威胁建模，而非默认设备可信。
关注跨实验室（跨机房）量子比特泄漏这一新引入的侧信道维度，评估其对现有量子密钥分发与量子随机数方案的信任边界影响。
将该类构造列入密码敏捷性（crypto-agility）长期规划的研究清单，明确其为理论可行性论证，不应作为近期产品化承诺。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: MultiTable: A Faster Hash Table at any Physical Load Factor up to and Including One
items.summary: We present \emph{multitable} and its Rust reference implementation: a stable hash table both materially faster at equal physical memory and more flexible than the SwissTable in its Rust's hashbrown implementation. As an arithmetic mean over 84 configurations it delivers $\mathbf{2.1\times}$ hashbrown's throughput when both hash the same raw bytes and $\mathbf{1.9\times}$ when hashbrown is keyed on native integers, its best case; on negative lookups alone, $3.2\times$ and $2.9\times$. Multitable reaches \textbf{any physical load factor} up to and \textbf{including one} ($0.9999$ demonstrated), exactly for the requested capacity, compared to hashbrown which doubles at $0.777$ for 4-byte keys and values. At $75\%$ saturation of hashbrown (assumed average case of its rigid ladder) and multitable sized to $0.97$ physical load factor, hashbrown takes $66\%$ more space. The lookup probe count has no cliff as the load factor approaches one. Bucket size, physical load factor, and failure budget are parameters, and the multitable can be grown without rehashing. We implement two variants of multitable: plain and filtered. At equal physical memory on an Apple M2 Pro the filtered multitable leads hashbrown in all $84$ insert, hit, and miss configurations. Multitable is more \textbf{memory-efficient}, at equal mixed-lookup throughput on the map of $4$-byte keys and values the filtered multitable needs up to $12\%$ fewer bytes than hashbrown, and the plain multitable is $18\%$ smaller, holding $\mathbf{22\%}$ more keys in the same memory.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为 multitable 的新型哈希表结构，并给出了 Rust 参考实现。作者要解决的核心问题是：现有主流工程实现（以 Rust 生态中 hashbrown 所采用的 SwissTable 为代表）在物理负载因子上受到刚性阶梯限制——当键和值均为 4 字节时，hashbrown 在装载率达到 0.777 时就必须整体扩容一倍，导致在接近饱和时要么浪费大量内存，要么被迫提前扩容。multitable 的设计目标是在同等物理内存开销下同时实现更高吞吐与更高灵活性。其关键思想是把桶大小（bucket size）、物理负载因子（physical load factor）和失败预算（failure budget）都提升为可调参数，从而支持任意物理负载因子，最高可达并包含 1（论文演示到 0.9999），并且容量可以按请求的实际大小精确分配；此外，multitable 还支持在扩容（grow）时无需对整个表重新哈希（rehash），并保持稳定（stable）语义。论文实现了 plain 与 filtered 两个变体。在 Apple M2 Pro 平台对 84 组插入、命中（hit）和未命中（miss）配置取算术平均后，filtered multitable 在相同物理内存下全面领先 hashbrown；在对相同原始字节做哈希时吞吐为 hashbrown 的 2.1 倍，在 hashbrown 使用原生整数键这一其最佳情形下仍为 1.9 倍；仅看负向查找（negative lookup，即未命中查询）则分别为 3.2 倍和 2.9 倍。论文还强调，随着负载因子逼近 1，查找所需的探测次数（probe count）不存在突变性的“悬崖”。在空间效率方面，当 hashbrown 处于其刚性阶梯所假定的 75% 饱和度、multitable 取 0.97 物理负载因子时，hashbrown 多占用 66% 的空间；在 4 字节键值映射上达到相同混合查找吞吐时，filtered multitable 最多可比 hashbrown 少用 12% 字节，plain multitable 则小 18%，并可在相同内存中多容纳 22% 的键。论文属于数据结构与算法（cs.DS）方向，配有组合数学与概率论（math.CO、math.PR）角度的分析。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 哈希表是高吞吐数据面、缓存、索引与日志管线的底层组件。该工作表明在接近饱和的负载因子下仍可保持吞吐且无探测悬崖，对内存受限场景的性能与容量规划有直接参考价值，也提示防御方重新审视基于负载因子的容量与失败预算假设。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至高吞吐网络中间件、DPI/流表、内存型缓存与索引、可观测性日志聚合等对内存效率与查找延迟敏感的场景；也可用于重新评估自研哈希结构在极端负载下的表现。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并由平台/基础库团队评估在内存受限的高吞吐服务中替换或对标现有哈希表实现的可行性

items.title: System-Level Optimization Beyond Cryptographic Kernels: An ML-KEM Case Study on Arm Cortex-M7
items.summary: Recent work on embedded post-quantum cryptography has focused primarily on instruction-level optimization, including arithmetic-kernel improvements, assembly tuning, register allocation, and instruction scheduling. Using the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) on an Arm Cortex-M7 as a case study, we examine the additional gains available from memory-hierarchy utilization, tightly coupled memory placement, peripheral integration, clock configuration, and deterministic public-data reuse. The evaluation starts from a state-of-the-art SLOTHY-optimized implementation and covers all three ML-KEM parameter sets. Without modifying the cryptographic algorithm or standardized wire formats, the evaluated profiles without auxiliary public state reduce cycles by up to 2.5%. A selected public-data-reuse profile reduces encapsulation and decapsulation cycles by up to 74.6% and 58.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate that substantial deployment gains remain after arithmetic-kernel optimization and motivate a two-stage methodology that also examines the surrounding execution system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究嵌入式后量子密码在 Arm Cortex-M7 平台上的系统级优化空间。背景是：此前嵌入式 PQC 实现的工作几乎全部集中在指令级层面，包括算术内核改进、手写汇编调优、寄存器分配与指令调度（典型代表是基于 SLOTHY 的自动化汇编优化）。作者以 ML-KEM（模块格基密钥封装机制，即 NIST 标准化的 Kyber 系算法）为案例，指出在算术内核已接近最优、优化收益趋于饱和之后，仍可从“执行系统”层面获得可观性能收益，具体考察四个方向：内存层次利用（例如紧耦合内存 ITCM/DTCM 的代码与数据放置、缓存与访问模式安排）、外设集成（借助硬件外设分担运算与外设事务）、时钟与存储子系统配置（主频、闪存等待周期、预取与加速器设置）、以及确定性公开数据的复用（不再在每次操作中重新生成公开矩阵等公开状态，而是缓存并重复使用）。实验以当前最先进的 SLOTHY 优化实现作为基线，覆盖 ML-KEM 全部三组参数集（ML-KEM-512/768/1024）。在不修改密码算法、也不改变标准化线上格式（因而不影响互操作性）的前提下，不引入辅助公开状态的配置最多可减少约 2.5% 的周期数；而启用所选公开数据复用配置后，封装与解封装周期数分别最多降低约 74.6% 与 58.8%。论文据此提出一个两阶段方法论：第一阶段做算术内核优化，第二阶段系统性地审视并调优周边执行系统。该工作对嵌入式密码实现者、PQC 迁移团队以及安全芯片/固件工程师具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: PQC 迁移到嵌入式设备的瓶颈往往不是算法本身，而是性能、延迟与资源占用。该研究表明在汇编内核优化接近见顶后，系统级配置仍可能带来数量级可观的收益（封装周期最多降约 75%），对资源受限终端的 ML-KEM 落地、选型与性能预算有直接参考意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到所有资源受限的 PQC 部署场景：IoT 终端、车载 ECU、工业控制器、安全元件与安全启动链路中的 ML-KEM/ML-DSA 实现。需注意公开数据复用虽然显著提速，但会增加常驻内存占用，并改变内存残留、缓存与访问模式特征，可能影响 MPU 隔离策略与侧信道评估结论。
defense_advice_zh: 在自研或采买嵌入式 ML-KEM 实现时，除核对算术内核指标外，应把内存放置（TCM/缓存）、时钟与闪存等待周期、外设协同等系统级配置纳入基准测试项。
若采用公开数据复用等优化，需同步复核其常驻内存占用、内存残留与访问模式变化，重新评估侧信道与故障注入风险，并确认未影响 MPU 隔离边界。
坚持互操作性回归测试：确认优化仅作用于本地执行路径，未改动标准化线上格式与密钥/密文编码。
对第三方提供的“加速版”PQC 库，要求其说明优化层级与是否复用公开状态，避免不可审计的隐式状态与内存暴露。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Query-Limited RAM Programs and their Applications
items.summary: Quantum one-time programs (Broadbent, Gutoski and Stebila, CRYPTO 2013) or OTPs for short, enable a functionality to be encoded into a quantum token that can be evaluated on a single chosen input and then becomes unusable. While powerful, this primitive is inherently stateless and tied to a setting in which a quantum token needs to be issued and distributed for every single evaluation of a circuit. This raises a natural question: can the one-time computation paradigm be extended to richer, stateful forms of controlled access, and would such an extension offer inherent advantages beyond standard OTPs? We introduce $\textit{query-limited RAM programs}$ (QLPs), a RAM-generalization of QOTPs that supports structured, stateful computation under bounded or policy-driven access. QLPs allow controlled sequences of evaluations while preventing adversarial forking or rollback of computational state. This enables new applications beyond stateless one-time programs, including quantum tokens for Turing Machines whose size depends only on $\textit{code length}$ (and not runtime), transferable $k$-time or budget-limited programs, and low-communication mechanisms for delegating computation in settings such as Software-as-a-Service. To construct QLPs, we introduce $\textit{one-shot programs}$, unifying one-shot signatures (Amos, Georgiou, Kiayias and Zhandry, STOC 2020) with the single effective query paradigm (Gupte, Liu, Raizes, Roberts and Vaikuntanathan, STOC 2025). We prove that one-shot programs generically imply query-limited programs, demonstrating that the strengthened unclonability guarantees of one-shot signatures translate into enhanced functionality. Along the way, we clarify the relationship between signature-token primitives and quantum one-time programs via generic constructions, essentially showing that one-time signing programs imply one-time general computation.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文研究量子密码学中一次性程序（one-time program, OTP）范式的推广问题。量子一次性程序（QOTP，由 Broadbent、Gutoski 与 Stebila 在 CRYPTO 2013 提出）能把某一功能编码进一个量子令牌，持有者只能在单个选定输入上求值一次，求值后令牌即失效、不可再次使用。该原语能力很强，但本质上是无状态的，且其设定要求针对电路的每一次求值都重新签发并分发一个量子令牌，部署代价高、扩展性差。由此引出核心问题：能否把一次性计算范式扩展到更丰富、带状态的受控访问形式，且这种扩展是否能带来超出标准 OTP 的固有优势？

为此，作者提出查询受限 RAM 程序（query-limited RAM programs, QLP），它是 QOTP 在随机存取机（RAM）模型上的推广，支持在有界或由策略驱动的访问次数下执行结构化的、有状态的计算。QLP 的关键安全性质是：允许受控的多次求值序列，同时防止敌手对计算状态进行分叉（forking）或回滚（rollback）。作者指出，这种状态化能力带来了无状态一次性程序无法实现的新应用，包括：规模仅取决于代码长度（而非运行时间）的图灵机量子令牌、可转让的 k 次或预算受限程序，以及在软件即服务（SaaS）等场景下低通信开销的计算委托机制。

在构造层面，作者引入「一次性程序」（one-shot programs）这一中间原语，将一次性签名（one-shot signatures，Amos、Georgiou、Kiayias 与 Zhandry，STOC 2020）与「单次有效查询」范式（single effective query paradigm，Gupte、Liu、Raizes、Roberts 与 Vaikuntanathan，STOC 2025）统一起来。作者证明：一次性程序可以通用地（generically）蕴含查询受限程序，说明一次性签名更强的不可克隆性保证能够转化为更强的功能。论文还通过通用构造厘清了签名—令牌类原语与量子一次性程序之间的关系，本质上证明了「一次性签名程序可蕴含一次性通用计算」，并借此界定了若干原语之间的蕴含结构。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为量子密码学与委托计算研究提供有状态受控访问的理论框架，界定了一次性签名与原语间蕴含关系；短期无直接防御落地，属长期理论储备。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响量子密码学、不可克隆性与委托计算的理论研究；长期可迁移到量子云服务、SaaS 计算委托、k 次或预算受限的软件授权等场景设计。
defense_advice_zh: 关注量子云计算委托场景中的授权状态管理与回滚防护设计思路

items.title: LaraDashboard from 1.4.0 before 1.4.8 contains a race condition vulnerability in RegisterController::register that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the per-IP daily re...
items.summary: LaraDashboard from 1.4.0 before 1.4.8 contains a race condition vulnerability in RegisterController::register that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the per-IP daily registration limit. Attackers can send many concurrent registration requests from one IP so all pass RegistrationGuardService::hasExceededIpLimit before recordRegistration runs, creating accounts in bulk and defeating anti-automation controls.

llm_summary.summary_zh: LaraDashboard 在 1.4.0 起至 1.4.8 之前的版本中，注册流程 RegisterController::register 存在竞态条件（race condition）问题。该组件原本设计了基于来源 IP 的每日注册次数上限，用来对抗自动化批量注册：处理注册请求时会先调用 RegistrationGuardService::hasExceededIpLimit 判断该 IP 当天是否已超过配额，若未超过则继续处理，随后再通过 recordRegistration 记录本次注册并累加计数。问题在于“检查”和“记录”两个动作之间存在时间窗口，且并非原子操作。未认证的远程攻击者可以在极短时间内从同一个 IP 并发提交大量注册请求，使得多条请求几乎同时进入流程，在 recordRegistration 真正写入计数之前全部通过 hasExceededIpLimit 检查，从而一次性创建远超每日配额的账号。攻击者由此可批量注册账户，绕过站点部署的防自动化控制，进而可能被用于垃圾内容投放、资源滥用、账号囤积或作为后续滥用行为的跳板。由于攻击者无需认证、仅需网络可达即可触发，且并发请求在网络层面容易实施，该问题在实际部署中具备可操作性。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 3.7，向量为 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N，表明攻击复杂度较高、仅造成低级别完整性影响，机密性与可用性不受影响，整体风险等级为低危。官方已在 1.4.8 版本中修复，受影响范围为 1.4.0 至 1.4.8 之前的所有版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该缺陷让未认证攻击者可通过并发请求绕过按 IP 的每日注册上限，批量创建账号，使防自动化机制失效；虽 CVSS 仅 3.7 且未列入 KEV、无在野利用证据，仍属应纳入常规修复节奏的配置与业务逻辑缺陷。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 完整性低影响（I:L），机密性与可用性不受影响；可被滥用于批量注册账号、垃圾内容投放与资源消耗，削弱站点反自动化控制。攻击复杂度高（AC:H），需并发时序配合，但无需认证与用户交互，网络可达即可尝试。

items.title: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with only settings.view permission to read stored secrets through th...
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with only settings.view permission to read stored secrets through the settings API. Attackers can query GET /api/settings or /api/settings/{option_name} to retrieve plaintext AI provider API keys, mail credentials, passwords and tokens.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-105129 是披露于 LaraDashboard 1.4.8 之前版本的授权校验缺陷（不当授权 / 访问控制不足，CWE-863 类问题）。LaraDashboard 是构建在 Laravel 之上的后台管理面板组件，其「设置（settings）」模块将应用级配置集中存储并对外提供读取接口。问题在于：该读取逻辑只校验用户是否具备 settings.view 这一较低权限，而没有进一步区分「可以查看配置项结构」与「可以查看配置项明文值」，也没有对敏感字段做脱敏过滤。因此，任何已通过身份认证、仅被授予设置查看权限的普通账号（例如只读运维、审计或第三方集成账号），都可以通过调用设置读取接口，批量取回以明文形式存储的敏感配置，包括 AI 服务商的 API Key、邮件（SMTP/IMAP）凭据、各类密码以及访问令牌。攻击者无需管理员权限，也不需要用户交互，仅凭一个低权限账号即可完成信息收集。按 CVSS 3.1 评估为 6.5（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N），风险集中于机密性——完整性、可用性不受影响。官方在 1.4.8 版本中修复了该授权判断。当前该 CVE 未列入 KEV，来源字段也未标记在野利用，且暂无 EPSS 评分，属于「应尽快修复但尚未见公开利用」的类别。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 任何拥有低权限设置查看账号的人都能读到明文密钥与口令，属于典型的越权导致大规模凭据泄露；凭据一旦外泄可直接用于横向移动或冒充第三方服务，且此类读取行为通常不会触发告警。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 受影响系统存储的 AI 服务商 API Key、邮件账号口令、系统密码和访问令牌可能被低权限认证用户批量读取，造成凭据泄露与后续横向访问风险；不涉及数据篡改或服务中断。鉴于未列入 KEV 且无在野利用标记，暂不认定为已被利用。

items.title: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows authenticated Admin users to escalate to Superadmin by editing or renaming roles. ...
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows authenticated Admin users to escalate to Superadmin by editing or renaming roles. Attackers with role.edit can rename their role to Superadmin or grant user.login_as permissions to take over accounts and reach core upgrade and module installation functions for code execution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: LaraDashboard 是一款基于 Laravel 的后台管理面板。在 1.4.8 版本之前，存在不正确的权限管理漏洞。经过身份验证的 Admin 用户（拥有 role.edit 权限）可以通过编辑或重命名角色来提升权限。具体而言，攻击者可将自己的角色重命名为 Superadmin，或者授予 user.login_as 权限，从而接管其他账户，并进一步访问核心升级和模块安装功能，最终可能导致代码执行。该漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.2，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H，表明攻击者可远程利用，但需要高权限（已认证的 Admin）。目前该漏洞未被列入 CISA KEV，也无公开的在野利用报告。影响产品为 LaraDashboard < 1.4.8，厂商信息未提供。风险在于权限提升至 Superadmin 后，攻击者可完全控制应用，安装恶意模块或升级包，实现远程代码执行，严重威胁数据机密性、完整性和可用性。建议尽快升级至 1.4.8 或更高版本，并限制后台访问来源，审计现有角色和权限分配。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许已认证的 Admin 用户通过角色编辑提升至 Superadmin，进而可能实现代码执行。CVSS 7.2 属于高危，虽然需要较高权限，但一旦被利用后果严重，且补丁已发布，应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可提升权限至 Superadmin，接管任意账户，访问核心升级和模块安装功能，导致远程代码执行、数据泄露或系统完全失控。

items.title: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read JSON files by manipulating the {lang} route segment. On Windows ...
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.4.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read JSON files by manipulating the {lang} route segment. On Windows hosts, attackers can send URL-encoded backslash sequences like ..%5C to escape resources/lang and read composer.json or other application JSON files.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
LaraDashboard 是一个基于 Laravel 框架的后台仪表盘组件。根据 NVD 元数据，该组件在 1.4.8 之前的版本中存在一处路径穿越（Path Traversal）漏洞。漏洞的触发点位于应用路由中的 {lang} 路径段：该参数在拼接语言资源文件路径时未对用户输入做充分的规范化与白名单校验，导致攻击者可以构造包含目录跳转序列的请求，从预期的 resources/lang 目录中逃逸，进而在服务器文件系统上读取 JSON 格式的文件。

该漏洞的一个关键特征是其平台相关性。在 Windows 主机上，攻击者可以发送经过 URL 编码的反斜杠序列（如 ..%5C）来绕过基于正斜杠的路径校验逻辑，从而成功实现目录穿越；由于 Windows 同时接受正斜杠与反斜杠作为路径分隔符，这类混合分隔符的输入往往能绕过仅针对 ../ 做过滤的实现。借助该手法，未认证的远程攻击者可以读取应用根目录下的 composer.json，或其它包含敏感信息的 JSON 文件。

从影响面看，成功利用后的直接后果是信息泄露，其中 composer.json 会暴露项目所依赖的 PHP 组件及其精确版本号，这类信息对攻击者后续挑选已知漏洞、构造更进一步的攻击链具有较高价值；其它应用 JSON 文件也可能包含配置项、密钥标识或内部结构信息。漏洞不会直接导致数据被篡改或服务中断。

CVSS 3.1 评分为 3.7（低危），向量为 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N。其含义是：攻击者可通过网络远程发起、无需任何身份认证（PR:N）、无需用户交互（UI:N）；但攻击复杂度被判定为高（AC:H），主要因为利用效果依赖目标运行在 Windows 环境并依赖特定路径解析行为；影响范围仅限机密性且程度为低（C:L），完整性与可用性均不受影响。EPSS 分值在给定数据中缺失，该 CVE 未被列入 CISA KEV，来源字段也未标记存在在野利用，因此当前没有可引用的野外利用证据。

整体判断：这是一个利用条件较窄、危害等级偏低的路径穿越信息泄露问题，适用于以 Windows 为宿主环境、且管理后台对外可达的 LaraDashboard 部署。风险主要来自‘未认证可远程访问’与‘泄露依赖清单’两大因素的组合，而非直接的数据破坏能力。运营方应优先确认自身是否满足 Windows + 对外暴露这两个前提条件，再据此决定处置优先级。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未认证远程攻击者即可读取 composer.json 等 JSON 文件，泄露依赖版本与内部配置，为后续攻击提供情报。虽然 CVSS 仅 3.7 且利用依赖 Windows 环境，但管理后台若直接暴露在互联网上，仍属于应尽快修复的配置型缺陷。当前无 KEV 列入、无在野利用证据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 仅影响机密性（C:L），可导致 resources/lang 目录外的 JSON 文件被未认证读取，典型目标为 composer.json 及类似应用 JSON 文件；不涉及数据篡改或服务中断。利用成功的前提是目标运行于 Windows 且 {lang} 路由可被未认证访问。

items.why_it_matters: 未认证远程攻击者即可读取 composer.json 等 JSON 文件，泄露依赖版本与内部配置，为后续攻击提供情报。虽然 CVSS 仅 3.7 且利用依赖 Windows 环境，但管理后台若直接暴露在互联网上，仍属于应尽快修复的配置型缺陷。当前无 KEV 列入、无在野利用证据。

items.title: W (vincent-peugnet/wcms) through 3.18.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated editors to write arbitrary files by abusing the unvalidated path...
items.summary: W (vincent-peugnet/wcms) through 3.18.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated editors to write arbitrary files by abusing the unvalidated path in POST /api/v0/media/upload/[*:path]. Attackers can upload .php files executed by the web server, use encoded ../ sequences to write outside the media directory, and delete arbitrary files via DELETE /api/v0/media/[*:path].

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-105123 是影响开源轻量级 CMS 项目 W（代码库 vincent-peugnet/wcms）的一个远程代码执行漏洞，波及 3.18.0 及之前的所有版本。问题根因在于媒体管理 API 对路由中的路径参数缺乏校验：上传接口 POST /api/v0/media/upload/[*:path] 直接把用户可控的路径拼接到服务端文件写入操作中，而删除接口 DELETE /api/v0/media/[*:path] 存在同类缺陷。利用该缺陷的准入门槛并不高——攻击者只需拥有一个已通过认证的编辑者（editor）账号，即可绕过媒体目录的边界限制，向服务器文件系统写入任意文件，也能删除任意文件。写入任意文件的能力可进一步升级为远程代码执行：若把可被 Web 服务器解释执行的文件放入可访问目录，服务端会将其当作正常内容处理并执行，从而使低权限的编辑者获得对主机的命令执行能力。目录跳出序列（编码形式的相对路径）可让写操作落到媒体目录之外，进一步扩大影响面。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 8.8（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），机密性、完整性、可用性三项均为高影响，攻击向量为网络、复杂度低、无需用户交互，唯一明显的限制条件是攻击者需要先取得低权限的编辑者身份。目前 NVD 元数据中未将该漏洞列入 KEV，也未标注已在野利用或已武器化，因此应将其视为一个高危但尚未确认被主动利用的问题来处理。对于部署了 wcms 3.18.0 及更早版本、且对外暴露媒体 API 的站点，风险尤为突出：编辑者账号在多数内容型站点中往往由多人共享或外包维护，一旦其中一个账号被攻陷或滥用，即可能演变为整站乃至宿主机的完全失陷。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 低权限的已认证编辑者即可写入并执行任意文件，等同于把服务器控制权交给了内容编辑角色，权限边界形同虚设。对公网暴露 wcms 后台的站点而言，只要存在一个被攻陷或被滥用的编辑者账号，就可能直接导致整站与宿主机失陷。当前未确认在野利用，但建议按高危处理。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致服务器文件系统任意写入与任意删除，并可进一步实现远程代码执行，造成数据篡改与破坏、站点被植入恶意内容、服务器被完全接管；机密性、完整性与可用性均受高影响。

items.why_it_matters: 低权限的已认证编辑者即可写入并执行任意文件，等同于把服务器控制权交给了内容编辑角色，权限边界形同虚设。对公网暴露 wcms 后台的站点而言，只要存在一个被攻陷或被滥用的编辑者账号，就可能直接导致整站与宿主机失陷。当前未确认在野利用，但建议按高危处理。

items.title: Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Themeum Kirki kirki allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs.This issue affects Kirki:...
items.summary: Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in Themeum Kirki kirki allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs.This issue affects Kirki: from n/a through 6.3.1.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-103065 影响 WordPress 生态中广泛使用的定制器框架库 Themeum Kirki（Kirki），影响范围为 6.3.1 及之前的全部版本。该漏洞被归类为「输入中指定数量验证不当」（Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input），并由此导致「访问未被 ACL 正确约束的功能」——即攻击者可通过构造输入触发本应受权限控制、仅对特定角色或上下文开放的内部功能，绕过预期的访问控制边界。由于 Kirki 常被大量商业主题与插件作为依赖引入，一旦相关入口可被匿名触达，风险会随安装基数放大。CVSS v3.1 评分为 8.2（高危），向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N，含义为网络可达、攻击复杂度低、无需任何认证与用户交互、作用域不变，机密性影响为高、完整性影响为低、可用性无影响；最典型后果是敏感数据或配置信息泄露，而非站点完全被控或服务中断。需强调：评分仅反映潜在严重性，不代表实际可达性，真实风险取决于目标站点是否暴露相关接口、是否运行受影响版本以及外围加固情况。截至本次情报整理，NVD 元数据未将该漏洞列入 CISA KEV，也没有任何来源标记为已在野利用，EPSS 分值缺失，因此不应描述为已武器化或正被大规模利用。当前置信度仅为元数据级，尚无独立厂商安全公告细节可供交叉验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Kirki 被大量 WordPress 主题与插件依赖，漏洞无需认证即可远程触发，可能泄露敏感配置数据。CVSS 8.2 属高危，未列入 KEV 且无在野利用标记，应优先排查暴露面并按计划升级。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 未认证攻击者可能绕过访问控制调用受限制功能，造成高机密性影响（敏感数据/配置泄露）与低完整性影响，不影响可用性。迄今无在野利用证据。

items.why_it_matters: Kirki 被大量 WordPress 主题与插件依赖，漏洞无需认证即可远程触发，可能泄露敏感配置数据。CVSS 8.2 属高危，未列入 KEV 且无在野利用标记，应优先排查暴露面并按计划升级。

items.title: OpenAM before 16.1.3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows delegated administrators to destroy sessions outside their realms because realm checks use the ...
items.summary: OpenAM before 16.1.3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows delegated administrators to destroy sessions outside their realms because realm checks use the requester's realm. Authenticated accounts holding the iplanet-am-session-destroy-sessions attribute can supply a target session identifier or handle to forcibly log out users in any realm.

llm_summary.summary_zh: OpenAM 16.1.3 之前版本存在不当授权（授权校验逻辑缺陷）问题。核心成因在于：系统在判断“销毁其他用户会话”这一高权限操作是否越过 realm 边界时，比对的是【发起请求者自身所属 realm】与目标 realm，而不是【被销毁的目标会话所属 realm】。这个方向性错误使得 realm 隔离校验实际失效。影响面为：任何已通过认证、且被授予 iplanet-am-session-destroy-sessions 属性的账号（即被委派管理会话的委派管理员），都可以提交任意目标会话标识符或会话 handle，强制注销处于任意其他 realm 中的用户会话，实现跨 realm 的会话销毁。该漏洞按 CVSS 3.1 评为 4.9（向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H），属中危：攻击向量为网络，复杂度低，但需要高权限（委派管理员）前提，无需用户交互，作用范围不变；机密性与完整性无影响，仅可用性受高影响。利用结果是被害用户被强制下线，可能造成业务中断与反复重新认证，但不涉及数据泄露或篡改。当前输入未提供受影响产品清单、EPSS 分值，未列入 KEV，且来源字段标明无在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该缺陷直接击穿 OpenAM 多 realm（多租户/多域）隔离边界：任何持有 session-destroy 委派权限的账号可跨域强制注销用户，造成可用性中断，且权限模型的可信度受损。虽需高权限前提，但在大型 SSO 部署中委派管理员数量多、影响面广，应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用性受高影响：任意 realm 下的用户会话可被未授权范围内的委派管理员强制注销，导致用户被异常下线、业务中断、反复重新认证，可能被用于定向干扰特定域用户；机密性与完整性不受影响，无数据泄露或篡改证据。

items.summary: OpenAM before 16.1.3 applies its OAuth2 Provider PKCE enforcement only to authorization requests whose response_type is exactly code, so codes issued through OpenID Connect hybrid flows (code token, code id_token, code token id_token) carry no bound challenge. An attacker who intercepts such a code can redeem it for a public client's tokens with any non-empty code_verifier.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the raw JCA provider's legacy PBES1 (PKCS#5 scheme 1) and PKCS#12 PBE families ran their password-based key derivation with an iteration c...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the raw JCA provider's legacy PBES1 (PKCS#5 scheme 1) and PKCS#12 PBE families ran their password-based key derivation with an iteration count taken from untrusted input without bounding it, so a small input could dictate an arbitrary amount of work before anything could be verified. The AlgorithmParameters implementations (PKCS12PBE and its object identifier aliases, and PBKDF1) accepted any count from an encoded PKCS12PBEParams or PBEParameter, narrowing a value beyond the int range with intValue(), and every Cipher, Mac and SecretKeyFactory in these families derived with whatever count it was given, including one decoded by another provider's AlgorithmParameters, as when javax.crypto.EncryptedPrivateKeyInfo.getKeySpec() decrypts a PKCS#12 PBE-protected private key with BC. Both the parameter parse and the derivations now reject a negative or over-limit count under the org.bouncycastle.pbe.max_iteration_count property (default 10,000,000) that already bounded PBKDF2 (CVE-2026-17508), and the parse rejects a count beyond the int range rather than narrowing it. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, a truncated OpenPGP encrypted message was accepted with no error reported, and on the SEIPD version 1 path with no integrity check perform...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, a truncated OpenPGP encrypted message was accepted with no error reported, and on the SEIPD version 1 path with no integrity check performed at all. RFC 9580 sec. 13.7 permits an implementation to release the cleartext of the fully authenticated chunks when streaming but requires it to indicate a clear error as soon as the truncation is detected, and to report suspect integrity when it discovers malleable ciphertext. The truncation was detected and then discarded: when a message is truncated but the length field of the enclosing packet is left unchanged, BCPGInputStream.PartialInputStream raises an EOFException for the missing ciphertext, and BCPGInputStream.nextPacketTag() reports an EOFException as a clean end of message, so the packet stream above it stopped as though no packets remained. On the AEAD path (SEIPD version 2 and the version 5 AEAD packet), when the literal data packet ended on an AEAD chunk boundary and the consumer read in increments smaller than one chunk, the look-ahead for the packet after the literal triggered the truncated chunk read, so BcAEADUtil and JceAEADUtil never reached the trailing message tag of sec. 5.13.2 that authenticates the total plaintext length; the caller received the plaintext of the fully authenticated chunks, every packet following the literal was silently dropped, and no exception was raised, so a signed and encrypted message read back as a well-formed unsigned one. Every byte released on that path remained individually authenticated, making this a missing truncation error rather than a forgery, and it is a residual of CVE-2026-12817, which closed the same outcome for an attacker who corrects the outer packet length. On the SEIPD version 1 path the consequence was more serious: IntegrityProtectedInputStream verifies the modification detection code from close(), and reached close() only by closing itself when a read of it returned -1, which a truncated message never produces, so PGPEncryptedData.verify() never ran and the recipient was handed CFB-decrypted plaintext on which no integrity check of any kind had been performed. Measured on a message truncated into that shape, 136 distinct single-byte modifications of the ciphertext produced accepted, altered plaintext with no exception raised. Reachability is a property of the message rather than of attacker-supplied input: the AEAD shape held for 3 of 131 consecutive payload lengths measured, and the SEIPD version 1 shape for one payload length in sixteen, at a truncation offset that did not move with the payload length. The low-level API is unaffected, a caller that invokes PGPEncryptedData.verify() directly getting the check regardless, as are consumers reading in increments of a whole AEAD chunk or more. The AEAD decryption streams now re-throw such an EOFException as a plain IOException, which nextPacketTag() does not launder; OpenPGPMessageInputStream.close() now closes its layer's integrity-protected stream itself rather than relying on that stream having seen the end of its data; and IntegrityProtectedInputStream.close() was made idempotent, as java.io.Closeable requires, which that depends on, since the stream is genuinely closed twice on the ordinary path and PGPEncryptedData.verify() consumes the digest state behind it and cannot be run a second time. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, on the AEAD route only, as that edition does not ship the high-level OpenPGP API the SEIPDv1 route runs through. It also affects Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpg-fips 1.0.14 (1.0.X series), 2.0.14.1 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.14 (2.1.X series), on the AEAD route only, as those editions do not ship the high-level OpenPGP API.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the opt-in key-size validation on CMS key-transport recipients, org.bouncycastle.cms.jcajce.JceKeyTransRecipient.setKeySizeValidation(true...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the opt-in key-size validation on CMS key-transport recipients, org.bouncycastle.cms.jcajce.JceKeyTransRecipient.setKeySizeValidation(true), never ran for a message using RFC 9709 content-encryption key derivation (id-alg-cek-hkdf-sha256). The branch that should have selected the actual content-encryption algorithm carried in the key derivation AlgorithmIdentifier's parameters compared the encrypted-key byte array against the id-alg-cek-hkdf-sha256 object identifier, a comparison between a byte array and an ASN1ObjectIdentifier that is false for every possible input, so the check fell through to a key-size lookup on the outer wrapper OID. That OID identifies a key-derivation construction rather than a cipher and has no registered key size, so the size comparison was skipped entirely. A key-transport EnvelopedData or AuthEnvelopedData whose transported, HKDF-derived content-encryption key did not match the key size of the advertised content-encryption algorithm was therefore accepted even with validation explicitly enabled, silently defeating the only mechanism the API offers for enforcing recovered key size. The recipient now dispatches on the content-encryption AlgorithmIdentifier's algorithm OID, so validation checks the recovered key against the inner content-encryption algorithm. Messages with a matching key size, non-HKDF messages, and recipients that do not enable validation are unaffected. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpkix-fips 2.0.13 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.13 (2.1.X series).

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, BLS12_381BasicScheme.keyValidate, and so BLSPublicKeyParameters and every BasicScheme, MessageAugmentation and ProofOfPossession verify an...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, BLS12_381BasicScheme.keyValidate, and so BLSPublicKeyParameters and every BasicScheme, MessageAugmentation and ProofOfPossession verify and aggregateVerify that gate on it, accepted a public key built on a foreign ECCurve that merely shares BLS12-381's field characteristic. The prime-order subgroup check trusts a point's own curve to name its cofactor, since ECPoint.satisfiesOrder returns true outright when the curve's cofactor is one, so a point on a curve with a different equation and a cofactor forged to one passed keyValidate despite not being a G1 point at all. In BC's pairing implementation such a point contributes the identity in the target group, so an aggregate signature verified against a set of public keys including it is accepted even though it contains no signature for that key and message pair, admitting a phantom signer. keyValidate now first confirms that the point's curve carries exactly the canonical G1 field, equation, order and cofactor before any subgroup check. The issue is reachable only where an application constructs an ECPoint on an explicit, non-canonical curve and accepts it as an authority-bearing key; the standard 48-byte compressed-point decoder always supplies the canonical curve and was never affected.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, validation of an MLS (RFC 9420) external commit's proposal list, org.bouncycastle.mls.protocol.Group.validateExternalCachedProposals, coun...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, validation of an MLS (RFC 9420) external commit's proposal list, org.bouncycastle.mls.protocol.Group.validateExternalCachedProposals, counted the proposals by type and bounded the removed leaf index but never established that the removed leaf had anything to do with the joiner. RFC 9420 sec. 12.2 permits at most one Remove proposal in an external commit, with which the joiner removes an old version of themselves, and requires that where one is present the LeafNode in the commit's path field meet the criteria it would have to meet in an Update for the removed leaf, in particular that its credential present identifiers acceptable for the removed participant. The ordinary proposal-list validator's self-remove rule is deliberately not applied on this path, because a resync commit legitimately removes a leaf the joiner owns, but nothing was put in its place. Any party holding the group's public GroupInfo, which is precisely what an external joiner is meant to be given, could therefore commit a Remove naming any member's LeafIndex and have every member apply it, evicting that member and taking over their slot in the ratchet tree. The credential check that should have prevented this existed only in the gRPC interop harness and so protected no other caller of the public Group.externalJoin and Group.handle API. An external commit carrying a Remove is now accepted only when the removed leaf's credential is identical to the one in the joiner's own new leaf, on both the sending and the receiving side.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, neither copy of PKIXCertPathReviewer - org.bouncycastle.pkix.jcajce.PKIXCertPathReviewer nor the legacy org.bouncycastle.x509.PKIXCertPath...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, neither copy of PKIXCertPathReviewer - org.bouncycastle.pkix.jcajce.PKIXCertPathReviewer nor the legacy org.bouncycastle.x509.PKIXCertPathReviewer - applied X.509 name constraints to the end-entity certificate. checkNameConstraints walked the path with a loop bound of index greater than zero, which is the bound the CA-only steps require, but index zero is the target certificate under the standard CertPath ordering, so the permitted and excluded subtree checks of RFC 5280 sec. 6.1.3 (b) and (c) never ran against the leaf's subject DN or its subjectAltName. A chain whose leaf violated a NameConstraints extension imposed by its own issuing CA therefore reported isValidCertPath() true with an empty error list, while CertPathValidator.getInstance("PKIX", "BC"), which shares no code with the reviewer, rejected the identical chain against the identical trust anchor. An application using the reviewer to make the trust decision rather than for diagnostics alongside a real validation accepted a certificate the constrained CA was never authorised to issue. Both copies now check every certificate in the path including the target, waive the sec. 4.2.1.10 self-issued exemption for the final certificate as sec. 6.1.3 requires, and skip the sec. 6.1.4 (g) constraint-accumulation step for the target. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, which carries only the org.bouncycastle.pkix.jcajce copy of the reviewer. It also affects Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpkix-fips 1.0.13 (1.0.X series), 2.0.13 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.13 (2.1.X series).

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the streaming CMS AuthenticatedData parser accepted a message whose digestAlgorithm and authAttrs fields disagreed about whether authentic...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the streaming CMS AuthenticatedData parser accepted a message whose digestAlgorithm and authAttrs fields disagreed about whether authenticated attributes were present. RFC 5652 sec. 9.1 pairs the two, requiring that authAttrs be present whenever digestAlgorithm is, and sec. 9.2 makes the MAC cover the DER encoding of authAttrs when they are present and the eContent OCTET STRING directly when they are not. CMSAuthenticatedDataParser has to choose between those two in its constructor, before it can reach authAttrs, which comes later in the SEQUENCE, so it chose on digestAlgorithm alone: for a message with digestAlgorithm absent but authAttrs present it verified the content MAC and then returned the attributes through getAuthAttrs() as though they had been authenticated, when the MAC had never covered them. An attacker able to modify a message in transit could insert an authenticated attribute, such as an RFC 2634 ESSSecurityLabel, into an otherwise valid message while holding neither the key-encryption key nor the content-MAC key, and an application taking an authorization, routing or labelling decision from those attributes would act on attacker-chosen values. The content itself remained MAC-bound. asn1.cms.AuthenticatedData now rejects the mismatched pairing when parsing and CMSAuthenticatedDataParser cross-checks the two fields once authAttrs is read. This is a variant of CVE-2026-59642, which bound the content to the MAC for messages that legitimately carry authAttrs, and which does not address this case. This issue also affects Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, and Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (BC-FJA) before bcpkix-fips 1.0.13 (1.0.X series), 2.0.13 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.13 (2.1.X series), and bcutil-fips 2.0.8 (2.0.X series) and 2.1.8 (2.1.X series).

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the high-level OpenPGP API accepted a data signature made by a signing subkey whose Subkey Binding signature carried no embedded Primary K...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the high-level OpenPGP API accepted a data signature made by a signing subkey whose Subkey Binding signature carried no embedded Primary Key Binding (cross-certification) signature, in the case where that binding omits a Key Flags subpacket. RFC 9580 sec. 5.2.1.8 and sec. 10.1.3 require the embedded Primary Key Binding signature on any subkey that can issue signatures; it is the subkey's own statement that it belongs to the primary key it is bound under. OpenPGPCertificate resolved the subkey's key flags two different ways. isSigningKey() goes through getKeyFlags() and getApplyingSubpacket(), which falls back to the primary key's direct-key or primary User ID self-signature when the binding signature omits the subpacket, so the subkey inherited the primary's SIGN_DATA and counted as signing-capable; verifyEmbeddedPrimaryKeyBinding(), which enforces the requirement, reads the binding signature's own hashed subpackets, found no SIGN_DATA there, and returned early as a non-signing key without ever demanding the back signature. The same subkey was therefore signing-capable - so its signatures were attributed to the certificate and OpenPGPSignature.OpenPGPDocumentSignature.isValid() returned true - while being exempt from cross-certification, where GnuPG refuses the identical certificate and message. An attacker needs only the victim's public signing subkey, which is public material: they bind it to their own primary key with a Subkey Binding signature they are able to make, carrying no Key Flags and no embedded Primary Key Binding signature, which they cannot make without the subkey's private key, and a relying party verifying one of the victim's genuinely signed messages against that certificate is told the signature is valid and given the attacker's certificate as its issuer. Because a certificate's User IDs are self-asserted, a verifier that pins on the subkey's fingerprint or key ID while taking the identity from the enclosing certificate reports a real signature under an attacker-chosen identity. This is misattribution of a genuine signature rather than forgery of a new one: no private key is recovered, and the signature must be one the grafted subkey actually made. The low-level PGPSignature / PGPPublicKeyRing API performs no binding checks by design and is unaffected. Key Flags are a statement about the key the carrying signature refers to (RFC 9580 sec. 5.2.3.29), so a subkey no longer inherits them from the certificate-wide signatures of the primary key: a Subkey Binding signature that omits the subpacket now leaves the subkey with no capabilities rather than the primary's, which makes the flags the cross-certification check consults the same flags every other decision consults. Preferences and the other subpackets a direct-key signature carries are inherited as before, and the primary key itself, whose flags legitimately come from its own direct-key or User ID self-signature, is unaffected.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the high-level OpenPGP certificate API accepted a third-party certification or trust delegation from any component key of the issuing cert...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the high-level OpenPGP certificate API accepted a third-party certification or trust delegation from any component key of the issuing certificate, without requiring that component to have been granted the authority to certify. OpenPGPCertificate.getCertificationBy() and getDelegationBy() resolve a third-party signature by matching its issuer key identifier against every key of the third-party certificate, then verify the issuing component's binding chain and the signature itself; nothing checked that the issuing component carried the RFC 9580 sec. 5.2.3.29 certification key flag (CERTIFY_OTHER) when the signature was created. A subkey bound only with SIGN_DATA - the online signing subkey of exactly the offline-primary arrangement those key flags exist to express - could therefore issue a positive User ID certification over an attacker-controlled identity, or a full-trust depth-one direct-key delegation of introducer trust, and the API returned it as a valid signature chain attributed to the third-party certificate. An application treating getCertificationBy(...).isValid() or getDelegationBy(...) as an identity or trusted-introducer decision would attribute the attacker's assertion to the offline primary key. The same held for a legacy RSA subkey bound only for encryption, whose algorithm is nonetheless able to sign. This does not forge the primary key's signature or recover any private key; it promotes an already-compromised restricted subkey to the primary key's identity-issuing authority, defeating the containment the key-flag separation provides. A third-party certification or delegation is now attributed to the issuing certificate only when the component key that made it is the primary key, or is a subkey holding CERTIFY_OTHER when the signature was created, so certification-capable subkeys continue to be accepted; primary keys are accepted whatever their key flags say, since a primary key is certification-capable by construction and certificates carrying no key flags subpacket at all are common. Third-party revocations are deliberately outside the rule, since declining to honour one would keep trust alive rather than withdraw it.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) implementation did not bind an X.509 credential to a LeafNode's signature_key. LeafNode.verif...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, the Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) implementation did not bind an X.509 credential to a LeafNode's signature_key. LeafNode.verify() checked a leaf's signature against the signature_key carried in the leaf itself, while the credential's X.509 certificate chain was stored but never parsed or validated, so the end-entity certificate's public key was never required to match signature_key as RFC 9420 sec. 5.3 requires. A party could therefore present another party's certificate as its credential while signing the leaf, and the enclosing KeyPackage, with an unrelated key, and be accepted under that other party's identity through KeyPackage.verify() and the Group leaf-validation path. In a deployment that admits external commits without an independent credential-admission check, an unauthenticated attacker could be admitted under a victim's X.509 identity, evict the victim (resynchronization compares whole credentials rather than signing keys), derive the current epoch, decrypt subsequent group messages, and send messages accepted as the victim. TreeKEM.LeafNode now requires the end-entity certificate's subject public key, in the cipher suite's signature encoding, to equal signature_key for an X.509 credential and rejects the leaf otherwise, including an empty chain or a certificate whose key type does not match the cipher suite; certificate-chain and identity validation to a trust anchor remain the application's responsibility per RFC 9420 sec. 5.3.1. Deployments using only basic credentials are unaffected.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, the one-shot native packet ciphers for AES-CBC, CCM, CFB, CTR, GCM and GCM-SIV released the caller's key, IV and additional authent...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java LTS before 2.73.13, the one-shot native packet ciphers for AES-CBC, CCM, CFB, CTR, GCM and GCM-SIV released the caller's key, IV and additional authenticated data arrays with JNI's ReleaseByteArrayElements in mode 0, which commits the native copy back into the Java array. Those arrays are read-only to the native code, and on a JVM that returns a copy rather than a pin the copy still holds the input bytes as they were read. The output buffer is taken through a separate critical region and committed first, so where an application passed the same Java array as both an input and the destination - encrypting in place over KeyParameter.getKey(), for example - the later mode-0 release of the key wrote the unchanged key bytes over the ciphertext that had just been produced. The call still returned the correct output length, so an application encrypting in place over its own key array was handed the raw AES key where it expected ciphertext, with nothing in the API to indicate it, and would transmit or store the key in place of the message. The read-only input arrays are now released with JNI_ABORT, freeing the native copy without copying it back, and mode 0 is reserved for arrays the native code wrote. The pure-Java packet ciphers and the streaming native modes are not affected. Bouncy Castle for Java (bcprov) is not affected, as it ships no native implementations.

items.title: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, HQC leaked secret-derived data through two side channels: its GF(2^8) arithmetic used lookup tables indexed by field elements, making the ...
items.summary: In Bouncy Castle for Java before 1.86, HQC leaked secret-derived data through two side channels: its GF(2^8) arithmetic used lookup tables indexed by field elements, making the cache line touched a function of the operand, and its fixed-weight support sampler left its duplicate scan as soon as a collision was found and stored accepted positions at a secret index. Both run on secret inputs during encapsulation and decapsulation, and the sampler re-expands the secret key from its seed on every decapsulation, so an attacker able to observe cache behaviour or decapsulation timing can recover information about the HQC private key. The field arithmetic is now table-free and the sampler branch-free within a batch of candidates, with output and randomness consumption unchanged.

Patch name: a5aecea074e8564b7a22f1ce054b31ec862974b7. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. One of the project maintainers explains, that "EPUB support was removed from Xreader and reimplemented in Xepub".

items.title: The Burst Statistics – Simple WordPress Analytics (Google Analytics Alternative) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Improper Authentication leading to Account Persistence in ...
items.summary: The Burst Statistics – Simple WordPress Analytics (Google Analytics Alternative) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Improper Authentication leading to Account Persistence in all versions up to, and including, 3.7.1. This is due to the `maybe_load_shared_dashboard()` handler issuing a genuine WordPress session cookie for the `burst_statistics_viewer` account to any visitor presenting a valid share token via `wp_set_auth_cookie()`, while the plugin only blocks Application Passwords for the resulting `burst_viewer` role and does not restrict the core `/wp-json/wp/v2/users/me` password update endpoint or filter the `edit_user` capability for that account — leaving WordPress core's built-in rule that any authenticated user may update their own account fully in effect. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to set an attacker-chosen password on the `burst_statistics_viewer` WordPress account, constituting a permanent takeover of that limited-privilege (`view_burst_statistics`) account that persists through share-token revocation, share-token expiration, and execution of the plugin's daily `cleanup_viewer_sessions()` routine. Exploitation requires that the attacker have obtained a valid `burst_share_token`, such as one that has been shared publicly or distributed to an untrusted party.

items.summary: The Photo Reviews for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary Content Deletion in versions up to, and including, 1.2.30. This is due to the plugin storing attacker-controlled post IDs from the wcpr_image_upload_id parameter of a public review submission into the review's reviews-images comment meta without verifying that the IDs correspond to attachments owned by the submitter, combined with the delete_reviews_image() handler unconditionally calling wp_delete_post( $id, true ) on every stored ID when the review is deleted. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to permanently delete arbitrary posts, pages, products, or media attachments on the site whenever an administrator subsequently deletes the attacker's review (or when WordPress's built-in wp_scheduled_delete cron empties the comment trash after 30 days).
